article.articleHeadline: DBD hingga ISPA Mengintai Anak Saat Peralihan Musim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever and Acute Respiratory Infections Threaten Children as the Seasons Change
article.articleSummary: Jakarta-based pediatric specialist Mulki Angela warns that the transition from dry to rainy season raises risks of acute respiratory infections (ARI), including influenza A, particularly in Jakarta. Smoke from forest-fire/peatland fires (karhutla) areas can exacerbate respiratory problems. With the onset of rain, dengue fever (DBD) transmission risk increases due to mosquitoes. Limited access to clean water may cause diarrheal illness and vomiting, and skin infections can occur. Preventive measures focus on 3M Plus for dengue, regular handwashing, bathing, changing clothes, maintaining a clean home, and eliminating standing water; ensure adequate fluids for children and have fever-reducing medicines at home. To bolster immunity, emphasize balanced nutrition, physical activity, sleep, and possibly vitamin D supplementation. Transmission precautions include distancing from the sick, masking, coughing etiquette, and ensuring complete immunizations. Parents should prepare children’s rain gear and spare clothes for wet conditions.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Fatality Rate Tops 50% After Hundreds of Deaths Added to Congo Toll
article.articleSummary: 10,414 laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections and 5,372 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo, yielding a case-fatality ratio of 51.6% after Ituri province's health authorities added 314 previously uncounted deaths from a records review covering 97% of affected health zones. The update lifted CFR from 48.6% two days earlier, as new infections rose by 140. The outbreak's epicenter is Ituri, with transmission across eight provinces and 67 health zones, marking the largest Ebola outbreak in Congo's history and the largest globally since 2013–2016 West Africa. Nigeria has one confirmed infection, with two suspected cases in Adamawa tested negative. The US will tighten travel restrictions: beginning late Tuesday, travelers boarding international flights to the US must attest they have not been in the DRC in the prior 21 days, otherwise typically barred from boarding.

article.articleHeadline: Awas! 5 Penyakit Ini Mengintai Saat Musim Hujan, DBD dan Leptospirosis Bisa Berujung Fatal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Watch out! These 5 diseases lurk during the rainy season; dengue fever and leptospirosis can be fatal.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's rainy season prompts health warnings from the Ministry of Health, highlighting five diseases linked to moisture and standing water, including dengue fever and leptospirosis. Dengue fever, transmitted by Aedes aegypti mosquitoes that breed in standing water, can present with sudden high fever, headache, muscle and joint pains, nausea, vomiting, and red skin rashes; warning signs include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, dehydration, and weakness. The article emphasizes preventive measures, particularly the 3M Plus program: drain standing water, tightly cover water storage, and reuse or repurpose items that can hold water to reduce mosquito breeding sites. The piece does not provide specific case or death counts. Published 2026-11-02, per Indonesia's Health Ministry guidance.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola fatality rate tops 50% after hundreds of deaths added to Congo toll
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 10,414 confirmed infections and 5,372 deaths, a case-fatality ratio of 51.6% after 314 earlier Ebola deaths were added to Ituri province’s toll. The epidemic has spread to eight provinces and 67 health zones, with Ituri as epicenter. It is the largest Ebola outbreak in Congo’s history and the largest globally since 2013-2016 West Africa outbreak. Transmission has extended beyond Congo, though spillover elsewhere remains limited; Nigeria reported two suspected cases tested negative on Oct 31, leaving one confirmed infection in the country. The United States will tighten travel rules from Nov 3: travelers boarding international flights must attest they were not in the DRC in the prior 21 days; those who were in Congo generally cannot board US-bound flights. The numbers are based on a latest Oct 31 report.

article.articleHeadline: Melioidosis in Thailand: Soil Fever Explained
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis, or soil fever, is caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei and is endemic in Thailand, with especially high risk in the Northeast and eastern regions (Chiang Rai cited). The bacteria enter via skin cuts, swallowing contaminated water, or inhalation of disturbed soil or water; person-to-person transmission is rare. Symptoms can include fever, cough, breathing problems, or skin abscesses, typically appearing 1–4 weeks after exposure, though delays of months or years are possible. Diagnosis relies on cultures. Treatment requires an initial intensive antibiotic course followed by a prolonged oral regimen. Rainy-season outdoor work increases exposure risk, and untreated well or natural water may pose additional danger. Preventive measures include wearing boots, covering wounds, and drinking treated water. A 2025 study reported melioidosis in 36 of 1,486 adults admitted with bacterial pneumonia in an endemic region.

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện sốt mò từ vết loét ở nách
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Discovery of visceral leishmaniasis from an armpit ulcer.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-02 in Hanoi, a 67-year-old woman (Bà Minh) presented with 40°C fever, headache, cough progressing to pneumonia and respiratory failure. An axillary ulcer with a black eschar and round red lesions on the face and forearm were observed. She had garden exposure two weeks earlier. Diagnostic workup for scrub typhus—caused by Orientia tsutsugamushi and transmitted by chiggers—included blood cultures and biochemical tests; she was diagnosed with scrub typhus and treated with targeted antibiotics. After three days, fever abated and fatigue improved, though diarrhea persisted, prompting a regimen change. After a week of intensified therapy, pneumonia and liver enzyme elevations improved. The report notes that scrub typhus can resemble other febrile illnesses (flu, COVID-19, dengue) and that black eschars may appear at hidden bite sites such as the armpit, groin, or under the breast. Gardening or outdoor exposure is a key risk factor.

article.articleHeadline: Colombia confirma dos casos de malaria y las autoridades activan protocolos de vigilancia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Colombia confirms two malaria cases and authorities activate surveillance protocols.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed malaria cases in Colombia, with one death and another hospitalized, triggering enhanced surveillance nationwide. Cases involve Colombian nationals who arrived from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to Cali and Palmira in Valle del Cauca (southwest). Diagnoses are Plasmodium falciparum malaria, the most dangerous form. One patient, aged 33, died on Oct 31 in Palmira; the other, aged 50, remains hospitalized in Cali. Two additional individuals from the DRC are under observation. Health authorities are conducting tests to exclude other infections, including Ebola, with no confirmed Ebola cases to date. The INIS is coordinating with Migración Colombia to trace travel routes and exposure. Officials urge travelers from the DRC to report fever or malaise promptly. The intervention underscores active prevention and surveillance protocols following imported cases.

article.articleHeadline: पटना में इस सीजन डेंगू से तीसरी मौत, 23 साल के युवक ने PMCH में तोड़ा दम; संक्रमितों की संख्या 500 पार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Patna this season, dengue claims its third death; a 23-year-old man dies at PMCH; the number of those infected has crossed 500.
article.articleSummary: Patna, India reports dengue severity with the season’s third death: a 23-year-old man, Manjeet Kumar of Kamla Nehru Nagar near Buddha Marg, died at Patna Medical College and Hospital (PMCH) after about a month of fever; official confirmation of dengue as cause remains pending. District Dengue-Malaria Officer Subhash Prasad says Patna’s dengue cases have crossed 537, with five new infections confirmed in the last 24 hours. A previous dengue death occurred on Sep 10 involving 28-year-old Mohammad Khusiyal. Local residents claim this is the second dengue fatality in Kamla Nehru Nagar, though authorities have not confirmed it. The report underscores ongoing dengue transmission in Patna city, indicating a continued public health concern and the need for preventive measures and vigilance.

article.articleHeadline: 成大生物（688739.SH）第三季度盈利回暖 布局四价手足口病疫苗_中国财经时报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chengda Biotech (688739.SH) Q3 earnings rebound as it lays out a quadrivalent hand-foot-mouth disease vaccine - China Finance Times Net
article.articleSummary: Chengda Biotech (688739.SH) reported a Q3 2026 earnings rebound as it advances a vaccine matrix and AI-driven drug development. For Jan–Sep 2026, revenue reached CNY 1.043 billion with net profit attributable to shareholders of CNY 97.99 million; Q3 alone delivered CNY 366 million revenue and CNY 64.71 million net profit, up 52.2% YoY. It completed the acquisition of all rights to a recombinant quadrivalent enterovirus vaccine (Hanson Yeast) covering EV-A71, CV-A16, CV-A6 and CV-A10, with a total after-tax licensing fee of CNY 46 million and milestone-based payments, positioning the company in the multi-valent hand-foot-mouth disease space. The human diploid cell rabies vaccine line shipped first batches on Sept 15, with annual capacity of 10 million doses. Other programs include quadrivalent/trivalent influenza vaccines, and 15-valent HPV vaccine in Phase II. Shanghai-based Chengda Ziyuan Medical Technology opened Sept 16 to drive early R&D, backed by a up to CNY 10 billion investment fund.

article.articleHeadline: 俄疫情谜团未解 中共通报一例鼠疫死亡病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia's outbreak mystery remains unsolved; the CCP reports one fatal plague case.
article.articleSummary: Russia's 28-year-old female employee at an anti-plague research institute died in early October from pneumonia of unknown cause; about 200 people were quarantined or under medical observation. The World Health Organization, in a Oct 10 briefing, said tests did not detect plague or other high-risk pathogens among those tested, but the exact cause and full diagnostic data remain undisclosed by Russia. Concurrently, China’s CDC reported one plague death in September 2026 among eight nationwide Class A infections, with no details released. Across China, plague remains sporadic, concentrated in Inner Mongolia, Ningxia, Qinghai, and Yunnan. Notable past cases include 2019 Akesai County, Gansu (suspected/septicemic plague); 2019 Inner Mongolia (pneumonic plague); 2020 Baotou (intestinal plague death); 2022 Tibet’s Shannan (pneumonic plague death); 2023 Inner Mongolia family cluster; and 2024 two cases with one death. Experts warn of opacity and potential concealment, while authorities urge heightened vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの正体不明の感染症の謎は未解決のまま、中国共産党はペスト死亡例1件を報告

triage.notes: ロシアでの正体不明肺炎による死亡例はWHO検査でペスト陰性と確認されており、対象国（ロシア）はリストに含まれないため除外。中国側は過去にも内モンゴル・青海・雲南等で散発的なペスト事例が報告されており、今回の死亡例も同様の文脈と考えられるが、詳細非公開のため評価は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: 俄疫情謎團未解 中共通報一例鼠疫死亡病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia's epidemic mystery remains unsolved; the CCP reports one death from plague.
article.articleSummary: Russia’s plague research institute case: a 28-year-old female employee died in early October from an undetermined pneumonia; about 200 people were quarantined or observed. WHO’s Oct 10 briefing found no plague or other high-risk pathogens in tested samples, but the exact cause and full diagnostic data have not been disclosed, and Russian authorities have not released a definitive explanation, fueling concern of a possible laboratory incident and prompting heightened regional surveillance. In China, the CDC’s Sept 2026 report lists eight Class A infectious disease cases nationwide—seven cholera and one plague—with one plague death, though details on the time or location of the plague fatality were not provided. China has a history of sporadic plague activity, concentrated in Inner Mongolia, Ningxia, Qinghai, Yunnan, and Gansu, often linked to wildlife or pastoral activity; notable past events include 2019 outbreaks in Gansu and Inner Mongolia, a 2020 intestinal plague death in Baotou, and a 2022 Tibetan pneumonic case.

article.articleHeadline: 男子双腿被稻茬划伤险丧命 钩端螺旋体病作祟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man's both legs scratched by rice straw, nearly died; leptospirosis to blame.
article.articleSummary: In Shenzhen, Guangdong, a 24-year-old man developed leptospirosis after returning to Hunan to harvest rice; his legs were cut by rice straw, and both the home and fields harbored rats. Starting Oct 31, he experienced fever up to 38.1°C for five days, with severe headache, back and lower-limb muscle pain, and nausea with vomiting, making it hard to lie down. No waterproof boots were worn while working in the fields. Laboratory testing detected Leptospira in the kidney, with sequence type 1007, confirming leptospirosis (Weil's disease). Major reservoirs include rats, pigs, cattle and sheep; humans acquire infection through contact with contaminated water or soil or direct contact with blood or urine from infected animals. Early symptoms resemble influenza; severe disease can cause pulmonary hemorrhage, jaundice, liver and kidney failure, and be life-threatening. After antibiotics and platelet transfusion, the patient recovered and was discharged.

article.articleHeadline: Mối nguy hại từ virus RSV đối với trẻ, cách phòng hiệu quả
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The danger posed by the RSV virus to children and effective prevention methods.
article.articleSummary: RSV, the respiratory syncytial virus, is a common cause of lower respiratory infection in Vietnam children, potentially causing bronchiolitis, pneumonia, and respiratory failure, especially in infants under 2 years (notably under 6 months) or those with congenital heart or lung disease. It spreads mainly through droplets and contaminated surfaces and circulates year-round with seasonal peaks. At Thanh Son Regional Medical Center, Pediatrics reports multiple RSV admissions. Early symptoms include runny nose, congestion, cough, mild fever, irritability, and poor feeding; progression can lead to bronchiolitis or pneumonia with rapid breathing, wheeze, and chest retractions. Severe disease risks respiratory failure; warning signs include tachypnea, chest indrawing, cyanosis, poor feeding, lethargy, or apnea. Immunity is not long-lasting, so reinfections occur. Prevention emphasizes hand hygiene, cleaning surfaces and toys, avoiding sick contacts and tobacco smoke, ventilated spaces, and avoiding crowds. Some high-risk children may receive monoclonal antibodies as prophylaxis after physician assessment. A case: 8-day-old girl with cyanosis and lung collapse due to RSV.

triage.headline_ja: 子どもに対するRSVウイルスの危険性と効果的な予防法
triage.triage_reason: RSVはベトナムで年間を通じて流行する既知の季節性疾患に関する一般的な医学解説記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の病院における通常のRSV症例報告と一般的な予防啓発を内容としており、異常な集団発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 3 người tử vong do viêm não mô cầu ở Cà Mau: Nhiều người đi tiêm vaccine, chuyên gia cảnh báo!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three people die from meningococcal meningitis in Ca Mau: Many people are getting vaccinated, experts warn!
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal meningitis in Ca Mau, Vietnam, has caused three deaths in 2026, including two recent cases in Song Doc commune. A vaccination surge followed, with overcrowded centers (VNVC and Long Chau) and waits over one hour. Vaccines vary in serogroup coverage and price: Mengoc BC (Cuba) about 396,000 VND per dose; US/Belgian vaccines for serogroups A, C, Y, W about 1.37–1.75 million VND; Bexsero (Italy) over 1.8 million VND. Not all vaccines cover all serogroups, so medical guidance is advised to select appropriate protection. CDC Ca Mau Director Tran Hien Khoa notes vaccines reduce risk but do not guarantee protection, with estimated immunity of 80–90%. Transmission is via respiratory droplets; about 10–25% of people may be asymptomatic carriers. Officials urge calm, avoid crowding, wear masks, maintain hygiene, and seek medical evaluation for fever, cough, or runny nose to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: カマウ省で髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎により3人死亡：多くの人がワクチン接種に殺到、専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎によるクラスター死亡（3名）が発生し、ワクチン接種施設が混雑するなど社会的関心も高まっているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ベトナム・カマウ省（ソンドック村）における髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎クラスターで、2026年に3人が死亡。飛沫感染によるヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があり、無症候性キャリアが10-25%存在するとされる。ワクチン接種施設の混雑など社会的関心が高い一方、国際的拡大や渡航制限の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Antisipasi Penyebaran Nyamuk, LRT Jabodebek Lakukan Fogging di Sejumlah Area Operasional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To Prevent the Spread of Mosquitoes, Jabodebek LRT Conducts Fogging in Several Operational Areas.
article.articleSummary: Jakarta, Indonesia — In the rainy season, Jabodebek LRT intensified mosquito-control efforts by conducting fogging at multiple operational sites on 30–31 October 2026 to reduce dengue fever (DBD) risk. The intervention covered key facilities, including the Operation Control Center (OCC), stabling area, maintenance facilities, the LRT Jabodebek office, workers’ dormitories, and several LRT UPT offices. Public Relations Manager Radhitya Mardika emphasized that protecting the work environment is vital for staff readiness to serve the public, and fogging is part of broader mosquito-control measures in areas prone to breeding. Health personnel accompanying the activity also provided socialization on cleanliness and preventing standing water. Safety guidelines urged workers to vacate treated zones, avoid them until cleared, and secure food, beverages, medicines, and personal items from exposure. Ongoing environmental health efforts complement fogging to sustain a healthy, reliable service.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊の発生防止のため、ジャボデベックLRTが複数の運用エリアでフォギングを実施
triage.triage_reason: ルーチンの予防的蚊防除活動の報道であり、具体的な感染者数や異常な流行拡大の情報がないため、現時点でシグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱予防のための通常の公共交通機関による防蚊活動の報道であり、実際のデング熱症例数や流行状況についての具体的な情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 北京疾控：诺如病毒为什么容易在校园传播？学校和家长该怎么做？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beijing CDC: Why is norovirus easily transmitted on campus, and what should schools and parents do?
article.articleSummary: Norovirus is highly contagious and rapidly spreads in dense settings such as Beijing schools and childcare facilities. Transmission is fecal-oral via close contact with an infected person, contaminated objects, vomiting aerosols, or contaminated food or water. Onset is typically 12–48 hours after exposure; symptoms are vomiting and diarrhea and usually last 2–3 days, with possible reinfection. Prevention emphasizes hand hygiene, boiled water, thoroughly cooked foods, washing fruits and vegetables, and avoiding raw or undercooked items. Infected individuals should stay home to limit spread. Parents should teach children good handwashing before meals, ensure rest and nutrition, and cooperate with schools for stool testing if GI symptoms occur; disinfect with chlorine-based agents and boil utensils for 30 minutes during home isolation. Schools should perform daily health checks, reporting, and environmental disinfection; cafeteria staff who test positive must be off duty until two consecutive negative Norovirus PCR tests, 24 hours apart, and outbreaks reported to local CDC and school health offices.

triage.headline_ja: 北京疾病対策予防センター：なぜノロウイルスは学校で広がりやすいのか？学校と保護者はどう対応すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: 北京市当局による季節性ノロウイルス感染予防に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、異常な流行や重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: ノロウイルスは学校等の密集環境で伝播しやすいため疫学的拡散しやすさ（epidemic_prone）はYesとしたが、具体的な発生規模・症例数等の記載がなく、通常の予防啓発情報に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: Người dân Cà Mau xếp hàng tiêm vắc - xin não mô cầu giữa dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ca Mau residents line up to receive meningococcal vaccine amid an outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ca Mau, Vietnam faces an ongoing outbreak of meningococcal meningitis, with fatalities reported and a surge in vaccination uptake. In late Oct–early Nov, residents crowded VNVC in An Xuyen and Long Chau in Tan Thanh, queuing over an hour for doses. Vaccines available include Mengoc BC (Cuba) at about 396,000 VND per shot; Meningococcal ACWY (US/Belgium) 1.37–1.75 million VND; Bexsero, type B (Italy) over 1.8 million VND. Ca Mau CDC director Tran Hien Khoa warns the disease spreads via respiratory droplets, and 10–25% of people may be asymptomatic carriers who can transmit it. Crowding at vaccination sites may accelerate spread; vaccine protection is not absolute (80–90%). People should maintain precautions—wear masks, practice hygiene, and seek medical care for fever, cough, or runny nose. All licensed vaccines are reported to be quality assured.

triage.headline_ja: カマウ省住民、流行の中で髄膜炎菌ワクチン接種のため長蛇の列
triage.triage_reason: 死亡例を伴う髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の流行が報告され、ワクチン接種会場での混雑による感染拡大懸念など、重症度・流行可能性の観点からフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断される。
triage.notes: 死亡者数、感染者総数、流行の正式な開始時期など詳細情報が不足しており、続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Vaka sayısı 10 bini, can kaybı 5 bini aştı! Kırmızı alarm verildi... Artık tüm ülkeler risk altında
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of cases has surpassed 10,000, and the death toll has surpassed 5,000! Red alert issued... Now all countries are at risk.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) fueled by the rare Bundibugyo strain has surpassed 10,000 cases and 5,000 deaths, triggering a global red alert as cross-border spread intensifies. The virus, characterized by a 21-day incubation, could enable international dissemination before symptoms appear. Symptoms begin with fever, headache, muscle pains, vomiting and diarrhea, progressing to internal bleeding and organ failure; transmission is via blood and body fluids, not a typical respiratory route. No approved vaccine exists for Bundibugyo, with vaccine development expected to take 3–6 months. The outbreak is described as the second-largest Ebola crisis on record, after 2014–2016 West Africa. Reports of imported cases include a Swiss woman infected in Nigeria transferred to Geneva, and a French doctor returning from DRC testing positive. Initial diagnoses in Bunia (April 24) and Mongbwalu (February) were hampered by testing limited to Zaire strain.

triage.headline_ja: 症例数が1万人、死者数が5千人を超えた！レッドアラート発令…もはや全ての国がリスクにさらされている
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの希少なブンディブギョ株によるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが1万症例・5000人死亡、国際的な拡散（スイス・フランスへの輸入例）を報じており、事実であればIHR基準を複数満たすため、情報の信憑性を含めフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の内容（症例1万人超・死者5千人超、ブンディブギョ株による史上2番目の規模のアウトブレイク）は、WHO等の公式情報と比較して過大・異常な数値である可能性が高く、信頼性の検証が必須。トルコ語メディア単独情報であり、一次情報源（WHO/DRC保健省）での裏付けが取れるまでは誇張・誤報の可能性も考慮すべき。スイス・フランス・ナイジェリアでの輸入症例についても要確認。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴのエボラ死者5000人超、世界で過去2番目の流行規模に
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in Congo surpasses 5,000, the second-largest outbreak on record worldwide.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-02, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 5,000 people, marking the second-largest outbreak on record globally. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo virus, for which there are no approved therapies or vaccines. Since its May declaration, confirmed infections exceed 10,000 across eight of the 26 provinces, with many deaths occurring outside treatment facilities. Delays in detection, ongoing conflict, and an overburdened health system have facilitated rapid spread. Globally, the outbreak trails only the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which infected over 28,600 and killed more than 11,000. Nigeria reported a case last week—the fourth African country to record one—while Kenya and Uganda have also reported cases as the outbreak extends into West and East Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者5000人超、世界で過去2番目の流行規模に
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）による死者が5000人を超え、世界で過去2番目の規模の流行となっており、複数国への越境拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事ではナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダへの拡大も報じられているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。アンゴラ・モザンビークはBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが記事本文で言及がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolas vīruss kļūst nekontrolējams: eksperti skaidro, kāpēc to neizdodas apturēt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus is becoming uncontrollable: experts explain why it cannot be stopped.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is contending Bundibugyo ebolavirus in its largest outbreak since records began, declared May 2026; by late October 2026 there were over 9,800 infections and more than 4,700 deaths. Ituri province is the epicenter, with cases also in other eastern regions. At Katwa Ebola Treatment Center in Butembo, 252 patients have been admitted, with more than 70 deaths. Delayed care, poor roads, the rainy season, and insecurity hinder response, forcing many patients to travel days and cross rivers; families often attempt home remedies, wasting crucial time. Most cases are among ages 15–49, linked to informal mining camps in Ituri. Misinformation about vaccines for Bundibugyo impedes care; currently no approved Bundibugyo vaccine, though early supportive treatment and patient isolation improve survival. Contact tracing is ~75%; experts say >95% is needed. Research examines Bundibugyo-specific vaccines and potential cross-immunity from rVSV. Medair provides medical and material aid.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが制御不能に：専門家が阻止できない理由を説明
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスの史上最大規模の流行が発生しており、感染者9,800人超、死者4,700人超と深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、国際的拡大・支援の必要性も認められるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はラトビア語メディアによるものだが内容はDRC東部（イトゥリ州、北キブ州）のエボラ流行に関する詳細な報告。承認済みワクチンがなく、接触者追跡率が目標未達（75%<95%）である点がリスクとして強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya to release ebola contacts on Tuesday, urges Saudi to lift ban
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports nine Ebola cases tied to a single imported cluster with no community transmission; two deaths. The initial case, Oct 6, involved a man who had travelled from the DRC via Uganda (he died Oct 5, per MOH). Of 135 contacts traced, the first group completed 21 days in quarantine and were discharged on Oct 26; the remaining contacts are due for discharge on Nov 3, 2026, if negative. Seven patients remain in treatment and are expected to be discharged on Nov 2, 2026; 46 more quarantined individuals will be released on Nov 3 if they maintain negative status. WHO says the outbreak is under control and advises against travel bans; Kenya requests WHO to explain restrictions within 48 hours under IHR 2005. Saudi Arabia imposed Oct 30 travel/visa bans on Kenyans and barred Saudis from visiting Kenya, a move Kenya calls disproportionate and unsupported by science.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、火曜日にエボラ接触者を解放予定、サウジアラビアに禁輸措置の解除を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の輸入例（DRC由来）がケニアで発生し、死亡者も出ているほか、サウジアラビアが渡航・ビザ制限を課すなど国際的な緊張が生じており、IHR基準の複数が該当するためフルリスク評価へ進める。
triage.notes: 実際の症例発生国はケニアであり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。DRCは感染者の渡航元として言及されているのみで、DRC国内での新規発生事例は記事中に示されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Heat, Smog and Mosquitoes: How Climate Change Is Making India Sick, Says Lancet Report
article.articleSummary: Heat, smog and mosquitoes drive rising climate-health risks in India, per the Lancet Countdown. In 2023, heat caused a record 7.1 lakh deaths globally, with 71.5% linked to human-caused climate change. India faces about 2,600 hours/year of heat stress and little night relief, with 64 hours of sleep lost annually (2021–25). Among medium-HDI countries, India bears the highest heat-stress burden (~2,430 hours/person/year) and heat deaths total about 1.26%, with 56.3% attributed to climate change. PM2.5 pollution killed about 2.2 million in India in 2023, worth US$517 billion. Mosquito-borne risks rise: transmission potential for Aedes vectors increases; malaria transmission months up 19% for Pf and 18% for Pv (2016–25 vs 1981–90). Vibrio coastline suitability expands 27% to ~2,740 km by 2025. Outdoor workers face substantial global GDP losses.

triage.headline_ja: 熱波、スモッグ、蚊:気候変動がインドの健康をどう悪化させているか、ランセット報告書が指摘
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、気候変動と健康リスクに関するLancet Countdownの一般的な分析レポートであるため、感染症イベントとしてのシグナル性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な感染症発生事例ではなく、気候変動がマラリアやビブリオ感染症の媒介条件（伝播期間延長、沿岸適地拡大）に与える将来的・傾向的影響を論じた学術レポート（Lancet Countdown）の報道。急性の公衆衛生イベントではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉致死率破50%！　民主剛果「校正回歸」確診數破萬
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fatality rate surpasses 50%! Democratic Republic of the Congo's "calibration regression" confirmed cases exceed ten thousand.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the largest in the country’s history, with 10,414 laboratory-confirmed cases and 5,372 deaths, giving a case fatality rate of 51.6% after retrospective recalibration added 314 previously uncounted deaths. Ituri province accounts for 97% of affected health zones; the outbreak has spread to eight provinces and 67 health zones nationwide. Data reflect updates through Oct 31, following recalibration, with daily new infections continuing. Cross-border risk includes Nigeria (1 confirmed, 2 suspected cases later negative). In response, the US CDC will tighten travel restrictions from Nov 3: travelers who have been in the DRC in the past 21 days must sign a declaration, and those with recent DRC residence are generally barred from boarding international flights.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ致死率50%超！民主コンゴ「校正見直し」で確定症例数が1万人突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が継続し、致死率51.6%、複数州・国境を越えた拡散、米国の渡航制限強化が確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ナイジェリアでの確定症例は1件のみで疑い例は陰性と判明しており、ナイジェリアは対象国だが今回の発生地域としては確定していないため除外。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めず。

article.articleHeadline: 同曦官方：全队遭遇大面积甲流感染 郭昊文&双外援等出现发热症状
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tongxi Official: The Entire Team Has Suffered a Widespread H1N1 Influenza Infection; Guo Haowen and Two Foreign Players, Among Others, Have Developed Fever Symptoms
article.articleSummary: As of Nov 2, 2026, Tongxi's official briefing confirms a widespread H1N1 influenza outbreak among the team after a four-city road trip (Nanjing to Qingdao, Chengdu, Urumqi, ending in Shanghai). Since Oct 24, travel amid substantial temperature variation coincided with high flu activity; multiple players, including Jiang He, Kai Kai, Zhu Zixuan, Guo Haowen, and two foreign players, developed fever and flu-like symptoms, with several others playing despite mild illness. The team lost 84-100 to Shanghai in Shanghai. No laboratory confirmation details are provided in the report. The squad plans to return to Jiangning (Nanjing) for the season’s end of the first phase and the Jiangsu Derby at home, emphasizing rapid recovery for the group.

triage.headline_ja: 同曦オフィシャル：チーム全体が広範囲なH1N1インフルエンザ感染に見舞われる 郭昊文や外国人選手2名などが発熱症状
triage.triage_reason: バスケットボールチーム内での季節性インフルエンザ様症状の集団発生であり、検査確認もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: スポーツチーム内の季節性インフルエンザ様症状の集団発生報道であり、検査室での確認は未実施。公衆衛生イベントとしての重大性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Update: 46 Contacts Set for Release Tuesday, Five Patients Await Second Tests
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak: 9 confirmed infections, 2 deaths, all from the initial imported case of a Kenyan national who traveled from DRC via Uganda. The Ministry identifies 135 contacts; 118 are in quarantine; 20 discharged on Oct 26. Another 46 contacts are slated for release on Tuesday Nov 3 after completing a 21-day monitoring period if asymptomatic. Five of seven patients still in treatment are expected to be discharged after a second negative Ebola test; they had one negative and await a second test on Nov 2. To date, 66 people have been released from quarantine. No new confirmed infections since Oct 19; transmission appears confined to one cluster, with containment through contact tracing, isolation, lab testing and entry screening. Kenya seeks Saudi Arabia to lift Oct 30 travel restrictions and asks WHO for justification within 48 hours per IHR, and will raise the matter with Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ最新情報：46名の接触者が火曜日に解放予定、5名の患者が2回目の検査待ち
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクで死亡例が発生し、国際的な渡航制限（サウジアラビアによる入国制限）とWHO・Africa CDCへの対応要請が生じているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 確定症例9例・死亡2例は全てケニアで確認されているが、感染源となった初発症例はDRCからウガンダ経由で輸入されたとされる。ケニア・ウガンダ・サウジアラビアは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsとした。新規感染は10/19以降確認されておらず、接触者追跡・隔離による封じ込めが進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Bercermin dari Muntaber Massal di Garut, Dokter Jelaskan Penularan Virus hingga Bahaya Dehidrasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reflecting on Garut's Mass Gastroenteritis Outbreak, a Doctor Explains Virus Transmission and the Dangers of Dehydration.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 November 2026, Garut, West Java, faces a mass gastroenteritis outbreak among several tourists. Gastroenteritis (muntaber) stems from infections or noninfectious factors; viruses are common culprits. Transmission occurs via direct contact or contaminated food and drinks. Norovirus frequently causes illness in adults, especially in crowded settings, with rotavirus, adenovirus, and astrovirus also implicated. Bacterial culprits include Escherichia coli, Salmonella, Campylobacter, Vibrio cholerae, Shigella, and Staphylococcus aureus; parasites such as Giardia lamblia, Entamoeba histolytica, and Cryptosporidium may contaminate water or food. Noninfectious triggers include food poisoning toxins, antibiotic exposure, and chemical or heavy metal exposure. Early management for dehydration uses oral rehydration with sip-feeding (oralit) for mild-to-moderate cases, while rapid investigation and supportive care are essential to prevent dehydration in this multi-person event.

triage.headline_ja: ガルートの集団胃腸炎流行を振り返って、医師がウイルス感染と脱水の危険性を解説
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・ガルートで観光客を含む複数人の急性胃腸炎（感染経路・病原体未特定）が発生しているが、規模や重症度、原因病原体の詳細が不明なため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 複数の病原体候補（ノロウイルス、ロタウイルス、各種細菌・寄生虫）が挙げられているが、実際の確定診断や患者数・重症度は記事に記載がなく不明。観光客を含む集団発生であり、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Wisatawan Muntaber usai Liburan ke Garut, Dokter Ungkap Kemungkinan Penyebab dan Cara Penanganannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Travelers with gastroenteritis after a vacation in Garut, doctor reveals possible causes and how to treat it.
article.articleSummary: Travelers who developed gastroenteritis after a vacation in Garut Regency, West Java, Indonesia, are being investigated for several possible causes and dehydration risk. Gastroenteritis (muntaber) is inflammation of the digestive tract caused by infections or noninfectious factors. Viruses frequently implicated include norovirus, rotavirus (though more common in children), adenovirus, and astrovirus; transmission occurs via direct contact or contaminated food and drink. Bacterial culprits include Escherichia coli, Salmonella, Campylobacter, Vibrio cholerae, Shigella, and Staphylococcus. Parasitic infections such as Giardia lamblia, Entamoeba histolytica, and Cryptosporidium are possible. Noninfectious triggers include bacterial toxin from poor food storage. Management should be tailored to severity. Prevention emphasizes isolating affected individuals, environmental disinfection, and maintaining hygienic food practices.

triage.headline_ja: ガルートへの休暇後に観光客が胃腸炎を発症、医師が考えられる原因と対処法を解説
triage.triage_reason: 単発の観光客の胃腸炎症例であり、原因病原体も特定されておらず、集団発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 記事は一般的な胃腸炎の原因と対処法に関する啓発的な内容で、特定の集団感染やアウトブレイクの詳細（患者数、確定病原体など）が記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai Food Poisoning: नाहूरमध्ये लग्नसमारंभातील जेवणातून विषबाधा; 100 जणांना त्रास, अनेकजण रुग्णालयात, शेवटच्या पंगतीत काय घडलं?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mumbai food poisoning: Poisoning from the food at a wedding ceremony in Nahur; 100 people affected, several hospitalized, what happened at the last course?
article.articleSummary: 70-100 people affected after consuming meals at a wedding in Nahur West, Mumbai, at Nalanda Buddhist Vihar Hall on November 1. Reported symptoms include vomiting, nausea, and malaise, especially among guests who ate the last course. Immediate hospitalizations followed: 22 patients admitted to Mulund's Agrwal Hospital, four children to Kamgar Hospital, and five others to a Vikroli hospital. All patients are currently stable and under observation. Investigations are ongoing to determine the precise cause, with authorities examining whether foodborne poisoning or another factor triggered the outbreak. No laboratory confirmation has been reported yet. The incident has prompted scrutiny of the food preparation and service at the wedding venue, as investigators await test results and causal findings.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ食中毒：ナフールの結婚式の食事で中毒発生、100人が体調不良、多数が入院、最後のコースで何が起きたのか？
triage.triage_reason: 単発の結婚式での食中毒事例であり、全員安定しており国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは認められない。局地的な集団食中毒であり感染症のアウトブレイクではない。
triage.notes: 原因物質・病原体は未確認。食中毒（foodborne illness）の可能性が高く、感染症のヒト-ヒト感染リスクはないと考えられる。患者は全員安定している。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai: 70-100 Guests Fall Ill After Wedding Feast in Nahur; 31 Hospitalised, Including Bride and Groom
article.articleSummary: 70-100 wedding guests in Mumbai's Nahur West fell ill after a wedding feast on November 1, with 31 hospitalized including the bride and groom. The ceremony at Nalanda Buddha Vihar Hall drew 400-500 attendees; illnesses appeared after the final serving round between 4:00-4:30 pm, with vomiting and diarrhea starting around 11:00-11:30 pm after returning home. Of the 31 hospitalized, 22 are at MT Agarwal Hospital in Mulund, four children at Kamgar Hospital, and five others at hospitals in Vikhroli; all patients are stable. Families are demanding accountability for caterers and venue management, while the BMC and local administration monitor the situation. The exact cause is undetermined; investigators will determine whether contaminated food or handling lapses triggered suspected food poisoning. The incident highlights foodborne illness risk at large gatherings in Mumbai.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ：ナフールでの結婚式宴会後に70~100人のゲストが体調不良、新郎新婦を含む31人が入院
triage.triage_reason: 単発の食中毒疑い事案であり、人-人感染や国際的拡大のリスクはなく、原因食材による限定的な集団発生とみられる。
triage.notes: 食中毒（食品由来疾患）の疑いで、感染症の国際的拡大リスクはない。地元当局（BMC）が調査中であり、外部支援は不要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: GHS contains yellow fever outbreak after confirming four cases
article.articleSummary: Ghana Health Service (GHS) says it has contained a yellow fever outbreak after confirming four cases recorded between September and the first half of October. The four cases were detected in Sissala West, Wa West, Etu, and Nadowli-Kaleo districts, with samples sent to Dakar, Senegal, for laboratory confirmation, and results subsequently confirmed four infections. Health authorities rolled out vaccination interventions to curb further spread. Speaking on TV3 on November 1, 2026, GHS Director‑General Dr Samuel Kaba Akoriyea said the outbreak has been curtailed and vaccination campaigns are part of the response. The GHS is also probing reports of deaths in affected communities to determine if they were due to yellow fever, amid ongoing public health measures and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ保健サービス、4症例確認後に黄熱病の流行を封じ込め
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病の確定症例4件が複数地区で発生し、関連死亡例の調査も行われているため、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）に該当しフルRRAでの評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 検体はセネガル・ダカールの検査機関に送付され確定診断されたのみで、発生自体はガーナ国内（Sissala West, Wa West, Etu, Nadowli-Kaleo地区）に限定される。関連死亡例については黄熱病によるものか調査中であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ਰੈਬੀਜ਼ ਪੀੜਤ ਗਾਂ ਦਾ ਦੁੱਧ ਪੀ ਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ? ਜਾਨਲੇਵਾ ਵਾਇਰਸ ਨੂੰ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਦੂਰ ਕਰ ਲਓ ਆਪਣੀ ਉਲਝਣ - What will happen if you drink milk from a rabid cow Clear your confusion about the deadly virus | ਰੈਬੀਜ਼ ਪੀੜਤ ਗਾਂ ਦਾ ਦੁੱਧ ਪੀ ਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ? ਜਾਨਲੇਵਾ ਵਾਇਰਸ ਨੂੰ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਦੂਰ ਕਰ ਲਓ ਆਪਣੀ ਉਲਝਣ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What will happen if you drink milk from a cow afflicted with rabies? Clear your confusion about the rabies virus.
article.articleSummary: Rabies is a fatal Lyssavirus infection transmitted from animals to humans. In India, rabies cases are high due to stray dogs, though other animals can also be infected. Regarding dairy from an afflicted cow, India’s National Rabies Control Programme finds no evidence that milk from rabid cows spreads rabies, and there is no scientific proof that dairy products pose a risk. Nonetheless, safety precautions are advised and such milk is not considered completely safe to consume. The WHO likewise reports no evidence of transmission via dairy products from infected animals but recommends avoiding these products. Boiling milk or pasteurization inactivates the virus, given its heat sensitivity. Fermentation-based dairy products (e.g., yogurt, cheese) should not be viewed as substitutes for heating. For health concerns, consult a doctor.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病に感染した牛の乳を飲んだらどうなる？致命的ウイルスに関する誤解を解く
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例の報告ではなく、狂犬病に関する一般的な健康啓発・FAQ記事であり、公衆衛生上の新規事象や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の発生イベントではなく、狂犬病に関する一般的な啓発記事（乳製品からの感染可能性に関するQ&A）であり、トリアージ対象の感染症イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: La peligrosa complacencia mundial ante el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Dangerous Global Complacency in the Face of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus is driving the Ebola outbreak in northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo amid protracted conflict that has displaced millions and weakened health systems. As of October 27, 2026, there are 10,193 reported cases and 4,960 deaths. In mid‑May, the WHO and Africa CDC declared a public health emergency of international concern and a continental security issue. Unlike Zaire ebolavirus outbreaks, Bundibugyo is less common and lacks fully licensed vaccines or proven antivirals; response measures include broad-spectrum vaccines and rapid clinical testing, though containment is hampered by insecurity and limited contact-tracing reach, far short of the 95% target. Ongoing funding shortfalls threaten the response, with international support deemed insufficient. Africa CDC leads a continental plan emphasizing cross‑border surveillance, community-based containment, and African‑led leadership, urging immediate financing to stop the virus at its source.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱に対する世界の危険な油断
triage.triage_reason: DRCでPHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行（10,193症例、4,960死亡）が継続中であり、ワクチン・治療薬が限定的で国際支援も不足しているため、深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクが複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO/Africa CDCがPHEICおよび大陸規模の安全保障上の問題として宣言済み。紛争による治安悪化と資金不足が封じ込めを妨げている。

article.articleHeadline: 香港流感季已錄28宗兒童重症個案　專家倡引入第二代抗病毒藥物 - 香港文匯報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Hong Kong influenza season has recorded 28 cases of severe pediatric illness; experts advocate introducing second-generation antiviral drugs - Wen Wei Po
article.articleSummary: As of November 2, 2026, Hong Kong's influenza season, which began in late June, remains highly active. The Hong Kong Infectious Diseases Society for Children reported 28 pediatric influenza severe cases to date. Of these, 20 have recovered and discharged, 2 are stable, 4 are critically ill, and 2 have died. Early warning signs of severe disease include persistent high fever, vomiting, abdominal and chest pain; seek medical attention promptly for antiviral treatment. Oseltamivir (Tamiflu) is the main prescription, but some patients do not complete the full course and adolescents may experience adverse effects. Experts advocate the use of the second-generation antiviral baloxavir marboxil (Baloxavir), a single-dose therapy that can clear the virus in about 24 hours. Its use in crowded settings—elderly care homes, child care facilities, dormitories, and schools—could lower transmission. Government should introduce Baloxavir, and industry should consider adoption.

triage.headline_ja: 香港のインフルエンザシーズンで小児重症例が28件確認　専門家が第二世代抗ウイルス薬の導入を提言
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザではあるが、小児重症例28件（うち死亡2例）が報告され、専門家が新規抗ウイルス薬導入を政府に提言するなど社会的・行政的関心が高まっているため、フルRRAでの確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 香港は中国(1814991)に含めて集計。季節性インフルエンザの定例報告だが、重症小児例・死亡例と抗ウイルス薬導入提言という社会的関心の高まりが見られるため、経過及び治療方針の変化を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情延燒！民主剛果確診破萬、致死率破5成
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads further! Confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpass 10,000, with a case fatality rate above 50%.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to expand, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, now affecting eight provinces and 67 health zones. As of Oct 31, 2026, total confirmed cases reach 14,014 with 5,372 deaths, yielding an adjusted case fatality rate of 51.6% after Ituri province’s data recheck added 314 previously uncounted deaths; CFR rose from 48.6%. Ituri’s ~97% record reconciliation underpins the update. This marks the largest Ebola wave in DRC’s history and the second-largest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. In response to cross-border risk, the United States will tighten inbound travel requirements from Nov 3, requiring declaration that travelers have not visited DRC in the past 21 days and generally restricting those who have been there from commercial flights. Nigeria reports two suspected Adamawa state cases testing negative; the country still has 1 confirmed case.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情拡大！民主コンゴで確診1万人突破、致死率5割超
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行がDRC史上最大規模に拡大し、致死率51.6%と極めて深刻。国際的な渡航制限措置（米国）も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・アダマワ州の疑い例は検査で陰性と判明しており、確定例は1例のみで国内流行拡大の根拠は乏しい。米国・ナイジェリアは渡航制限・監視対応国であり発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Người trưởng thành bị não mô cầu tấn công, chuyên gia chỉ "lá chắn thép" cần làm ngay để phòng bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Adults infected with meningococcal disease: experts point to the 'steel shield' that must be taken immediately to prevent the disease.
article.articleSummary: Two adult deaths from meningococcal disease (Neisseria meningitidis) occurred in Song Doc Commune, Ca Mau Province, Vietnam; authorities report no confirmed link and an undetermined source. Following prior student-age cases, experts warn that meningococcal infection can kill healthy adults within hours and may spread silently via nasopharyngeal carriage. Transmission is through close contact and respiratory droplets, with crowded settings like dormitories increasing risk. Rapid progression can cause meningitis with severe headache, fever, neck stiffness, altered consciousness, purpuric rash, septic shock, and multi-organ failure. A Bach Mai Hospital case began with fatigue and chills, then fever and rash, leading to coma before recovery with timely treatment. Prevention centers on vaccination—described as a steel shield—covering serogroups A, B, C, W, Y; vaccines should be selected per age and risk. Hygiene and antibiotic prophylaxis for close contacts are advised.

triage.headline_ja: 成人が髄膜炎菌に感染、専門家が予防に必要な『鋼鉄の盾』を指摘
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・カマウ省で成人2名が髄膜炎菌感染症で死亡したが、感染源は未確定で関連性も未確認であり、大規模流行の証拠はないため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発が主旨であり、具体的な感染拡大や公的機関の対応状況についての情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: 'Banh mi' bakery owner faces proposed $3,880 fine over mass food poisoning in Vietnam
article.articleSummary: Mass poisoning in Cam Thanh Ward, Quang Ngai Province, central Vietnam linked to Ba Duoc Banh Mi Shop on Duy Tan Street. 175 people affected; first symptoms Oct 9 (abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, fever); hospitalizations Oct 10–11. Nha Trang Pasteur Institute found 12 of 13 samples positive for Salmonella spp. Owner Nguyen Van Hung faces proposed fine of 100 million VND (US$3,880) awaiting approval. Compensation session Oct 27 for all victims; around 40 objected, citing insufficient coverage for health losses and lost income; some payments completed, others pending. Authorities intensified food safety inspections; about 100 street banh mi carts in the ward. No imported/exported case details provided.

triage.headline_ja: 「バインミー」店主、ベトナムでの集団食中毒事件で約3,880ドルの罰金提案に直面
triage.triage_reason: 単一のパン店に起因するサルモネラによる食中毒事件であり、既に原因特定・行政対応(罰金・補償）が進行中。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、175名規模の集団感染であり経過観察対象とする。
triage.notes: 疾患名にTyphoid/Paratyphoidとあるが、記事内容はSalmonella spp.による食中毒（食品由来感染）であり、腸チフス菌（Salmonella Typhi/Paratyphi）との関連は明記されていない。単発の食品衛生事案であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国境を越えた拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola toll tops 5,000 as cases spread
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has killed more than 5,000 and infected over 10,000 since it was declared in May, making it the DRC’s largest Ebola outbreak and the second-largest worldwide after 2014–2016 West Africa. Cases linked to the outbreak have reached Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria; a Nigerian diagnosed case was evacuated to Geneva on Oct 26. In Europe, a French patient who contracted the virus in DRC in June recovered, with no secondary cases. The EU/EEA risk is deemed very low per ECDC (Oct 29). Ebola is caused by Bundibugyo virus; there is no approved vaccine for this strain. The incubation can reach 21 days, allowing travel before symptoms; transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of ill or dead, or contaminated materials. Early supportive care, isolation, contact tracing and infection control remain essential. Diagnostic limitations delayed recognition; May tests for Zaire Ebola virus were negative. A Bundibugyo vaccine trial began in Bunia on Oct 23, with Ervebo (Zaire strain) being tested as well.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、死者5,000人超、感染拡大続く
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行(死者5,000人超・感染者1万人超)が発生し、複数国への感染拡大と国際的な医療対応(ワクチン治験等)を要する深刻な公衆衛生事案であるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの感染拡大、スイス(ジュネーブ)・フランスへの症例輸出が報告されているが、いずれも本トリアージ対象国リストには含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。Bundibugyoウイルス株によるDRC史上最大のエボラ流行で、承認済みワクチンが存在しない点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai Food Poisoning: लग्नाच्या जेवणातून ७०-१०० जणांना विषबाधा, वधू-वरासह वऱ्हाडी रुग्णालयात दाखल; मुंबईत खळबळ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mumbai food poisoning: 70–100 people ill after wedding feast; bride and groom along with the baratis admitted to hospital; Mumbai shaken.
article.articleSummary: Food poisoning outbreak in Mumbai, India. A wedding reception in Bhandup East at the Mahabodhi Ratnavihar Hall led to illness in 70–100 guests after consuming the final course, with the incident occurring around midnight on 1–2 November 2026. The event reportedly hosted 400–500 attendees. Affected individuals were hospitalized: 22 at Agrawal Hospital, Mulund; four children at Workers Hospital, Mulund; and five patients at a hospital in Vikhroli; all are stable and receiving care. Authorities classify this as a suspected food poisoning outbreak linked to the wedding meal; no fatalities are mentioned in the report. Investigations and public health measures are underway to identify the contamination source and prevent further cases.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイの食中毒：結婚式の食事で70〜100人が発症、新郎新婦含む参列者が入院；ムンバイで騒動に
triage.triage_reason: 単一の結婚式会場での食中毒事例であり、感染症（病原体）のヒト-ヒト感染リスクは低く、国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限の懸念もない局所的な食品衛生事案である。
triage.notes: 死者なし、全員安定との報告。原因は結婚式の食事と推定され、感染症の病原体によるアウトブレイクではなく食品汚染（細菌毒素等）の可能性が高い。続報があれば原因物質を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Baru September Tercatat 54 Kasus DBD, Pemkab Bangka Selatan Waspadai Lonjakan hingga 200 Kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In September alone, 54 dengue fever cases were recorded; South Bangka Regency Government warns of a surge up to 200 cases.
article.articleSummary: South Bangka Regency, Bangka Belitung Islands, reports dengue fever (DBD) activity rising with the rainy season. As of September 2026, 54 DBD cases and 93 suspected DBD have been recorded. Officials project November 2026–February 2027 could see 200+ cases. Weather shift toward the rainy season and increased mosquito breeding habitats underlie the expected rise. Among 10 health centers, Payung reports 17 DBD cases, Air Gegas 12, Toboali 9, Batu Betumpang 8; Tanjung Labu and Tiram each 3; Air Bara 2; Rias, Simpang Rimba, Pongok report none. Suspected dengue (DD) meanwhile peaks at Simpang Rimba (37), Rias (23), Payung (15), with smaller counts at Toboali (9), Air Gegas (5), Tiram (2), Tanjung Labu and Batu Betumpang (1 each). The 5–14 age group is most affected. Authorities urge residents to check for mosquito larvae in water containers and eliminate standing water to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 9月だけでデング熱54件を記録、南バンカ県政府は200件までの急増に警戒
triage.triage_reason: 地域的なデング熱の季節的増加であり、重大な異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められないが、今後の症例急増が予測されており経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアで毎年雨季に流行する風土病であり、本記事は地方自治体レベルの注意喚起・予防啓発が主旨。重症度や死亡者数の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ituri : le manque d'eau fragilise la prévention contre Ebola sur le site des déplacés de l'ISP à Bunia | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ituri: Water shortage undermines Ebola prevention at the ISP internally displaced persons camp in Bunia | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Water shortage and absence of handwashing facilities at the ISP internally displaced persons camp in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, undermine Ebola prevention. The situation raises concerns for sanitary protection of a population living in precarious conditions. Olivier Bavi Karba, president of ADPI, says limited potable water and missing handwashing installations contribute to lax hygiene. He urges residents to maintain barrier gestures and follow health recommendations to reduce transmission, stressing prevention must continue even when moving to host neighborhoods, and that vigilance extend to host communities to prevent spread. The WHO warned in June that displacement, overcrowding, and inadequate WASH services hinder early case detection and Ebola transmission prevention, complicating response. Restoring handwashing devices, ensuring constant water and soap, and boosting community awareness are essential to improve prevention at ISP, with material support needed for vulnerable populations to implement measures.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ：水不足がブニアの国内避難民（ISP）サイトにおけるエボラ予防対策を弱体化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州の避難民キャンプにおいて、水不足・手洗い設備欠如がエボラ感染予防を阻害しているとWHOも懸念を表明しており、過密状態でのヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクと外部支援の必要性が指摘されているため。
triage.notes: 記事は新規症例数の報告ではなく、既存のエボラ流行下における避難民キャンプのWASH環境悪化と予防対策の課題に関するもの。WHOが6月に既に懸念を表明しており、継続的なリスク要因として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控：我国60岁及以上老人感染性腹泻报告发病率呈上升趋势
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC: The reported incidence rate of infectious diarrhea among elderly people aged 60 and above in China is on the rise.
article.articleSummary: China CDC Weekly reports rising infectious diarrhea incidence among adults aged 60+ from 2005–2025, with about 2.58 million cases. The incidence increased from 31.27 per 100,000 in 2005 to 91.74 per 100,000 in 2025; risk rises with age, highest in 85+ individuals. Viral pathogens predominate (Norovirus, Rotavirus); bacterial pathogens include Salmonella and Vibrio parahaemolyticus. Diarrhea occurs year-round, with peaks in July–August; cases are more common in eastern and southern coastal provinces, notably Shandong, Anhui, Zhejiang, Guangdong, and Henan. Warmer, humid environments and higher seafood consumption may boost exposure to foodborne pathogens. Norovirus—highly contagious, environmentally stable, and rapidly genetically variable—drives many elderly-care facility outbreaks. Deployment of nationwide smart infectious disease surveillance improves reporting timeliness and completeness. Recommendations: strengthen surveillance, food safety regulation, and pathogen detection, especially in summer/fall and high-incidence areas; prioritize 85+ elderly and elderly-care facility staff for interventions.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防コントロールセンター：中国の60歳以上高齢者における感染性下痢の報告発生率が上昇傾向
triage.triage_reason: 2005年から2025年までの長期的な疫学統計・サーベイランス報告であり、急性の公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国CDCによる20年間の統計分析報告であり、特定のアウトブレイクイベントを示すものではない。高齢者施設でのノロウイルス感染対策強化が推奨されているが、急性の公衆衛生危機ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Alertă privind apariția unei noi tulpini de gripă. Medicii avertizează asupra riscului unui virus periculos. Cine este mai expus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning about the emergence of a new influenza strain. Doctors warn of the risk posed by a dangerous virus. Who is most at risk.
article.articleSummary: Thousands of Scots are urged to vaccinate against influenza amid fears of a new devastating strain. Health experts warn a viral mutation could cause severe disease and even spark a new pandemic. The scenario involves influenza viruses circulating in animals and humans mixing to produce a dangerous, immune-evasion variant. Scottish scientists emphasize workers in close contact with live animals—farmers, agricultural workers, veterinarians, inspectors, animal transport drivers, and abattoir staff—face heightened risk and should receive the flu shot. The NHS in the UK provides free vaccination to vulnerable groups to reduce infection risk. The alert follows reports of a Brazilian woman’s death from swine flu in recent weeks, with additional avian influenza cases in China and Cambodia. Authorities stress animal-origin viruses rarely transmit human-to-human, but co-infection could favor a highly contagious novel variant; the risk is theoretical but being monitored.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなインフルエンザ株出現に関する警告。医師らは危険なウイルスのリスクを警告。最もリスクが高いのは誰か。
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでの豚インフルエンザ死亡例、中国・カンボジアでの鳥インフルエンザ症例に加え、英国（スコットランド）で新規変異株による将来的パンデミックリスクへの専門家警告が出ており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はスコットランド（英国、対象国外）での新型インフル変異株リスク警告だが、実際の人獣共通感染症事例としてブラジルでの豚インフルエンザ死亡例、中国での鳥インフルエンザ症例が言及されているため該当国として記録。カンボジアは対象国リスト外のため除外。理論的パンデミックリスクのため続報を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death rate exceeds 50% in DR Congo as US tightens travel restrictions
article.articleSummary: As of 2 November 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DR Congo) shows a case-fatality rate of 51.6% (5,372 deaths/10,414 confirmed infections) after mortality records in Ituri province added 314 previously unallocated deaths. The outbreak now spans eight provinces and 67 health zones, making it the largest Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and the second-largest globally. Dozens of new infections are reported daily, with transmission beyond DR Congo but limited in neighbouring countries. The United States will tighten travel restrictions, effective late 3 November 2026, requiring international travelers to attest no DR Congo visit in the preceding 21 days; those with such visits are generally barred from US-bound flights. Nigeria has intensified surveillance after a first Ebola case since 2013 (woman evacuated from Uganda on Oct 26); by 1 November two suspected Adamawa cases tested negative, and WHO later confirmed no remaining patients in Nigeria, with a potential outbreak end by 7 December if conditions are met. Africa CDC questions over $700 million in Ebola funding due to financial-record gaps.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死亡率が50%を超え、米国が渡航制限を強化
triage.triage_reason: 致死率51.6%の大規模エボラ流行がDRCで8州67保健区に拡大し、国境を越えた伝播（ナイジェリア症例）も発生、米国が渡航制限を強化するなどIHR基準を複数満たすため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリアでは疑い例が陰性でWHOが患者なしと確認したため対象国リストに含めず。米国・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。資金不足（Africa CDC）も管理可能性に影響する要素として言及。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : la riposte évaluée, de nouvelles décisions prises (Revue intra-action)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the response evaluated, new decisions taken (Intra-action Review).
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the DRC: Kisangani hosts a three-day intra-action review (October 28–30) with about 190 health actors to evaluate the Bundibugyo-strain response. The exercise aims to capitalize gains, address challenges and strengthen the response. Participants noted overall progress: reductions in cases and deaths, with some health zones reporting over 42 days without a case in Kisangani and soon in Sud Ubangi; Ituri remains the epicenter, with zones exceeding 21 days without new cases. Vaccination and post-exposure prophylaxis are to be sustained and expanded. With over 1,000 confirmed cases, the response remains fragile. Transmission chains in Bafwasende persist due to community resistance; in Beni-Mabalako and Mandima, cases rose in the past three weeks. Improvements discussed include better nutrition in treatment centers, feeding quarantined individuals, enhanced contact tracing, and stronger rural authority involvement, Haut-Uele cited as a model with village chiefs.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：対応状況を評価、新たな決定を採択（活動内レビュー）
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例1000例超、一部地域で症例増加・コミュニティの抵抗による感染連鎖継続など、依然として公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念があり、IHR基準にも複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 既知のエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）に関する活動内レビューの続報。Ituriが依然流行の中心で、Bafwasendeではコミュニティの抵抗により感染連鎖が持続、Beni-MabalakoとMandimaでは直近3週間で症例増加が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Video. Robinson: Europe doesn't 'care enough' about Congo's Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: EBOLA outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the second-largest in history, with more than 10,000 cases and at least 5,000 deaths in under six months. Mary Robinson, Ireland’s former president, urged G20 nations to release the full €3 billion pledged to contain the outbreak, stressing urgent funds to expand contact tracing and surveillance. The virus is spreading at an unprecedented pace, and resources are critical to curb transmission. Robinson criticized Europe for not giving enough attention to the lives affected, warning that the situation could become truly serious and pose risks to Europe if spread continues. The call emphasizes international accountability and rapid funding to accelerate the response in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 動画:ロビンソン氏「欧州はコンゴのエボラ流行に十分な関心を払っていない」
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行（1万例超、死者5000人以上）が6ヶ月未満で発生しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: Ireland(アイルランド)はBluedotが付与した発生地域だが、記事はロビンソン元アイルランド大統領の発言地であり発生国ではないため除外。対象国リストにIrelandは含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak surpasses 10,000 cases as international concerns grow
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 10,000 confirmed infections with 4,996 deaths as of October 28, 2026, per CDC data. The DRC accounts for 10,274 infections and 4,992 deaths; additional cases have been reported in Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria and France, making this the country’s deadliest Ebola crisis and the second-largest outbreak on record. The Bundibugyo variant lacks a licensed vaccine or approved treatment, complicating containment and raising international preparedness concerns. Incubation can reach 21 days, enabling cross-border spread before symptoms appear; transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with blood or bodily fluids. Initial tests failed to detect Bundibugyo, delaying confirmation after a Bunia healthcare worker’s death on April 24. The outbreak prompted WHO’s PHEIC declaration in May; vaccine trials are expected in 3–6 months, with emphasis on surveillance, isolation, and health-system strengthening.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生が1万人を超える感染者数に達し、国際的な懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCで1万人超・死者約5千人に達し、周辺国やフランスにも拡大、WHOがPHEICを宣言しておりIHR基準を複数満たす深刻な国際的公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランスでも症例報告があるが、対象国リストにはDRC以外含まれないため verified_locations はDRCのみとした。ワクチン未承認・治療法未確立で封じ込めが困難、WHOがPHEICを宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Pasien Ebola Terakhir Pulih, Nakes Joget Bareng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Last Ebola patient has recovered, healthcare workers dance together
article.articleSummary: On Oct 20, 2026, in Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, health workers, Médecins Sans Frontières volunteers, and Ebola survivors danced to celebrate the discharge of the last patient from the Ebola treatment center. The facility has seen at least 2,600 recoveries. Despite the milestone, the outbreak is still widespread, with government data released on Oct 20 indicating 10,000 confirmed Ebola cases nationwide. The celebration reflects local progress in patient outcomes amid ongoing Ebola transmission across the country, highlighting both the gains in recovery and the persistent public health burden in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ最後の患者が回復、医療従事者らが共に踊る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で全国10,000例の確定エボラ症例が報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と異常性の両基準を満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事自体はMongbwalu治療センターでの最後の患者退院を祝う内容だが、サマリーには全国で10,000例の確定エボラ症例が存在すると明記されており、進行中の大規模アウトブレイクであることから継続的な監視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: সাফল্য অব্যাহত, যক্ষ্মা নির্মূল অভিযানে ফের রাজ্যে প্রথম নদিয়া
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Continued success; Nadia again leads the state in the tuberculosis elimination drive.
article.articleSummary: West Bengal's Nadia district tops the state TB elimination drive under the national TB-free India initiative. This year, 18 of 185 gram panchayats were declared TB-free, up from 60 last year. Over three years, 15 panchayats have had zero new TB cases (Gold Standard); 33 panchayats with no new cases in two years (Silver Standard); and 50 with no new cases in the last year (Bronze Standard). TB treatment typically lasts six to 18 months; early improvement can lead patients to discontinue therapy, raising the risk of drug-resistant TB, so full course adherence is emphasized. About 250–350 volunteers, called Nikshay Mitra, assist with treatment and nutrition. District Magistrate Shrikant Palli notes the TB burden was 20–30 times higher two decades ago; Nadia achieved second place in 2024, first in 2025, and again leads in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 結核撲滅運動で快進撃継続、ナディア県が再び州内1位に
triage.triage_reason: 結核撲滅キャンペーンの成功を伝える前向きな行政広報記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核撲滅の成功事例報告であり、感染拡大や新規発生を示す内容ではないため、対象国としての事象発生地点には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 10 Girl Students Fall Ill as Diarrhoea Panic Spreads in Utkal University Campus
article.articleSummary: As of 2 November 2026, diarrhoea and vomiting outbreaks hit the Utkal University campus in Bhubaneswar, affecting ten female students at Ladies Hostel No.7. Reports describe severe stomach illness and persistent vomiting; one student required urgent care at a private hospital, while others remain under medical treatment. A Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation public health team arrived to assess the situation, with water contamination suspected as the primary cause. Water samples were collected from the hostel’s drinking taps and storage tanks for laboratory analysis. Authorities have implemented precautionary measures across the campus, including boiling drinking water and maintaining strict hygiene until test results confirm the source. Public health investigations are ongoing to identify the contamination origin; no fatalities are reported in the article.

triage.headline_ja: ウトカル大学キャンパスで下痢の恐怖拡大、女子学生10人が体調不良
triage.triage_reason: 大学寮内の局地的な下痢・嘔吐集団発生であり水質汚染が疑われるが、死亡者なく規模も限定的。続報（検査結果）を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 単一の大学寮に限局した水系感染疑いの集団発生。当局が水質検査中で、結果次第で評価見直しが必要。

article.articleHeadline: India makes Air Suvidha form mandatory for all international arrivals amid Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 2 November 2026, India requires all international arrivals to complete the Air Suvidha Self-Declaration Form (SDF) due to the Ebola outbreak. The online form is mandatory for Indian passport holders, OCI cardholders and foreign nationals, regardless of travel history, and must be completed before departure or within 24 hours of arrival for travelers from the UAE and other destinations, ideally during web check-in. Required documents include a valid passport, Indian visa if applicable, flight ticket or boarding pass, and the Indian address where they will stay. The declaration collects 21 days of travel history, all foreign transit stops (with an Add Transit Row option), and a mobile number and email for OTP verification. The health section asks about possible Ebola exposure and symptoms (fever, bleeding). On arrival, an Airport Port Health Officer may conduct additional screening, and authorities may share data to identify travelers needing further medical assessment.

triage.headline_ja: インド、エボラ流行を受けて全ての国際線到着者にAir Suvidhaフォームの提出を義務化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行を受けインドが全入国者に健康申告・渡航歴申告を義務化するなど水際対策を強化しており、国際的拡大懸念・渡航制限の観点から基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はインド政府の水際対策（Air Suvidha申告義務化）に関する内容であり、エボラ発生国そのものについての記述がない。発生地域としてUAE・インドが付与されているが、いずれも対象国リストの発生国としては確認できず、実際の流行発生国は記事から不明。続報でエボラ流行の発生国情報を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള വ്യാപനം തടയല്‍ ; കെനിയയിലേക്ക് യാത്രാ വിലക്കുമായി സൗദി അറേബ്യ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Curbing Ebola Transmission; Saudi Arabia Bans Travel to Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Ebola transmission risk prompts Saudi Arabia to ban travel to Kenya. Saudi authorities have temporarily suspended all visas issued to Kenyan citizens as part of phased Ebola-prevention measures guided by health experts to safeguard public health. The restriction follows ongoing efforts since May and aims to curb potential spread in the region. Previously, Saudi Arabia had barred travel by its nationals to Ebola-affected African countries Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, reflecting a broader precautionary strategy against importation of the disease. Kenya is identified within these risk-based travel controls as authorities continue to adjust measures in response to evolving outbreak dynamics.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染拡大防止のため、サウジアラビアがケニアへの渡航を禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラはIHR上重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、既に複数国で渡航制限が実施されていることから国際的拡大・貿易渡航制限の基準に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はサウジアラビアによるケニア向け渡航禁止措置を報じており、実際のエボラ発生国としてはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）、ウガンダ、南スーダンが挙げられている。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ケニア・サウジアラビア・南スーダン・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Sở Nông nghiệp và Môi trường kiểm tra công tác phòng, chống bệnh dịch tả lợn châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Agriculture and Environment inspects the implementation of measures to prevent and control African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: On 2 November 2026, the Department of Agriculture and Environment inspected Thach Binh Commune in Vietnam for African swine fever (ASF) prevention and control. From 11 June to 30 October 2026 ASF affected 32 households across 10 of 18 hamlets, causing the death and culling of 1,217 pigs, totaling 92.37 tons. The commune responded by zoning, culling infected animals, reinforcing disinfection and environmental sanitation, and conducting public education. The inspection focused on assessing the outbreak status, addressing difficulties, and proposing measures to control the disease, minimize losses, and prevent further spread. It urged strict outbreak surveillance, tighter control of all pig-keeping households, enhanced hygiene, and enforcement of prevention regulations. Officials were asked to strengthen accountability, monitoring, reporting, and public communication, with a goal to suppress outbreaks by 15 November 2026 and declare the outbreak over by 25 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 農業環境局、アフリカ豚熱の予防・制圧対策の実施状況を視察
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（アフリカ豚熱）であり人の公衆衛生への直接的影響はなく、既存の行政対応枠内で管理されているため、ヒトの感染症シグナルとしては見送り。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱は動物（豚）のみに感染する疾患でありヒトへの感染症リスクはない。地方行政レベルでの通常の防疫対応として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Jembrana Catat 88 Kasus Positif Rabies, Kini Terapkan Eliminasi Selektif Sasar Hewan Liar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jembrana Records 88 Rabies-Positive Cases, Now Implementing Selective Elimination Targeting Wild Animals
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a public health concern in Jembrana, Bali, with 88 rabies-positive animals confirmed from January–October 2026. The cases are spread across districts, led by Mendoyo (36), followed by Negara (23), Jembrana (11), Melaya (10), and Pekutatan (8). The Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Food’s Animal Husbandry and Animal Health Branch will launch selective elimination targeting unowned/stray rabies-transmitting animals, based on official community reports. The operation involves PKH working with related agencies within the Rabies Handling Response Team, including BPBD. The measure responds to reports of coastal dumping sites for stray dogs and cats. A recent rabies case involved a dog attacking two residents in Melaya; brain tissue testing confirmed rabies, triggering emergency vaccination around the site, vaccinating 21 animals (20 dogs, 1 cat). Total 2026 cases remain below 2025’s 116.

triage.headline_ja: ジェンブラナ県で狂犬病陽性88件を記録、野生動物を対象とした選択的排除を実施
triage.triage_reason: バリ島ジェンブラナ県における狂犬病は地域的に継続する動物由来感染症であり、人への重大な拡大や異常性は認められないが、野良動物への曝露が継続しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地方自治体が野良犬・猫への選択的排除とワクチン接種で対応中。2026年の症例数（88件）は2025年（116件）を下回っており、拡大傾向ではない。
