article.articleHeadline: 医药生物行业周报（10月第4周）：冬春季呼吸道传染病进入高发期
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pharmaceuticals and Biotechnology Industry Weekly (Week 4 of October): Respiratory infectious diseases in the winter-to-spring season enter a high-incidence period
article.articleSummary: China CDC reports winter–spring respiratory infections are entering a high-incidence phase. For Oct 26–30, 2026, national influenza positivity is 11.8%, with 18.0% in southern provinces and 4.9% in the north; southern influenza-like illness accounts for 4.5% of ED visits, higher than 2024–2025 yet below 2023. The circulating strains are shifting from A(H3N2) toward A(H1N1)pdm09, with H3N2 dropping from 86.9% in week 40 to 67.2% in week 43, and northern A(H1N1) comprising 68.0% of Type A viruses. For the 2026–2027 season, all three components of the trivalent vaccine have been updated, and quadrivalent vaccines are being phased out. Antigenic drift, expanded medical insurance coverage, and modest price rises may boost uptake. Southern regions show consolidating demand for influenza diagnosis/testing, while northern vaccination windows remain open. Opportunities exist in influenza vaccines and respiratory pathogen testing companies.

triage.headline_ja: 医薬・バイオ産業週報（10月第4週）：冬春季の呼吸器感染症が流行期に突入
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの流行状況に関する業界分析レポートであり、通常の季節性変動の範囲内で異常性や重症度の高い公衆衛生リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は医薬・バイオ産業向けの投資分析レポートであり、中国国内の季節性インフルエンザ（H3N2からH1N1への株シフト）の通常の疫学動向を報告したもの。公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急性を示す内容はない。

article.articleHeadline: Anthrax outbreak kills hippos in DR Congo's Virunga National Park
article.articleSummary: Anthrax (Bacillus anthracis) killed hippos in Virunga National Park, DR Congo, with 28 deaths over roughly one month in the Semuliki River area west of Virunga and near Vitshumbi, about 100 km north of Goma in North Kivu. Laboratory confirmation linked the deaths to anthrax. The outbreak occurs amid the DRC’s ongoing Ebola crisis. Hippos, ecosystem engineers, contribute to nutrient cycling; their loss threatens park ecology. Park authorities are conducting surveillance, safe carcass management, and risk reduction for nearby communities; residents are advised not to touch, skin, or eat animals found dead, and to report carcasses. Anthrax outbreaks in Virunga are linked to drought, environmental persistence of spores, and dense animal aggregations around water. The park’s February 2026 census estimated hippos at 2,700+ in 171 groups; a 2025 outbreak killed 65 hippos.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国・ヴィルンガ国立公園で炭疽菌アウトブレイクによりカバが死亡
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（カバ）における炭疽菌アウトブレイクで、現時点でヒトへの感染例は報告されていないが、周辺住民への曝露リスクが示唆されており継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は野生動物（カバ）の炭疽菌アウトブレイクが主題であり、ヒトの感染症例は報告されていない。疾患名にEbolaが含まれるが、これはDRCで進行中の別のエボラ危機への言及であり、本記事の主題ではない。過去（2025年）にも同様の炭疽菌アウトブレイクが発生しており、季節的・環境的要因（干ばつ、胞子の環境残留）によるものとされ、異常性は低い。住民への死体接触回避の呼びかけがあり、人獣共通感染症としての曝露リスクは継続している点は留意。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai wedding food scare: Newlyweds among 31 hospitalised after guests fall ill
article.articleSummary: Suspected food poisoning at a Mumbai wedding left 70–100 guests ill during the final course at Nalanda Buddha Vihar Hall in Nahur West. About 400–500 attendees were present; 31 people were hospitalised across MT Agarwal Hospital in Mulund (22), Kamgar Hospital (four children), and facilities in Vikhroli (five). The newlywed couple were among those hospitalized; all patients are stable. The incident occurred on Sunday, 1 November 2026. Authorities say the Maharashtra FDA is probing catering arrangements and food safety and storage practices, with samples being examined to determine the cause. No laboratory confirmation has been reported publicly. Families are seeking accountability and action against the caterer if violations are found. The episode highlights ongoing concerns about food safety at large gatherings.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイの結婚式で食中毒騒動：新郎新婦を含む31人がゲスト体調不良で入院
triage.triage_reason: 単発の食中毒疑い事案であり、ヒト-ヒト感染性や国際的拡大の懸念がなく、患者も安定しているため感染症シグナルとしての重要性は低い。
triage.notes: 食中毒（感染症というより食品衛生事案）であり、原因病原体の特定・ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性は報告されていない。地域はインド国内のローカル事案で、対象国ではあるが感染症シグナルとしての該当性は低いためverified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: El personal médico de un hospital de R.D. Congo baila para celebrar que el último paciente con ébola ha recibido el alta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The medical staff at a hospital in DR Congo dance to celebrate that the last Ebola patient has been discharged.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 November 2026, staff at a hospital in the Democratic Republic of the Congo celebrated the discharge of the last Ebola patient, marking zero active Ebola cases at the facility. Dressed in scrubs, healthcare workers sang and danced in a jubilant celebration captured by Aruser@s. The moment, described by program hosts as historic, follows a long outbreak, with officials noting the hospital has had no Ebola cases since the outbreak began. Some commentators recalled fears the epidemic could evolve into a global pandemic. The coverage emphasizes the emotional relief among staff and the community after this milestone. This moment marks a symbolic milestone in the fight against Ebola in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の病院の医療スタッフが、最後のエボラ患者が退院したことを祝って踊る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行の終息を示す好意的なニュースであり、新規感染拡大の兆候はないが、アウトブレイク自体の終息確認情報として経過観察の価値がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラアウトブレイクの終息（最後の患者退院）を報じる好意的な内容であり、新規リスクを示すものではない。アウトブレイクの正式終息宣言や再燃の有無について続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: मानसून के बाद भी डेंगू का खतरा! एक्सपर्ट से जानें बचाव और रिकवरी के टिप्स
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue risk persists even after the monsoon! Learn prevention and recovery tips from an expert.
article.articleSummary: Dengue risk persists after the monsoon even as the season ends, because residual humidity and standing water sustain mosquitoes. Recent dengue cases underscore the ongoing threat. Symptoms typically appear 4–10 days after infection and include sudden high fever, severe headache behind the eyes, muscle and joint pain, nausea, vomiting, and a skin rash; platelets may fall, causing weakness. Not all low platelets indicate severity, but medical evaluation with blood tests is essential. Urgent care signs include persistent abdominal pain, continuous vomiting, bleeding gums or nose, restlessness, rapid breathing, or clammy skin. Prevention focuses on eliminating mosquito breeding sites and bite avoidance: remove standing water around home (rooftops, pots, coolers); cover water tanks; wear long sleeves in parks; apply repellents. Recovery priorities are rest, hydration (boiled water, ORS, coconut water, soups), and easily digestible nutrition (khichdi, dal, greens, fruit, protein). Narayana Hospital, Gurugram, Dr. M.K. Singh emphasizes vigilance after monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン後もデング熱のリスクが続く！専門家が教える予防と回復のコツ
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定の集団感染やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の季節性リスクに関する一般的な予防・治療ガイダンスであり、具体的な集団発生や異常な流行状況の報告ではない。特定地域（グルガオン）の言及はあるが、個別アウトブレイクのデータは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Người dân Cà Mau đổ xô đi tiêm vắc-xin viêm não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ca Mau residents rush to get the meningococcal vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Ca Mau reports rising meningococcal meningitis risk as residents flood vaccination sites. Two adult deaths from meningococcal disease in Song Doc commune this year raise Ca Mau’s total to three meningococcal deaths in 2026. Ongoing clusters and fatalities in Ho Chi Minh City and other southern provinces underscore persistent transmission risk, prompting mass vaccination. Vaccination centers such as VNVC in An Xuyên and Long Châu in Tân Thành are overwhelmed, with queues over an hour and crowds spilling onto sidewalks. Vaccine options include Bexsero (Italy) for group B; Nimenrix (Belgium) and MenQuadfi (USA) for groups A, C, Y, W-135; Cuba Mengoc BC priced about 396,000 VND per dose, though some clinics push more expensive vaccines (over 1.8 million VND) citing availability. CDC Ca Mau Director Tran Hien Khoa warns crowded conditions raise airborne transmission risk, noting 10-25% of carriers are asymptomatic. Vaccines give 80-90% protection; continued hygiene, masking, and prompt medical review for fever, cough, or runny nose are advised. Complete, age-appropriate vaccination schedules are recommended since serogroups do not cross-protect.

triage.headline_ja: カマウ省住民が髄膜炎菌ワクチン接種に殺到
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・カマウ省で髄膜炎菌感染症による死亡例が増加し、住民のワクチン接種殺到という社会的関心の高まりが見られる。ヒト-ヒト感染可能性と無症候性保菌者の存在から流行しやすさも指摘される。
triage.notes: カマウ省で2026年に3人の髄膜炎菌感染症死亡例（うち2人はSong Doc地区）、ホーチミン市など南部諸省でもクラスター発生。ワクチン接種拠点が混雑し、空気感染リスクの増大が懸念されている。国際的拡大の兆候は現時点でなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola tem letalidade de 52% na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has a case fatality rate of 52% in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), declared May 15 and caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the second-largest globally (after 2014–2016 West Africa). As of Oct 30, the INRB reports 10,414 confirmed cases and 5,372 deaths, a case fatality rate of 51.6%, with the rise in deaths due to retrospective data revisions in Ituri province rather than a single-day surge. The epicenter remains Ituri, but Kenya and Uganda have reported cases as well. Nigeria is investigating two suspected Ebola cases in the northeast; these are isolated while labs confirm. Nigeria previously confirmed its first case in over a decade—a Swiss traveler who had visited Uganda—and her husband were evacuated to Switzerland. There are no approved treatments or vaccines for Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の致死率が52%に
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模・世界第2位のエボラ流行で致死率51.6%、1万例超・死者5千人超に達し、複数国への越境拡大も確認されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・スイスでの症例/渡航関連感染が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主発生地はDRC・Ituri州。承認されたBundibugyoエボラウイルスのワクチン・治療薬は存在しない点にも留意。

article.articleHeadline: Satna news: सतना में डेंगू से 29 वर्षीय युवक की मौत, सात माह की गर्भवती पत्नी भी हुई संक्रमित | 29-year-old man dies of dengue in Satna; his seven-month-pregnant wife also infected
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Satna news: A 29-year-old man dies of dengue in Satna; his seven-month-pregnant wife also infected.
article.articleSummary: Satna, Madhya Pradesh: A 29-year-old man, Rajesh Bunakar, died of dengue during treatment; his seven-month-pregnant wife, Priyanka, also tested positive for dengue. They reside in Siddharth Nagar, Ward 8, Satna, and had returned from Pune, Maharashtra, where they worked. On the 29th, all three developed fever and persistent vomiting. Priyanka was diagnosed with dengue at a Sindhi Camp nursing home in Pune and discharged after treatment. In Satna, Rajesh was first treated at a private clinic, then admitted to the district hospital (Ward 6) before being moved to a private facility due to financial constraints; his platelet count was 27,000/µL and he received a platelet transfusion. He deteriorated and died en route to Rewa for further care around 3 PM. A Malaria Department team visited his home for investigation.

triage.headline_ja: サトナ:デング熱で29歳男性死亡、妊娠7ヶ月の妻も感染
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な拡大や異常性を示す情報はなく、季節性デング熱の一例と判断される。
triage.notes: インド（マディヤ・プラデーシュ州サトナ、マハラシュトラ州プネー）における個別のデング熱死亡例。マラリア部門が調査に訪れたとあるが、集団発生や異常な流行拡大を示す情報は記事中に見られない。デング熱はインドで季節性に流行する既知の疾患であり、個別死亡例単独ではシグナルとして取り上げる根拠は弱い。

article.articleHeadline: 诸城发布关于传染病疫情线索公众报告的须知
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zhucheng Releases Guidelines for Public Reporting of Clues Related to Infectious Disease Outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Zhucheng City announces guidelines for public reporting of clues related to infectious disease outbreaks, under the PRC Infectious Disease Prevention and Control Law. The goal is early detection, reporting, and response to curb spread. Any person or organization that identifies a patient or suspected patient should promptly report to the nearest disease control center or medical facility. Reporting triggers include: (1) severe illness or death after close contact with poultry, livestock, or wildlife; (2) returnees from high-incidence countries/regions with fever, cough, rash, diarrhea, or vomiting; (3) a cluster (five or more) with similar symptoms within a week in a community, workplace, school, home, or venue; (4) abnormal events in border areas, endemic foci, or areas with active vectors or unusual animal deaths; (5) other public health risks. Channel: Zhucheng CDC 24-hour duty line 0536-6212583. Reports should be factual, confidential, protective measures taken, and individuals urged to seek formal medical care and disclose exposure history. Announcement dated October 31, 2026 (released November 2, 2026).

triage.headline_ja: 諸城市、感染症疫情の手がかりに関する公衆報告ガイドラインを発表
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症イベントの発生を報じるものではなく、行政による公衆向け通報制度の案内文であるため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な感染症の発生報告ではなく、諸城市CDCによる通報制度の周知文であるため、特定の国を発生地と認定しない。

article.articleHeadline: 51 Kasus TB Ditemukan di Kendal, Skrining Masih Berlanjut
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 51 Tuberculosis Cases Found in Kendal, Screening Is Still Underway.
article.articleSummary: On 2 November 2026 in Kendal Regency, Central Java, Indonesia, health authorities found 51 tuberculosis (TB) cases from screening 829 individuals across 110 sites as part of an active TB tracing effort. An additional 30 people began TB preventive therapy (TPT) to reduce progression risk. The effort is integrated into the Free Health Check (CKG) program conducted August–November 2026 to accelerate case finding. Desa Wonosari, Pegandon, hosted screening with 100 participants; those with TB symptoms or risk factors proceed to sputum testing and radiology as indicated. The 110th of 144 planned screening points was completed, leaving 34 sites to cover by November 2026. Officials aim to reach TB elimination in Kendal by 2030 through continued active screening and early treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ケンダル県で結核51例発見、スクリーニングは継続中
triage.triage_reason: 結核は地域の風土病であり、既存の積極的スクリーニングプログラムによる通常の症例発見活動であるため、新規性・異常性はなく国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 結核対策プログラムの一環としての通常のスクリーニング活動報告であり、新規アウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: DH announces latest situation regarding Legionnaires' disease cases
article.articleSummary: Six community-acquired Legionnaires' disease cases were reported Oct 25–31 in Hong Kong, all male, aged 48–78 (Wan Chai, Yau Tsim Mong, Southern, Sha Tin, Tai Po). No epidemiological links to prior cases; CHP is investigating potential infection sources; cases are sporadic. By Oct 31, 169 LD cases in 2026; 2025 had 167; 2024 135. Risk factors: male, over 50, smoking, immunocompromised; environmental risks include poorly maintained water systems, cooling towers, fountains, hot-water systems, whirlpool spas, hotels or ships. Legionella thrives in warm water (20–45 C) in tanks, piping, humidifiers, and home devices; infection via inhalation of aerosols. Guidance for immunocompromised: sterile or boiled water for drinking/oral care; avoid humidifiers or use sterile water; clean regularly; drain stagnant water. Public advice: hygiene, avoid smoking/alcohol, inspect and clean taps/shower outlets; 0.2 µm filters if used; quarterly tank drainage; purge outlets weekly. Smoking cessation hotline 1833 183.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生署、レジオネラ症症例に関する最新状況を発表
triage.triage_reason: 香港における散発的なレジオネラ症の通常の発生報告であり、過去数年の推移と大きく変わらず、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも見られない。
triage.notes: レジオネラ症は環境由来の非ヒト-ヒト感染症であり、症例数も過去数年（2024年135件、2025年167件、2026年169件）と大きな増加傾向はなく、公衆衛生当局による通常の監視・注意喚起の一環と判断される。香港はChina (1814991)に含めて集計。

article.articleHeadline: 感染破万、死亡超5000人！非洲爆发人类史上第二大埃博拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infections surpass 10,000; deaths surpass 5,000! Africa experiences the second-largest Ebola outbreak in human history.
article.articleSummary: Over 10,000 confirmed Ebola cases and more than 5,000 deaths have been reported in Central Africa, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak in human history after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. The epicenter is Ituri Province in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, a border region near primary forests where ongoing conflict, poor transport, and limited healthcare hinder containment. The Ebola virus, first identified in 1976 in Sudan and in the Ebola River region of DRC, transmits mainly via contact with blood, body fluids, secretions, or excreta of infected people or animals. Ebola virus disease presents with nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, fever, abdominal pain, skin changes, and bleeding; EBHF is a high-consequence pathogen. The incubation is 2–21 days (commonly 5–10), with case fatality rates reported between 50%–90%, often due to stroke, myocardial infarction, hypovolemia, or multiorgan failure.

triage.headline_ja: 感染者1万人超、死者5000人超！アフリカで人類史上2番目に大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行発生
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州を中心に感染者1万人超・死者5000人超という大規模なエボラ流行であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSudanとAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文ではDRCイトゥリ州が震源地として明記されており、両国での発生は確認できないため除外。Sudanはエボラウイルスが最初に同定された歴史的経緯の言及のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết, tay chân miệng diễn biến phức tạp tại TP.HCM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever and Hand-Foot-Mouth Disease Show Complex Developments in Ho Chi Minh City.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever and hand-foot-mouth disease are rising in Ho Chi Minh City, totaling over 86,500 cases and 16 deaths. Through Week 43, dengue exceeds 42,500 cases with 11 deaths, while hand-foot-mouth disease surpasses 44,000 cases (up over 65% year-on-year) with 5 deaths and more than 1,600 outbreaks, notably among young children. Enterovirus 71 (EV71) circulation raises risk of serious neurologic, cardiac, and respiratory complications, with outbreaks concentrated in preschools and daycare settings. The City Department of Health, in coordination with the People’s Committee of Di An ward, launched a high-intensity campaign to curb both diseases, emphasizing vector control, early case detection, environmental sanitation, and school-based surveillance. Public health messaging stresses hygiene and community involvement; vaccination is highlighted as preventive, with Vietnam’s Qdenga dengue vaccine for ages 4+, given as two doses 3 months apart.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市でデング熱と手足口病が複雑化
triage.triage_reason: 両疾患ともベトナムの既知流行パターン内であり国際的拡大リスクは低いが、症例数・死亡者数が増加しており、EV71重症化リスクや季節流行の進展を継続して注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱・手足口病ともにベトナム国内の季節性流行であり、地元保健当局が対応中。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないが、死亡者数増加とEV71による重症化リスクから経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola na República Democrática do Congo atinge cinco mil mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo hits five thousand deaths.
article.articleSummary: More than five thousand deaths from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with a case fatality rate above 51%. The current outbreak, concentrated in Ituri, is driven by Ebola Bundibugyo and is the largest and deadliest in the DRC to date. Officials note the death toll rise reflects retrospective data consolidation rather than a single-day surge, following methodological reassessment. The outbreak was declared a health emergency in May, and the global situation ranks behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. No specific treatments or vaccines exist for this strain, complicating control efforts. In Nigeria, authorities are investigating new suspected cases in the northeast with isolation and laboratory testing ongoing. Kenya and Uganda have also reported cases linked to the pathogen's circulation, maintaining international vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、死者5000人に到達
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行となり死者5000人超・致死率51%に達し、健康緊急事態宣言下にある。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダでも関連症例が報告され国際的拡大の懸念があるため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による流行でワクチン・治療薬が存在しないため制御が困難。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ・アンゴラも発生地域として挙げられているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない（DRCが主要発生国）。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya protests Saudi Arabia's travel ban over Ebola outbreak - Nairobi Law Monthly
article.articleSummary: Kenya rejects Saudi Arabia's travel ban tied to the Ebola outbreak, seeking scientific justification and a review. As of Oct 31, 2026, Kenya reports nine confirmed Ebola cases and two deaths in a single cluster linked to one imported case, with no new infections since Oct 19. Of seven patients in treatment, five have tested negative once and await a second test; discharge could occur on Nov 3 if the second result is negative. A total of 135 contacts have been traced; the first group completed 21-day quarantine on Oct 26, with 46 remaining due to leave on Nov 3 if symptom-free. Saudi Arabia has barred its citizens from Kenya, suspended visas, and barred entry for anyone who has been in the past 21 days. The WHO deems restrictions inappropriate; risk outside DRC and neighbours is low. Kenya seeks Africa CDC involvement and a technical briefing.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ流行をめぐるサウジアラビアの渡航禁止に抗議 - Nairobi Law Monthly
triage.triage_reason: エボラ感染者・死者が確認され、サウジアラビアによる渡航制限という国際的な貿易・渡航制限措置が発生しており、ケニア政府がAfrica CDCの関与を求めるなど社会的・政治的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアで確認されたエボラクラスター（輸入症例由来、9例・死亡2例）とそれに対するサウジアラビアの渡航禁止措置である。DRCは『DRC and neighbours以外ではリスクが低い』というWHO評価の文脈で言及されているのみで、DRC国内での具体的な発生状況は記載されていないため、対象国として含めていない。ケニア・サウジアラビアは対象国リストに含まれないため、結果としてverified_locationsは空となる。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Warns Residents After Anthrax Kills Virunga Hippos | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: Anthrax killed hippos along the Semuliki River near Virunga National Park in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, after joint analyses by ICCN and Virunga Doctors confirmed anthrax as the cause. A Sept. 29 North Kivu directorate notice set out a response protocol. Al Jazeera, in a Nov. 2 account, cited about 28 hippos deaths in roughly a month; earlier, Oct. 2 estimates put carcasses around 20. Virunga’s February 2026 census counted the hippo population at over 2,700 across 171 groups, with 153 calves; the park previously reported 65 hippos killed in 2025. FAO reported 52 dead hippos and seven buffaloes by April 18, 2025. People are urged not to touch, cut, bury or burn carcasses, avoid water near them, and keep children, livestock and pets away, since infection can occur from handling infected animals or meat. Monitoring will continue with partners; further guidance may follow.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、炭疽病でヴィルンガのカバが死亡し住民に警告
triage.triage_reason: ヴィルンガ国立公園でカバの炭疽死が相次ぎ住民への注意喚起が出されているが、人への感染例は報告されておらず、情報不足のため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 動物（カバ）における炭疽の集団死事例。人への感染例は現時点で報告されていないが、死骸との接触によるリスクについて住民に注意喚起が出されている。2025年にも同様の事例があり、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: 小港五金賣場發生2例本土登革熱群聚　高雄衛生局籲有足跡者主動採檢追蹤
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two locally transmitted dengue fever cases form a cluster at Xiaogang Hardware Market; Kaohsiung Department of Health urges those with exposure history to undergo testing and contact tracing.
article.articleSummary: Two locally transmitted dengue fever cases form a cluster at the Xiaogang 99 Hardware Market in Kaohsiung City. Both cases are market service staff living in Gangnan and Ganghou villages in Xiaogang District, with no recent international travel. The first case developed fever, poor appetite, myalgia, headache and diarrhea on Oct 30; NS1 rapid testing and PCR confirmed dengue virus serotype 2. The second case, a coworker, became ill Oct 31; rapid test positive and PCR confirmed dengue type 2. A total of 61 samples from cohabitants, market staff, customers and nearby residents have been collected. An environmental check found a mosquito breeding source behind the market, raising transmission risk. Authorities will implement triad measures—epidemiologic investigation, larviciding spraying, and environmental cleanup—within a 400-meter radius. People who visited Oct 17–Nov 2 should test on Nov 3–4 at the Xiaogang Market or local clinics. National dengue figures: 16 locally acquired, 218 imported; main sources Vietnam (16), Philippines (8), Indonesia (4), Malaysia/Thailand (3 each).

triage.headline_ja: 小港五金売場で本土感染デング熱2例がクラスターを形成、高雄市衛生局が訪問歴のある人に自主検査を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市の市場で本土感染デング熱2例のクラスターが発生し、蚊の発生源も確認されたが、現時点では小規模で管理可能な範囲にとどまっており、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。記事はベトナム・フィリピン・インドネシア・マレーシア・タイを輸入症例の由来国として言及しているが、これらの国での発生イベントではないため除外。地方自治体レベルで対応中（疫学調査、殺虫剤散布、環境清掃）であり、蚊媒介感染症の季節的・局地的発生と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Mắc não mô cầu có cơ hội hồi phục khi được điều trị sớm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal meningitis has a chance of recovery when treated early.
article.articleSummary: Neisseria meningitidis group B meningitis in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, with a child from Binh Duong province discharged after about two weeks of antibiotic therapy, leaving no sequelae. Early care for fever and headache enabled prompt CSF testing and laboratory confirmation; treatment in the Pediatric Infectious Diseases ward proceeded smoothly. Since the outbreak, two cases have been treated at Ho Chi Minh City’s Hospital for Tropical Diseases, with three major pediatric hospitals—Children’s Hospital No. 1, No. 2, and City Children’s Hospital—on standby to manage suspected or confirmed cases. In October 2026, a cluster at Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước commune comprised four group B meningitis cases, with one death from fulminant septic shock; another student in Thường Tân commune was diagnosed on October 21. Authorities urge vaccination, hygiene, and rapid medical evaluation; parents should seek urgent care for high fever with severe headache, vomiting, neck stiffness, drowsiness, or rash, and avoid self-medication. Close-contact prophylaxis as advised by health authorities is recommended.

triage.headline_ja: 早期治療で回復の可能性がある髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市とビンズオン省で学校クラスター（4例、1死亡）を含む髄膜炎菌（B群）感染が報告されており、重症例（劇症型敗血症性ショックによる死亡）と予想外の集団発生という2つのIHR基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: Bluedotの疾患名は『Classical Swine Fever（豚コレラ）』と誤タグ付けされているが、記事本文は人のNeisseria meningitidis（髄膜炎菌）B群による髄膜炎クラスターに関するものであり、動物疾患ではない点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: 院士专家齐聚广州科普流感：把握黄金48小时 重视疫苗接种
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Academicians and experts gather in Guangzhou for influenza science popularization: seize the golden 48 hours and emphasize vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Nov 1, 2026 World Influenza Day events in Guangzhou highlight influenza prevention amid autumn–winter circulation. At Guangzhou Laboratory, experts from the Guangzhou Laboratory Science and Technology Association, National Key Laboratory of Respiratory Diseases, Guangzhou Respiratory Health Institute, and Guangdong Society of Respiration and Health discussed distinguishing influenza from the common cold and emphasized the 'golden 48 hours' for antiviral treatment, advocating 'early discovery, early diagnosis, early treatment.' Academician Gao Fu of the Chinese Academy of Sciences noted annual updates to vaccine components as circulating strains shift, with vaccination particularly recommended for the elderly, pregnant women, people with chronic diseases, healthcare workers, and children to reduce severe illness and death. Professor Li Tongzeng of Beijing You’an Hospital, Capital Medical University, highlighted vaccination benefits. The event launched the book World Influenza Day: Academician Dialogue and hosted an influenza science carnival, with domestic and international experts addressing avian influenza control, advanced molecular diagnostics, and broad-spectrum vaccine development to enhance respiratory disease prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 院士専門家が広州に集結しインフルエンザ啓発：ゴールデン48時間の把握とワクチン接種の重視を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は世界インフルエンザデーに関する科学啓発イベントの報道であり、具体的な感染拡大や異常事態を報じるものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザに関する啓発・科学普及イベントであり、具体的な感染事例や鳥インフルエンザのアウトブレイクに関する報告ではない。疾患名に鳥インフルエンザが含まれるが、本文はワクチン接種啓発が主題。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄小港2例本土登革熱群聚　市府籲有足跡者採檢
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two locally transmitted dengue fever cases form a cluster in Xiaogang District, Kaohsiung; city government urges those with exposure history to get tested.
article.articleSummary: Two locally acquired dengue fever cases linked to a hardware megastore in Xiaogang District, Kaohsiung, form a cluster. Both store employees, with no recent international travel, reside in Gangnan and Ganghou neighborhoods. The first case developed fever on Oct 30; NS1 rapid test and PCR confirmed dengue serotype 2. The second case became symptomatic Oct 31 and was PCR-confirmed after rapid testing. Epidemiology indicates a store-based cluster; 61 specimens from co-workers, household members, customers, and surrounding community are under testing. An environmental survey found a larval breeding source behind the store, signaling potential spread risk. Authorities urge anyone who entered the store between Oct 17 and Nov 2 to get tested during Nov 3–4. Nationally, 16 local dengue and 218 imported cases to date; Kaohsiung reports 12 local and 38 imported cases, with infections mainly from Vietnam (16), the Philippines (8), Indonesia (4), Malaysia and Thailand (3 each).

triage.headline_ja: 高雄小港区で本土感染のデング熱2例がクラスターを形成、市政府が立ち寄り者に検査を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市内のホームセンターを起点とした小規模なデング熱クラスターであり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念も限定的であるため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾（高雄市小港区）でのデング熱クラスター発生に関するもので、台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。ベトナム・フィリピン・インドネシア・マレーシア・タイは輸入症例の感染由来国として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生事例ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Anthrax Outbreak Kills Hippos in DR Congo's Virunga National Park
article.articleSummary: Anthrax outbreak has killed at least 28 hippos in the Semuliki River within Virunga National Park in eastern DR Congo, authorities confirmed on 2 November 2026. Deaths have been detected over the past four weeks; laboratory tests identified Bacillus anthracis as the cause. The event compounds existing wildlife threats amid the region’s Ebola outbreak, described as the deadliest in the country’s history. Humans can contract anthrax through contact with infected carcasses or by consuming contaminated meat. Park authorities urge caution and close monitoring. A One Health response is urged, combining conservation with public health measures: enhanced epidemiological surveillance, better protection for local communities, proper carcass management, and increased collaboration among state, non-state and para-state actors. Residents are advised to avoid contact with dead animals and report suspected cases to contain the outbreak and protect wildlife and public health.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのヴィルンガ国立公園で炭疽菌アウトブレイクによりカバが死亡
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（カバ）における炭疽菌アウトブレイクでヒトへの感染はまだ確認されていないが、エボラ流行地域と重なり、人獣共通感染症としてヒトへの感染リスクがあるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 現時点で人間の感染症例は報告されていないが、死骸や汚染肉との接触により感染リスクがあり、One Healthアプローチでの対応が呼びかけられている。同地域では歴史上最悪とされるエボラ流行も同時進行中であり、公衆衛生リソースへの負荷が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄小港五金賣場爆發登革熱群聚 8里警戒、明後天設站採檢
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Cluster Outbreak at Kaohsiung Xiaogang Hardware Market; Eight Neighborhoods Under Alert, Testing Stations to Be Set Up Tomorrow and the Day After
article.articleSummary: Two locally acquired dengue fever cases linked to Kaohsiung Xiaogang District's 99 Hardware Market have been PCR-confirmed as dengue fever type 2. Both cases are market employees with no recent international travel; residences are in Gangnan Li and Ganghou Li. Eight Li in Xiaogang District are designated dengue alert zones around the market. Health authorities will set up testing stations at the market and nearby clinics on November 3–4 for individuals who visited the market from October 17 to November 2. Investigations found unsanitary conditions behind the market with a mosquito larva breeding site-positive evidence, signaling potential spread in surrounding areas. A total of 61 people have been sampled so far; results are pending. Nationwide counts as of 2026-11-02: 16 locally acquired and 218 imported dengue cases; Kaohsiung: 12 local and 38 imported; sources include Vietnam, the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Thailand.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄小港五金売場でデング熱クラスター発生、8里が警戒区域に、明後日に検査ステーション設置
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市で局地的なデング熱クラスター発生が確認されたが、症例数は少なく重症度・国際拡大の情報もないため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsには該当なし。ただし記事本文は台湾（高雄）の事例であり、中国への分類は不適切な可能性があるため注意。ベトナム・フィリピン・インドネシア・タイは輸入症例の由来国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreads to Nigeria after killing over 5,000 people in DR Congo as officials race to stop the virus
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) since May 2026 has killed over 5,000 and infected more than 10,300 across eight provinces, with a 48.6% fatality rate. Ituri Province remains hardest hit amid armed conflict complicating containment. The virus has crossed borders to Kenya and Uganda, with Nigeria reporting two suspected cases—one confirmed in October and flown to Switzerland for treatment. WHO Africa warns that stopping the outbreak requires scaled-up control measures, greater access to affected areas, and community outreach. Testing and patient care continue, alongside vaccine clinical trials, but there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo. Health workers have faced violence, including killings and injuries, hindering response. Context from DR Congo’s 2018–2020 outbreak (2,299 deaths) and the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (11,325 deaths) is noted. Symptoms include fever, weakness, vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and bleeding; transmission via bodily fluids, not airborne. Europe risk remains very low per ECDC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で5000人以上が死亡したエボラ出血熱がナイジェリアに拡大、当局がウイルス封じ込めに奔走
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当し、WHO Africaも緊急対応を呼びかけている大規模アウトブレイクであるため、フルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア、スイスへの拡大も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主な発生地・主題国。

article.articleHeadline: 7歲女童染甲流併發嚴重肺炎　留醫廣華PICU情況嚴重
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 7-year-old girl with H1N1 influenza complicated by severe pneumonia; admitted to Guanghua PICU in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: An otherwise healthy 7-year-old girl in Hong Kong is in critical condition with influenza A (H1N1) complicated by severe pneumonia, admitted to Guanghua Hospital's Pediatric Intensive Care Unit. She had not traveled during the incubation period and had not received the seasonal flu vaccine. Household contacts recently presented with fever and mild upper respiratory symptoms and have since recovered. On Oct 27 she developed fever, cough, and fatigue, first seeking care at a private clinic; by Oct 29 she was admitted to Guanghua Hospital and, due to respiratory deterioration, transferred to the PICU. Respiratory testing confirmed Influenza A (H1N1). The Hong Kong Centre for Health Protection notes the flu season began in late June and remains above baseline activity. Across the season, 29 pediatric severe influenza cases have been recorded: 20 recovered, 2 stable, 1 severe, 4 critical, and 2 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 7歳女児がA型インフルエンザ(H1N1)に感染し重症肺炎を併発、広華病院PICUに入院、危機的状況
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)による重症小児例だが、香港では流行期として既知のパターンであり、IHR基準の該当は確認できない。重症度・流行継続性の観点から監視継続が妥当。
triage.notes: 香港衛生防護中心（CHP）は季節性インフルエンザの流行を6月下旬から継続的に監視しており、今季の小児重症例は29例（うち死亡2例）。今回の事例は個別の重症化例であり、特段の異常性（新型株・院内感染拡大等）は記事内で示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышку сибирской язвы зафиксировали в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anthrax outbreak recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax outbreak confirmed in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo's Virunga National Park, with 28 hippopotamuses killed in the past month. Laboratory analyses identified Bacillus anthracis as the cause. Park experts attribute the surge to drought and soil-spore persistence; hippos grazing low and congregating near shrinking waters heighten exposure, threatening the regional aquatic ecosystem. Ongoing armed conflict has hampered park control, with rangers disposing of carcasses and warning residents to avoid dead animals and meat due to high human transmission risk. The situation unfolds amid a severe Ebola outbreak in the DRC, which has surpassed 10,000 infections and roughly 5,000 deaths. Public health and conservation authorities urge caution, surveillance, and avoidance of contact with affected carcasses. As of 2 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で炭疽病の発生が確認される
triage.triage_reason: ヴィルンガ国立公園でカバ28頭が炭疽により死亡し、人への感染リスクが警告されているほか、武装紛争により対策が妨げられており、WPRO基準の複数該当と行政・国際支援の必要性が認められるためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 記事は主にヴィルンガ国立公園での炭疽病によるカバの大量死と人への感染リスクを報じており、同時進行中のエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（感染者1万人超）は背景情報として言及されているのみで、本件の主要シグナルは炭疽病の動物-人共通感染リスクである。武装紛争により公園管理当局の対応能力が制限されている点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: México reconhece regionalização para Newcastle e limita restrições a SC | Band
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico recognizes regionalization for Newcastle disease and limits restrictions on Santa Catarina | Band
article.articleSummary: Mexico officially recognizes sanitary regionalization for Newcastle disease in Brazil, limiting import restrictions to Santa Catarina state where outbreaks were identified. The move allows other Brazilian regions to ship chicken meat, offal, and fertile eggs to Mexico without restrictions, representing a shift from countrywide controls to zone-based status. The decision preserves trade flows for Brazilian exporters and reduces broad embargoes previously triggered by isolated notifications of Newcastle disease. MAPA (Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Food Supply) and the Brazilian productive sector influenced the adjustment, highlighting rapid epidemiological surveillance. The Associação Brasileira de Proteína Animal (ABPA) welcomes the measure as a recognition of Brazil's Official Veterinary Service credibility and transparency. Brazil intends to continue expanding regionalization with trade partners to stabilize operations and minimize impacts on international supply chains.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ニューカッスル病の地域区分を認め、サンタカタリーナ州への制限を限定
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（ニューカッスル病）に関する貿易規制緩和の報道であり、ヒトの公衆衛生リスクはなく、既に収束方向にある貿易措置のニュースのため見送り。
triage.notes: 動物衛生（家禽）に関する貿易規制の話題であり、ヒト感染症のシグナルではない。メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 美華盛頓州爆高致病性H5N1　港暫停進口禽類產品
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Washington state reports outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1; Hong Kong suspends imports of poultry products.
article.articleSummary: Washington state reports outbreak of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza H5N1 in Kittitas County, triggering international notification to the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE). In Hong Kong, the Food Safety Centre of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department immediately instructed the industry to suspend imports of poultry meat and poultry products, including eggs, from the region to safeguard public health. Hong Kong authorities are in contact with US officials and will monitor OIE updates to respond to the evolving outbreak. In the first nine months of this year, Hong Kong imported approximately 33,270 tonnes of chilled/frozen poultry meat and about 92.33 million eggs from the United States.

triage.headline_ja: 米ワシントン州で高病原性H5N1の発生、香港が家禽製品の輸入を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: 発生自体は対象国リストに含まれない米国ワシントン州の家禽における動物衛生事案であり、ヒト感染例の報告はない。香港は輸入停止という貿易対応を行っているのみで、疾病発生国ではない。
triage.notes: 本事案は米国ワシントン州の家禽（鳥）におけるHPAI H5N1発生に伴い、香港当局が家禽製品の輸入を一時停止した貿易上の対応に関する記事。発生地域として記載されている香港・中国は実際の疾病発生国ではなく、輸入停止措置を取った側であるため、対象国リストには含めない。米国は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。ヒトへの感染報告は記事中に見られない。

article.articleHeadline: 7歲女童確診甲型流感併發嚴重肺炎　情況嚴重
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 7-year-old girl diagnosed with influenza A complicated by severe pneumonia; serious condition.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection reports a 7-year-old girl in serious condition with influenza A complicated by severe pneumonia. The previously healthy child developed fever, cough and fatigue on October 27, sought private care, and was admitted to Kwong Wah Hospital on October 29 before being transferred to the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit as respiratory distress worsened. Laboratory tests confirmed Influenza A(H1). No travel during the incubation period; the patient had not received the seasonal influenza vaccine. Household contacts recently had fever and mild upper respiratory symptoms and have recovered. Across the current flu season in Hong Kong, 29 pediatric severe influenza cases have been recorded: 20 recovered/discharged, 2 stable, 1 serious, 4 critical, and 2 deaths. Authorities urge vaccination and continue the ongoing investigation into the case.

triage.headline_ja: 7歳女児が甲型インフルエンザと診断され、重症肺炎を併発。容体は深刻
triage.triage_reason: 香港で季節性インフルエンザA(H1)による小児重症例が報告されているが、今季29例中の1例であり、季節性インフルエンザの典型的流行パターン内の事例と見られるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 香港衛生防護中心（CHP）が今季29件の小児重症インフルエンザ症例（うち死亡2例）を記録しており、季節性インフルエンザの監視対象事例。渡航歴なし、未接種。家庭内接触者は軽症で回復済み。国際的拡大や異常なクラスターの兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Смертность от Эболы превысила 50%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The mortality rate from Ebola exceeded 50%.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak that began in May in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has infected 10,414 people and caused 5,372 deaths, a case fatality rate of 51.6%, according to Bloomberg citing the country’s Ministry of Health. Officials say this is the deadliest and most extensive Ebola outbreak in the DRC’s history. Most cases and deaths are in Ituri Province, though confirmed infections have also been reported in Uganda, Kenya, and France, indicating cross-border and international involvement. The epicenter remains Ituri, reflecting concentrated transmission in that region. The figures underscore the outbreak’s severity and scale, with ongoing spread within the DRC and linked international cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の致死率が50%を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模・最悪の致死率（51.6%）のエボラアウトブレイクが発生し、ウガンダ・ケニア・フランスへの国際的拡大も報告されており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・フランスでの確認感染が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。致死率51.6%・感染者1万人超という規模はDRC史上最悪のエボラ流行とされ、国際的拡大が既に発生している点で緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果爆發伊波拉疫情　無國界醫生提供心理健康支援
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo; Doctors Without Borders provides mental health support.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is amid its most severe Ebola outbreak in about six months. As of Oct 25, 2026, the Ministry of Health reports more than 10,060 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and at least 4,887 deaths. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) has treated over 4,159 patients and continues to deliver mental-health support. In Butembo, isolation wards feature transparent barriers, with families allowed in a safe visiting area to support loved ones at the bedside; Zawadi Kasoki describes the emotional toll of accompanying her husband Victor, whose test alternated from negative to positive before he recovered after 23 days. MSF psychologist Patrice Muyisa Kokotz notes that companionship reduces stress and fear. Survivors in Ituri’s Mongbwalu can access ongoing support via survivor clinics, including individual and group therapy led by Phoebe Zueya Yonkeu, addressing stigma and post-discharge challenges.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が流行、国境なき医師団がメンタルヘルス支援を提供
triage.triage_reason: DRCで10,000例超・死者4,887名という大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 致死率約48.6%と非常に高く、過去6か月で最も深刻な流行とされる。MSFなど国際機関が介入しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限の有無については記事内に情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: 7歲女童染流感併發嚴重肺炎　情况嚴重 (18:14) - 20261102
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 7-year-old girl with influenza complicated by severe pneumonia; serious condition (18:14) - 20261102
article.articleSummary: On 2 November 2026, the Centre for Health Protection (CHP) reported a pediatric severe influenza case in Hong Kong: a previously healthy 7-year-old girl tested positive for Influenza A(H1) and is diagnosed with influenza complicated by severe pneumonia, currently in critical condition in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit at Kwong Wah Hospital. Her illness began October 27 with fever, cough, and fatigue; following care at a private clinic, she was admitted October 29 and transferred to PICU due to respiratory distress. CHP preliminary investigation found no travel during incubation; she had not received the seasonal flu vaccine. Household contacts recently had fever and mild upper respiratory symptoms but recovered. CHP Director Xu Lok-kin noted the flu season has persisted for four months with activity above baseline. This season, 29 pediatric severe influenza cases have been recorded: 20 recovered, 2 stable, 1 serious, 4 critical, 2 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 7歳女児がインフルエンザに感染し重症肺炎を併発、重篤な状態
triage.triage_reason: 香港における季節性インフルエンザ（H1）の小児重症例報告であり、季節的流行の一環として続いているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、通常の公衆衛生監視対象の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1)による小児重症例。香港では今季すでに29例の小児重症インフルエンザが報告されており（うち死亡2例）、季節性流行の継続状況としての経過観察が妥当。香港はChinaに統合して計上。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Tanzania e Zanzibar chiedono una dichiarazione di salute
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Tanzania and Zanzibar request a health declaration.
article.articleSummary: Tanzania and Zanzibar require a new free health declaration to curb Ebola spread, aligning with recent U.S. measures. Effective 30 October, the declaration applies to all travelers entering continental Tanzania from any point (including via Dar es Salaam and Kilimanjaro airports) and includes travelers from Zanzibar. The form can be completed online on the official site or upon arrival. Zanzibar also requires a health declaration for travelers arriving from or transit through the Democratic Republic of the Congo (epicenter of the ongoing Ebola outbreak), Uganda, and Kenya. The measure supplements existing visa and government insurance (NIC). In 2025, Tanzania attracted about 2.3 million international visitors, with over 650,000 visiting Zanzibar, per the Tanzanian central bank.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：タンザニアとザンザルバルが健康申告を要求
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱流行（進行中のアウトブレイク）を受け、近隣国が渡航者に対する健康申告制度を導入しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで進行中のエボラ流行を発生源とし、タンザニア・ザンザルバルが渡航者向け健康申告制度を導入したという内容。実際の感染発生国はDRCであり、タンザニア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Sud-Kivu : plus de 2 millions d'enfants ciblés par une campagne de vaccination contre la poliomyélite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Kivu: More than 2 million children targeted by a polio vaccination campaign.
article.articleSummary: Poliomyelitis vaccination campaign targets over 2 million children (0-59 months) in South Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, from 12 to 14 November 2026 across all 34 health zones. The provincial health division reports two polio cases in Kitutu health zone, Mwenga territory, prompting urgent vaccination. Poliomyelitis symptoms described: sudden onset of limb weakness in children aged 0-15 years. The campaign aims to vaccinate about 2.3 million children to curb rapid virus spread. As of 2 November 2026, DRC has reported 111 polio cases in 9 provinces since the start of 2026. No infection source or lab confirmation details provided. The effort underscores rapid response necessity and invites parental participation during the campaign.

triage.headline_ja: 南キブ州：200万人以上の子どもを対象としたポリオワクチン接種キャンペーン
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2026年に111例のポリオ症例が9州で報告されており、南キブ州でも新規症例が確認されたため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: DRC全体で2026年初から111例のポリオ症例が9州で報告されており、南キブ州Mwenga準州Kitutu保健地区で新規2例確認。ワクチン未接種地域での急速な拡大防止のため緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施される。ウイルス株（野生株/VDPV）の詳細や検査室確認情報は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Anthrax outbreak kills hippos in DR Congo's Virunga National Park
article.articleSummary: Anthrax outbreak in Virunga National Park, DR Congo, caused the death of about 28 hippopotamuses in the Semuliki River over four weeks starting mid-September, with Bacillus anthracis laboratory-confirmed. The February 2026 census estimated over 2,700 hippos across 171 groups. The outbreak compounds regional health crises and underscores ecosystem risk, as hippos influence nutrient cycles and aquatic habitats. Park authorities have deployed surveillance, safe carcass management, and community education; residents are instructed to avoid contact with carcasses and report suspected cases. Anthrax spores can persist in soil for decades; dry periods concentrate herbivores near water and grazing sites, increasing exposure. A 2025 outbreak killed 65 hippos; recurring events are attributed to persistence, ecological stress, climate factors, and surveillance gaps, worsened by decades of armed conflict. Calls for One Health approaches, integrated surveillance, protection, carcass handling, and inter-agency collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国ヴィルンガ国立公園で炭疽病が発生、カバが死亡
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（カバ）の炭疽死亡が中心で現時点でヒト感染の報告はないが、死体接触によるヒトへの感染リスクや繰り返し発生する生態学的要因があり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は主に野生動物（カバ）の死亡と生態系への影響を扱っており、ヒトへの感染事例は報告されていない。ただし炭疽菌は人獣共通感染症であり、死体管理や地域住民の曝露リスクが指摘されているため経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết Hà Nội: 550 ca mắc, thêm 12 ổ dịch mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever in Hanoi: 550 cases reported, 12 new outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Hanoi reported 550 cases in the week of Oct 23–30, 2026 across 97 wards/communes, with 12 new outbreaks. Hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) added 175 cases across 79 wards/communes, with 3 new outbreaks. Year-to-date, Hanoi has 5,839 dengue cases in 121 wards/communes with no deaths and 241 outbreaks (28 active); HFMD totals 6,572 cases in 126 wards/communes with no deaths and 102 outbreaks (3 active). Public health actions include enhanced surveillance, zone-based outbreak investigations in 9 wards this week and 11 planned next week, and a focus on HFMD prevention in preschools, environmental cleaning, and cross-sector coordination with animal health. Residents are advised to take preventive measures and maintain routine vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイのデング熱：550例報告、新たな発生12件
triage.triage_reason: ハノイでのデング熱・手足口病の季節的な流行拡大だが、死亡例なく重症度も不明で、例年の流行パターンの範囲内とみられるため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 死亡例なし、地元保健当局が監視・対応を継続中。例年の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられ、国際的な拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Import of poultry meat and products from Kittitas County of State of Washington in US suspended
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-02, the Centre for Food Safety (CFS) of Hong Kong suspended imports of poultry meat and products, including poultry eggs, from Kittitas County, Washington State, US, following a WOAH notification of a highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza outbreak in the area. The measure is immediate to protect public health in Hong Kong. The CFS noted that HK imported about 33,270 tonnes of chilled and frozen poultry meat and about 92.33 million poultry eggs from the United States in the first nine months of 2026. The CFS has contacted US authorities and will closely monitor WOAH updates and actions by relevant authorities, taking appropriate steps as the situation develops. The report does not provide case counts or laboratory confirmation details.

triage.notes: 発生国は米国ワシントン州であり対象国リストに含まれない。香港（中国）は輸入停止措置の実施主体であり、発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。人への感染事例の報告はなく、家禽に関する貿易上の措置に関する記事。

article.articleHeadline: Bé gái 27 tháng tuổi nguy kịch vì biến chứng sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 27-month-old girl in critical condition due to dengue fever complications
article.articleSummary: 27-month-old girl from Thanh Hóa, Vietnam, with dengue fever developed fulminant myocarditis and cardiogenic shock, saved after nearly five weeks on VA-ECMO at Ho Chi Minh City Children's Hospital. NS1-positive dengue; within 12 hours she deteriorated to respiratory failure and shock requiring resuscitation. Echocardiography showed EF down to 28–30%, then 24–26%, indicating severe systolic dysfunction. Diagnosed with dengue-associated fulminant myocarditis and liver injury; transferred to ICU. VA-ECMO support with ventilation, inotropes, and multi-organ supportive care; eight sessions of continuous dialysis were required. After ~5 weeks, cardiac function improved (EF 48–52%), blood pressure stabilized; weaning from ECMO and ventilation followed. After ~2 months, sinus rhythm returned, liver and kidney function recovered, urine output improved. This is a rare dengue-related fulminant myocarditis case; parents urged to seek early care for warning signs. Local dengue activity: week of Oct 19–25 had 1,785 cases; year-to-date 42,515; Con Dao, Ngai Giao, Minh Thanh high incidence.

triage.headline_ja: 生後27ヶ月の女児、デング熱合併症により重体
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はベトナムで流行している既知の感染症であり、本記事は一症例の重症化（劇症型心筋炎）を報告する個別症例報告に過ぎず、国際的な異常事態やアウトブレイクの兆候は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Կոնգոյում էբոլայից մահվան դեպքերի թիվը գերազանցել է 5370-ը
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the Ebola death toll has exceeded 5,370.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-02, the Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak has a death toll of 5,372 with a case fatality rate of 51.6%. Official data cited by Reuters indicate 10,414 confirmed Ebola infections across 26 provinces, making it the country’s deadliest outbreak to date. The rise in fatalities follows a retrospective data revision rather than a new daily surge, underscoring reporting challenges in affected regions. Ebola cases have also been reported in Kenya and Nigeria, while Uganda has had no new cases since August, suggesting regional variability. The report highlights a sustained, high-mortality outbreak that continues to strain health services and requires ongoing international and local public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラによる死者数が5,370人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪のエボラ流行（死者5,372人、致死率51.6%、26州に拡大）が継続しており、ケニア・ナイジェリアでも症例が報告されるなど国際的拡大の懸念がある。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアでの症例報告、ウガンダは8月以降新規症例なしとされるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le taux de létalité dépasse les 50 %, avec 5 372 décès recensés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: the case fatality rate exceeds 50%, with 5,372 deaths recorded.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) shows a case fatality rate of 51.6%, with 5,372 deaths and 10,414 confirmed cases reported. The figures come from the INRB situation bulletin released Sunday, noting that the rise in deaths results from a retrospective data update conducted jointly by the local information-management team and the outbreak-response team in Ituri province. Authorities emphasize this was not a sudden daily spike, but a correction of previously reported data. The updated tallies underscore the ongoing severity of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC, with Ituri province as a focal point of the response. As of the end of October, these are the latest published counts guiding public health actions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がDRCで致死率50%超、死者5,372人を記録
triage.triage_reason: 致死率51.6%、死者5,372人、確定例10,414件という大規模かつ深刻なエボラアウトブレイクであり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当する。
triage.notes: 死者数の増加は遡及的なデータ更新によるものであり、急激な日次増加ではない点に留意。Ituri州が対応の焦点地域。

article.articleHeadline: DRC officials confirm 28 hippos killed by anthrax - Earthnews365
article.articleSummary: Twenty-eight hippopotamuses died of Bacillus anthracis (anthrax) along the Semuliki River on the western edge of Virunga National Park in eastern North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo. Laboratory tests confirmed the cause on Monday, 2026-11-02. Conservation organisations, including the Congolese Institute for the Conservation of Nature (ICCN), urged locals near the Virunga National Park and the Semuliki River not to touch, skin, or consume any dead animals. Anthrax can spread from infected animals to humans in the DRC, though it is not transmitted from person to person. Carcasses were found bobbing at the river, indicating an environmental outbreak affecting wildlife in the area.

triage.headline_ja: DRC当局、カバ28頭が炭疽で死亡したことを確認 - Earthnews365
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（カバ28頭）の炭疽死亡が確認されたが、現時点で人間感染例の報告はなく、局地的な環境アウトブレイクに留まる。人獣共通感染症リスクがあるため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 現時点では野生動物（カバ）の大量死事例であり、人間への感染報告はない。ICCNが地域住民に死骸への接触を避けるよう警告しており、人獣共通感染のリスクがあるため経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Seven-year-old girl in serious condition with influenza A
article.articleSummary: Seven-year-old girl in Hong Kong is in serious condition with influenza A (H1) after fever, cough and fatigue on 27 October. She was admitted to Kwong Wah Hospital on 29 October and transferred to the paediatric ICU for breathing difficulties. Laboratory testing confirmed influenza A (H1) with severe pneumonia. She had not traveled during incubation and had not received a seasonal influenza vaccine; household contacts had fever and mild upper respiratory symptoms and recovered without hospital care. As of 2 November 2026, the influenza season in Hong Kong—began in late June and remains active—records 29 severe paediatric cases: 20 discharged, 2 stable, 1 serious, 4 critical and 2 deaths. Vaccination remains the best protection; immunity wanes after about nine months, underpinning WHO's annual recommendation. The 2026/27 programme began 17 September, with the School Outreach Programme; about 1,660 schools have hosted sessions, with completion expected by mid-December.

triage.headline_ja: 香港で7歳女児がインフルエンザA型により重篤な状態に
triage.triage_reason: 香港の季節性インフルエンザ（H1亜型）流行の一環であり、個別重症例はあるものの、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、既存のワクチン接種プログラムで対応中の通常の季節性疾患動向である。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1)による重症小児例の報告。香港の2026/27年シーズンにおける29例の重症小児例の一つで、既にワクチン接種プログラム（学校アウトリーチ含む）が進行中。季節性サーベイランス情報としての性質が強く、新規性・異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola update, AI math scoop and permanent daylight saving time
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) driven by Bundibugyo virus has surpassed 10,000 cases since May, with nearly half resulting in death, making it the fastest Ebola outbreak on record. By day 187 of the outbreak, confirmed cases reached 10,060, compared with day 186 of the West Africa epidemic (2014–2016) when only 544 cases were reported; the West Africa outbreak ultimately endured over two years with 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths. The current surge is compounded by limited case tracking and care delivery: about half of deaths occur among people never admitted to treatment centers; roughly 80% of new cases arise from unknown sources, indicating substantial transmission from undetected cases. Distrust of authorities complicates response, including a nurse killed during field work. On the vaccine front, Tumaini trials began with the first participant vaccinated; Bundibugyo-specific inoculations are in development.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ最新情報、AI数学のスクープ、そして通年夏時間について
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるブンディブギョウイルス型エボラのアウトブレイクが発生187日目で症例10,060人に達し、致死率約50%と史上最速の拡大ペースであり、未検出感染経路が8割を占めるなど深刻かつ異常な公衆衛生事象であるため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリー内にAngolaに関する具体的言及がないため除外した。西アフリカ流行（2014-2016）との比較が本文で用いられているが、これは過去の参照事例であり発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Satna Man Dies Of Dengue Infection, Seven-Month Pregnant Wife Also Tests Positive
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Satna, Madhya Pradesh, threatens a 29-year-old man, Rajesh Bunkar, who died after testing positive; his seven-month-pregnant wife Priyanka also tested positive. Rajesh's platelet count reportedly fell to 27,000. Dengue was confirmed at Day Care Pathology Centre in Sindhi Camp after Rajesh developed fever and vomiting on returning Oct 29 from Pune, where he worked as a labourer with Priyanka and his younger brother. Rajesh was admitted to Ward No. 6 at District Hospital, then shifted to Pushpanjali Hospital on Oct 31; a platelet transfusion was given on Nov 1, but he died en route to Rewa. Priyanka was admitted to Hansraj Hospital and discharged on Nov 1 after dengue treatment. The official cause of Rajesh's death remains unconfirmed. Following the death, health officials launched insecticide spraying and a local survey in Siddharth Nagar; a malaria department team was deployed to the area to investigate potential cases.

triage.headline_ja: サトナ在住の男性、デング熱感染で死亡 妊娠7ヶ月の妻も陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: インド・マディヤプラデーシュ州サトナでの個別のデング熱死亡事例であり、地域的な流行拡大の兆候は明確ではないが、保健当局が調査・殺虫剤散布を開始しており動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで季節性に発生する既知の媒介性疾患であり、本件は個別症例（死亡1例、陽性1例）の報道。地域保健当局が殺虫剤散布・調査・マラリア部門チーム派遣を実施しており、他の感染例の有無など続報を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 5,370.
article.articleSummary: Death toll from Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 5,372, with a mortality rate of 51.6%. Ebola virus disease has been confirmed in 10,414 people in the DRC, with transmission spanning 26 provinces, making this the most deadly outbreak in the country to date. The apparent surge in deaths reflects a recalculation of data rather than a sudden daily increase in new cases. Internationally, Ebola cases have also been reported in Kenya and Nigeria. In Uganda, no new cases have been recorded since August. These figures come from official data cited by Reuters via Armenpress. As of 2 November 2026, health authorities are monitoring cross-border spread and the expanding provincial footprint within the DRC.

triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は死者5,372人・致死率51.6%・26州に拡大し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大も報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当するため。

article.articleHeadline: SAPA backs continued poultry imports from Brazil after NCD outbreak
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease (NCD) outbreak in Santa Catarina, Brazil, prompts a targeted safeguarding approach instead of a countrywide import ban on Brazil’s poultry. SAPA backs the Department of Agriculture's decision to allow continued imports under conditional certification, provided Santa Catarina’s export status remains restricted and Brazil complies with veterinary requirements. The DoA's 28 October statement sets rules to permit trade: fresh poultry meat may be exported only from premises with no NCD cases in the prior six months and within a 10 km radius; abattoirs and cutting plants must be outside infected zones. Hatching eggs and day-old chicks must come from farms outside infected zones and be disease-free for 12 months. SA imports about 18,000 tonnes of poultry meat from Brazil monthly; Santa Catarina-specific restrictions are emphasized, not a nationwide ban. Vaccination underpins SA’s protection against NCD, while avian influenza remains the main future risk.

triage.headline_ja: SAPA、ニューカッスル病発生後もブラジル産鶏肉の輸入継続を支持

triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州での家禽ニューカッスル病発生に伴う南アフリカの輸入規制対応に関するもので、ヒト感染症としての公衆衛生リスクは記載されていない。疾患名リストに鳥インフルエンザが含まれるが、記事内容はNCDに関するものでAIとは別件。

article.articleHeadline: 世界流感日｜多病原同时活跃：法维拉韦的"广谱"价值在哪
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Influenza Day | Multiple pathogens active simultaneously: What is Favipiravir's 'broad-spectrum' value?
article.articleSummary: World Influenza Day on 2026-11-01 occurs amid simultaneous activity of multiple respiratory pathogens in autumn–winter. China CDC Week 43 data show influenza-like illness samples with influenza positivity at 14.7% (down from 15.4%), still leading pathogens; rhinovirus 11.7%; other pathogens including parainfluenza and enteroviruses detected. In China, southern provinces report mid-level influenza activity while northern provinces remain low; dominant strains are influenza A(H3N2) (67.2% of influenza A) and B/Victoria lineage. Early symptoms—fever, sore throat, dry cough, myalgia—overlap across viruses, complicating rapid diagnosis. Given the 48-hour treatment window and delayed confirmation, broad-spectrum antivirals have value; favipiravir (RNA-dependent RNA polymerase inhibitor) is a core option in the 2025 influenza treatment guidelines and has activity against other RNA viruses (e.g., coronaviruses, bunyaviruses, hantaviruses, rhinoviruses). Emphasizes vaccination (2–4 weeks for antibodies), continued precautions, and early medical care if symptoms arise.

triage.headline_ja: 世界インフルエンザデー｜複数病原体が同時活発化：ファビピラビルの『広域スペクトル』価値はどこに
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常のサーベイランス報告であり、異常な増加や重症化、新規変異株の出現は確認されず、啓発・治療薬紹介の性質が強い記事のため。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H3N2優勢）の定点観測データに基づく一般向け啓発記事であり、陽性率も前週比で減少傾向。新規変異株や異常な流行拡大の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Izbruh antraksa, ki se lahko prenese na ljudi: poginilo že 28 povodnih konjev
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anthrax outbreak that can be transmitted to humans: 28 hippos have already died.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax outbreak in Virunga National Park, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, has killed 28 semiaquatic hippos in about a month along the Semuliki River. Laboratory confirmation identifies Bacillus anthracis as the cause; humans can be infected via contact with carcasses or consumption of meat. Authorities are increasing surveillance, ensuring safe removal of carcasses, and urging nearby residents not to touch or eat affected animals. The park, home to over 2,700 hippos in 171 groups, saw 65 hippos die from anthrax in 2025. Recurrent outbreaks are linked to drought, with stressed herbivores congregating near scarce forage and water, enabling soil-borne spores to persist for decades. The crisis coincides with a severe Ebola outbreak in the DRC (over 5,000 deaths) and ongoing armed conflict, highlighting the need for a One Health approach to strengthen epidemiological monitoring, prevention, and cross-sector collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: 人間にも感染しうる炭疽菌の発生：カバ28頭が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のヴィルンガ国立公園でカバの炭疽菌感染による大量死が続いているが、人間の感染例は報告されておらず、再発性の事象であるため現時点ではスクリーニング基準の一部のみ該当し情報不足。続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本件は動物(カバ)の炭疽菌による大量死が主題で、人間への感染例は報告されていない。2025年にも同様のアウトブレイク（65頭死亡）があり再発性の事象。同国内で進行中のエボラ流行（5000人以上死亡）は背景情報として言及されているが、本記事の主題ではない。One Healthアプローチの必要性が強調されている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Demam Lebih dari Tiga Hari, Warga Bangka Selatan Bakal Jalani Pemeriksaan Rapid DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever for more than three days, South Bangka residents will undergo rapid dengue fever testing.
article.articleSummary: South Bangka Regency, Bangka Belitung Islands, Indonesia, reports dengue fever activity. Residents with fever longer than three days are advised to undergo rapid dengue fever (DBD) testing at Puskesmas health centers to confirm the cause and enable timely management. A health official notes rapid DBD screening targets patients with persistent fever to distinguish dengue from other illnesses. Data from ten Puskesmas show the highest DBD counts at Payung Health Center (17), followed by Air Gegas (12) and Toboali (9); Batu Betumpang (8); Tanjung Labu and Tiram (3 each); Air Bara (2); Rias, Simpang Rimba, and Pongok reported no DBD cases. Dengue fever (DD) cases are led by Simpang Rimba (37), Rias (23), Payung (15), then Toboali (9) and Air Gegas (5); smaller counts elsewhere, with some centers reporting zero. Emphasis on 3M Plus preventive measures to reduce mosquito breeding by draining, closing water containers, and reusing discarded items to prevent larval habitats.

triage.headline_ja: 3日以上の発熱、南バンカ住民はDBD迅速検査を受けることに
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア南バンカ県における地域的なデング熱の通常の流行状況を報じる内容で、公衆衛生対応も通常の保健所レベルの対応であり、国際的拡大や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアの季節性風土病であり、本記事は地域保健所レベルでの通常の監視・検査推奨活動を報じたもの。重症度や死亡者数の記載はなく、特段の異常事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Entenda quais são os principais sintomas de Mpox e saiba quando procurar atendimento médico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understand the main symptoms of Mpox and know when to seek medical care.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (formerly monkeypox) in Brazil emphasizes early recognition to limit transmission and guide care. Incubation is 3–21 days after exposure, with initial fever and malaise followed by skin lesions that evolve from flat macules to vesicles and then crusts. Lesions may appear on the face, palms, soles, mouth, and genital region. Suspected cases should consult an infectious disease specialist or general clinician; diagnosis is confirmed by PCR testing of material from lesion crusts or secretions; if no rash, samples can be taken from the throat or anal area. Treatment focuses on symptom relief and preventing complications: analgesics and antipyretics, warm compresses or baths, ocular care if involved, and keeping lesions clean and dry during isolation. The article notes ongoing public health surveillance in Brazil and does not report case counts or travel-related cases. Published 2 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: Mpoxの主な症状とは？医療機関を受診すべきタイミングを理解する
triage.triage_reason: 症状や受診目安に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、新規症例数・アウトブレイク情報・異常性の記載がないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は症状解説・一般啓発情報であり、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの報告はない。ブラジルでの継続的な公衆衛生監視に言及しているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: MG registra 33 casos de Mpox; novo caso foi confirmado neste fim de semana - Sim Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais records 33 Mpox cases; a new case was confirmed this weekend - Sim News.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) cases in Minas Gerais, Brazil reach 33 in 2026, with Confins, a city in the Belo Horizonte metropolitan area, reporting its first confirmed case on Oct 31, 2026. Most affected individuals are aged 15–34. A new case was confirmed this weekend. Symptoms include skin lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, body pains, chills, and fatigue; incubation ranges from 3 to 16 days, up to 21 days. Diagnosis is via PCR testing of lesion samples. Transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, and contaminated objects, and can involve saliva and sexual contact. Prevention emphasizes avoiding contact with suspected or confirmed cases, isolation during the infectious period, PPE for caregivers, avoiding shared personal items, and diligent hand hygiene. Suspected cases should seek care at a Basic Health Unit (UBS) and inform about potential exposure.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州でMpox症例33件を記録、今週末に新規症例確認 - Sim Notícias
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内での既知の地域流行拡大(33例)であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の兆候はないが、継続的な症例増加のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: Mpox Clade不明。地域限定の症例増加であり、既存の公衆衛生対応内で管理可能とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Five overlooked steps to identify new epidemics, fast
article.articleSummary: Five overlooked steps to identify new epidemics, fast article argues that early detection remains hard as novel pathogens present atypical symptoms. Outbreaks discussed include the Ebola epidemic in Africa, the ongoing global threats from COVID-19, mpox, hantavirus; SARS-CoV-2 in 2020 had fever and respiratory distress, mpox 2022 in Europe and North America featured genital/anal sores, Nipah virus circulating in Bangladesh and India showing brain inflammation or breathing difficulties. Surveillance currently relies on event-based tracking, genomic sequencing, and syndromic surveillance, but atypical presentations can delay recognition. The authors propose five steps forming a symptom-preparedness loop: flag clusters of unusual cases using reporting procedures and DHIS2; use AI to flag atypical cases; adopt tiered case definitions (suspected/probable/confirmed) updated regularly. Tech tools include DHIS2 and centralized AI systems; aim to speed frontline alerts and public-health response.

triage.headline_ja: 新興感染症を迅速に特定するための、見過ごされがちな5つのステップ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は特定の新規アウトブレイクを報告するものではなく、過去の感染症事例（エボラ、COVID-19、mpox、ニパウイルス等）を引用しながら、早期探知手法の改善を論じる総説・提言記事であるため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はNature誌の学術的な論説記事であり、具体的な新規アウトブレイク事例の報告ではない。インド・バングラデシュにおけるニパウイルスへの言及は過去の事例紹介であり、新規イベントの発生報告ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 與男子敦倫惹猴痘　33歲漢需隔離治療
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox linked to sex with a man; 33-year-old man requires isolation and treatment.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox in Hong Kong: a 33-year-old man is in isolation at North District Hospital, stable, after high-risk sexual contact with a man during the incubation period in Hong Kong. The Centre for Health Protection is conducting epidemiological investigation and will report to WHO. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 118 monkeypox cases: 92 locally acquired, 25 imported, and 1 under investigation; all patients have been male. Among 25 local cases since August, all reported high-risk sexual activity during incubation, including sex with strangers or multiple partners and unprotected sex, with most not vaccinated against monkeypox. Local cases since August show frequent use of dating apps to find male partners; some patients could not contact new partners post-diagnosis, hindering contact tracing. CHP has intensified monkeypox prevention on social media and, through dating-app operators, regularly pushes prevention and vaccination information to all Hong Kong users.

triage.headline_ja: 男性との性行為で猴痘感染、33歳男性が隔離治療へ
triage.triage_reason: 香港での単発の猴痘症例で、2022年以降続く性的接触ネットワークを介した国内流行の一部であり、特段新規性や重症度の高まりは見られないが、人-人感染（性的接触）が継続している点は要観察。
triage.notes: 香港は2022年以降118例の猴痘症例を記録しており、本症例はその延長線上にある局所的な性的接触を介した感染拡大の一例。新規性や重症度の急変は認められず、公的機関（衛生防護センター）も通常の疫学調査・WHO報告手続きを実施中。インド（Sikkim/North District）への言及は記事内になく、対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: Confins confirma primeiro caso de mpox; Minas soma 33 em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confins confirms first mpox case; Minas Gerais totals 33 in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Confins confirms its first mpox case on Saturday Oct 31, announced by the Municipal Health Secretariat, with patient details not disclosed. In Minas Gerais, 33 mpox cases have been confirmed in 2026, per SES-MG. Historically, 2022 had the most cases (610), followed by 2025 (136), 2024 (68), and 2023 (53). Most state cases involve men aged 15–34. The circulating virus is clade II, subclade IIb, linked to the global outbreak that began in 2022. Records are sporadic and under control, with ongoing epidemiological monitoring. Common symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pains, chills, weakness, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions that can appear on the face, hands, feet, mouth, and genital/anal regions. Transmission is mainly by direct contact with lesions, secretions or fluids; indirect contact via contaminated objects; and prolonged close contact, including respiratory secretions. Suspected cases should seek a Basic Health Unit, report contacts, and isolate until the transmission period ends. Treatment is supportive; vaccination targets high-risk groups including people living with HIV/AIDS, the immunosuppressed, lab workers at biosafety level 2, and those exposed to case fluids.

triage.headline_ja: コンフィンスで初のエムポックス症例確認、ミナスジェライス州の2026年累計は33例に
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州での散発的なmpox症例報告であり、既知のクレードIIbによる管理下の流行で、2022年と比べ規模も縮小傾向にあるため新規シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列。既知の2022年由来クレードIIbによる散発例で、当局により監視下にある。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue no DF: chegada das chuvas acende alerta para risco de aumento dos casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue in the Federal District: Arrival of rains raises alert for risk of an increase in cases
article.articleSummary: Dengue in the Federal District, Brazil, enters high transmission risk as rains arrive. Through Oct 24, 2026, 12,130 suspected dengue cases were notified; 11,107 met case definitions, including 3,652 probable and 231 confirmed, with 16 showing warning signs; no deaths or severe dengue reported to week 42. Laboratory surveillance shows circulation of DENV-1, DENV-2, and DENV-3, with DENV-3 predominating. The Sudoeste Health Region records the most probable cases (913), followed by Leste (608) and Oeste (564); however, incidence per 100,000 people is highest in Leste (164.2), then Sul (142.3) and Oeste (133). The rains combined with high temperatures accelerate Aedes aegypti development, increasing seasonal transmission. Preventive focus includes vector control and public health surveillance; Ceilândia, Samambaia, Taguatinga, Sol Nascente, Planaltina highlighted for environmental risk. Vaccination targets 10-14-year-olds with two doses (90-day interval); parents must present ID and vaccination card. Those previously infected should wait six months before starting vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦区のデング熱：雨季の到来で症例増加リスクへの警戒が高まる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル連邦区でデング熱の季節的増加リスクが指摘されているが、重症例・死亡例は報告されておらず、既知の季節的流行パターンの範囲内であるため、通常のサーベイランス情報として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年季節的に流行する既知の疾患であり、現時点で死亡例・重症例の報告はない。公衆衛生当局によるワクチン接種推進や媒介蚊対策など通常の予防活動の一環として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Tragedija u Brazilu: Četvoromesečna beba preminula od meningitisa, 36 osoba dobilo preventivnu terapiju
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tragedy in Brazil: A four-month-old infant died of meningitis, 36 people received prophylactic treatment.
article.articleSummary: Four-month-old infant died in Pouso Alegre, Minas Gerais, Brazil, from confirmed meningococcal meningitis serogroup C. The child was unvaccinated. After confirmation, health authorities traced 36 close contacts (family members and healthcare workers) and provided prophylactic treatment to curb transmission. Meningococcal meningitis is a serious bacterial infection causing inflammation of the brain and spinal cord membranes and can progress rapidly, potentially fatal within hours. In infants, symptoms may be nonspecific—irritability, drowsiness, and poor feeding—while older individuals experience fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, vomiting, and altered consciousness. Authorities promote vaccination, part of Brazil’s national immunization program, offered free through the public SUS. Emphasis is placed on adhering to vaccination schedules and seeking prompt medical evaluation for suspected meningitis to prevent severe outcomes or further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの悲劇：生後4ヶ月の乳児が髄膜炎で死亡、36人が予防的治療を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 単発の乳児死亡例で接触者への予防対応は取られているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念は現時点でなく、散発事例としてWATCHに留める。
triage.notes: 単一の死亡例であり、保健当局が接触者36人に予防投薬を実施済み。地域的アウトブレイクの兆候はなく、ブラジル国内の既存ワクチンプログラムの枠組みで対応されている。

article.articleHeadline: Aligarh News Today|Aligarh Latest News|Aligarh TB News|TB Awareness Program Aligarh | Aligarh News: एक्स्ट्रा पल्मोनरी और बच्चों में टीबी पर सीएमई आयोजित
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aligarh News Today|Aligarh Latest News|Aligarh TB News|TB Awareness Program Aligarh | Aligarh News: CME organized on TB in extrapulmonary and pediatric populations.
article.articleSummary: Aligarh hosted a CME workshop on extrapulmonary and pediatric tuberculosis under the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP) via Project Shakti, run by HLFPPT. The event emphasized identification of extrapulmonary TB and pediatric TB beyond the lungs, including TB of the brain, bones, glands, and abdomen, with symptoms such as prolonged fever, poor weight gain, fatigue, decreased appetite, and lumps in the neck or elsewhere in children. National Technical Expert Dr. Kishore Reddy outlined diagnostic challenges and provided guidance for timely investigations and effective management. District TB Officer Dinesh Kumar Khatri stressed that TB elimination requires addressing extrapulmonary and pediatric TB in addition to pulmonary disease. Project Shakti described ongoing TB and HIV prevention, community screening, and linking patients to quality services, and called for stronger government-private sector coordination, regular surveillance, and universal notification. Attendees, including senior health officials, reaffirmed rapid case identification, accurate diagnosis, and public awareness.

triage.headline_ja: アリーガルでTB啓発プログラム開催|アリーガルニュース：肺外結核および小児結核に関するCME開催
triage.triage_reason: 国家結核撲滅プログラムの一環として実施された教育・啓発イベント（CMEワークショップ）であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。
