article.articleHeadline: Confins entra no mapa da Mpox e amplia contagem de infectados em Minas Gerais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confins enters the Mpox map and increases the number of infections in Minas Gerais.
article.articleSummary: Confins in the Metropolitan Region of Belo Horizonte confirmed its first mpox case, bringing Minas Gerais to dozens of confirmed infections. The municipality's public health announcement notes most cases occur in young adults. Preventive guidance includes heightened community alerts; watch for skin lesions and other clinical signs. Symptoms commonly include skin eruptions, swollen lymph nodes, chills, and generalized body pains, with an incubation period ranging from several days to up to three weeks. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected secretions or skin lesions; mpox virus is closely related to smallpox. Health authorities urge early diagnosis to curb spread and advise against self-medication; seek care at a basic health unit. The state health department and public network remain vigilant to identify new clusters and support diagnosed patients.

triage.headline_ja: コンフィンス市がMpox発生地図に加わり、ミナスジェライス州の感染者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の既知流行の地域拡大を示す地方ニュースであり、重症度や国際的拡大の情報はないが、地域内での感染継続を示唆するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 既存の国内流行（ミナスジェライス州）の新規自治体への拡大報告。重症例や死亡者数の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola fatality rate in DR Congo tops 50% as death toll reaches 5,372
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain reports 5,372 deaths and 10,414 confirmed cases as of Oct 30, with a case fatality rate of 51.6%. The elevated death toll reflects retrospective adjustments between the Ituri Province outbreak management team and the local data processing unit, not a single-day surge. Declared mid-May, the outbreak has strained health authorities as they manage an infection pattern lacking a vaccine or specific antiviral; care is largely supportive based on symptoms. The Africa CDC notes about 80% of new cases originate from outside the monitored contact chain, indicating many transmissions occur from unknown chains. Cases have also been recorded in Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria, signaling cross-border spread beyond the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ致死率が50%を超え、死者数は5,372人に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率51.6%の大規模エボラ流行で、感染経路不明の症例が多く周辺国への越境拡大も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアでも症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。DRCが主たる発生地であり対象国リストに該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Anakan Sapi di Jembrana Terinfeksi Rabies, Dinas Pertanian Ungkap Penyebabnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Calf in Jembrana Infected with Rabies, Department of Agriculture Reveals the Cause
article.articleSummary: Rabies infected a three-month-old calf in Pangyangan Village, Pekutatan District, Jembrana, Bali. The case was reported October 27, 2026; veterinary officers observed behavioral changes, excessive drooling, altered eye appearance, and aggression before the animal jumped into a nearby river and died. Brain tissue collected October 28 was tested at Balai Besar Veteriner, with results announced November 2, 2026, confirming rabies. The Department of Agriculture suspects transmission from stray dogs in the coastal Pangyangan area, where unowned dogs and dumped puppies are common near fish ponds and a cremation site. Rabies can affect cattle, though cattle are not considered a persistent reservoir; transmission occurs via saliva, usually through bites. As of November 2026, Jembrana records 88 rabies cases in animals (dogs, cats, and cattle).

triage.headline_ja: ジェンバラナの子牛が狂犬病に感染、農業局が原因を説明
triage.triage_reason: バリ島ジェンバラナで野良犬由来とみられる動物(牛)の狂犬病症例が確認されたが、人への感染報告はなく、地域の風土病的流行の一環と見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本件は動物(牛)の狂犬病症例であり、人への感染は報告されていない。ジェンバラナでは年間88件の動物狂犬病症例が確認されており、野良犬対策が課題となっている。

article.articleHeadline: 本港新增一宗猴痘個案涉及33歲男子｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong reports a new monkeypox case involving a 33-year-old man | METROHK.com.hk
article.articleSummary: As of 2 November 2026, Hong Kong reports a new monkeypox case: a 33-year-old man admitted to North District Hospital in isolation, stable condition. Lab confirmation by the Centre for Health Protection’s Public Health Laboratory Service. Symptom onset on 21 October with genital lesions, fever, and a rash spreading to the chest and limbs; high-risk male-to-male contact in Hong Kong during incubation. Epidemiological investigations continue, with case to be reported to the WHO. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 118 monkeypox cases: 92 locally acquired, 25 imported, 1 under investigation—all male. From August to present, all 25 local cases involved high-risk sexual activity, many using dating apps; some unable to contact new partners for tracing. Vaccination efforts: since 28 September, extra clinics have vaccinated 792 high-risk individuals; two-dose vaccination reduces infection by 82% and limits viral spread by 87%. Hotline 2125 2373 operates 9:00–18:00. Symptoms include fever, rash, lymphadenopathy, fatigue, myalgia, and severe headache; seek medical care promptly and avoid contact with lesions or body fluids.

triage.headline_ja: 香港で猴痘（Mpox）の新規症例1件、33歳男性が関連
triage.triage_reason: 香港では2022年以降118例の猴痘症例が継続報告されており、本件はその延長線上の単発症例（安定状態）であり新規の公衆衛生上の重大性は認められないが、MSMコミュニティ内での継続的な感染拡大（接触追跡困難）がみられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 香港衛生防護中心（CHP）は既に監視体制・ワクチン接種プログラムを実施中であり、本症例はWHOへの報告対象となる既知の流行パターンの一部。新規の重大シグナルというよりも継続モニタリング案件と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Kasindi : deux centres d'isolement ouverts à la frontière ougandaise, quinze jours après l'alerte du médecin chef de zone
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kasindi: two isolation centers opened at the Ugandan border, fifteen days after the alert from the zone's chief medical officer.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola isolation centers are now operational in Kasindi, the DRC–Uganda border town in North Kivu, at Lubiriha and La Frontière centers. Supported by a three‑day WHO mission, the facilities are essential first‑line triage points for suspected cases, not treatment centers, and aim to identify and refer patients to prevent transmission. The move follows a October 19 alert by Mutwanga health zone chief Germain Kamaliro, who noted Kasindi lacked a transit or treatment center; Kasindi had nine cases (four deaths) and five isolated, while Mutwanga reported 31 positives across seven of 21 health areas, with imported cases driving local transmission. By October 25, North Kivu logged over 2,309 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,293 deaths (~56% CFR). On October 28, 48 health professionals formed two rapid response teams, and three tonnes of IPC inputs were distributed. Bundibugyo vaccine trials began in Bunia (Oct 23); Kisangani hosted an intra-action review (Oct 31).

triage.headline_ja: カシンディ：ゾーン主任医師の警告から15日後、ウガンダ国境に2つの隔離センターが開設
triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州で確認症例2,309件・死亡1,293件（致死率約56%）の進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクがウガンダ国境の町カシンディに拡大しており、WHOの介入や緊急対応チームの編成がなされている重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダは国境地帯として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。北キブ州における既存の大規模エボラアウトブレイクの一環であり、継続的な監視と国際支援（WHO介入、ワクチン治験等）が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: 6名年齡介乎48至78歲的男子感染退伍軍人病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six men aged 48 to 78 have contracted veteran's disease.
article.articleSummary: Six men aged 48–78 in Hong Kong contracted veteran's disease. The Centre for Health Protection reported six community-acquired cases between 25 and 31 October. Four patients have chronic illnesses, and one is a long-term smoker. Epidemiological investigations are ongoing; preliminary data indicate sporadic cases with no evidence of transmission links to earlier Hong Kong cases. As of 31 October 2026, 169 veteran's disease cases have been recorded this year, compared with 167 in 2025 and 135 in 2024. The update highlights continued surveillance of the situation, with authorities pursuing further epidemiological insights about sources and transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 48歳から78歳の男性6名がレジオネラ症（在郷軍人病）に感染
triage.triage_reason: 香港で散発的なレジオネラ症6例が報告されたが、ヒト-ヒト感染のエビデンスはなく例年並みの発生数であり、現時点で深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: レジオネラ症は環境由来感染症でヒト-ヒト感染は通常起こらない。香港衛生当局が通常の監視活動として報告しており、症例数も過去数年と大きな差異はない。香港はChina(1814991)に含めてverified_locationsとした。

article.articleHeadline: 美國華盛頓州爆發禽流感　食安中心指示暫停進口禽肉禽類產品
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza outbreak in Washington State, USA; Food Safety Center orders suspension of imports of poultry meat and poultry products.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 has been reported in Kittitas County, Washington State, United States. The World Organisation for Animal Health was notified, and the Hong Kong Food Safety Centre immediately instructed the industry to suspend imports of poultry meat and poultry products, including eggs, from the affected area. The Centre is coordinating with U.S. authorities and will monitor updates from the OIE and relevant agencies to respond as the local situation develops. There is no specific information on human cases, case counts, deaths, or clinical symptoms in the article. In Hong Kong, data show that in the first nine months of 2026, imports from the United States reached about 33,270 metric tons of frozen and chilled poultry meat and about 92.33 million eggs, reflecting ongoing trade links with the U.S. poultry sector.

triage.headline_ja: 米国ワシントン州で鳥インフルエンザ発生、食品安全センターが食用鳥類・鳥肉製品の輸入停止を指示
triage.triage_reason: 発生地は米国ワシントン州であり対象国ではない。香港は輸入停止措置の実施主体として言及されているのみで、感染症の発生国ではないため対象国に該当しない。
triage.notes: 発生地は米国ワシントン州キティタス郡の家禽におけるH5N1高病原性鳥インフルエンザであり、ヒト感染例の報告はない。香港食品安全センターが輸入停止措置を取ったのみで、対象国（中国含む）での発生事例ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: CHP investigates confirmed Mpox case
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) in Hong Kong: CHP investigates a confirmed case in a 33-year-old man. He developed a genital rash on October 21, with fever, and was admitted to North District Hospital on October 30 for isolation; he is stable. Laboratory confirmation by the CHP Public Health Laboratory Services Branch. The patient reported high-risk exposure with a man in Hong Kong during incubation. An epidemiological investigation is underway; the case will be reported to the World Health Organization. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 118 Mpox cases (92 local, 25 imported, 1 under investigation); all patients are male. Among 25 cases since August, high-risk sexual activity with male partners was reported; most had not received Mpox vaccination. Outbreaks linked to dating apps have challenged contact tracing. To bolster prevention, the CHP opened an additional vaccination centre; since Sept 28, 792 high-risk individuals have been vaccinated at regular and extra venues. Two-dose vaccination reduces infection risk by 82% and lowers risk of viral spread by 87%. Mpox is not generally transmitted via respiratory droplets or aerosols.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生防護中心、確定したMpox症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: 香港で単発の確定Mpox症例が報告されたが、2022年以降の継続的な流行パターンの一部であり、患者は安定している。性的接触によるヒト-ヒト感染が継続している点は注視が必要。
triage.notes: 香港は中国の特別行政区のためChinaに分類。2022年以降118例（地域内92例、輸入25例）の継続的流行で、主に男性間性的接触によるハイリスク行動が感染拡大の主因。CHPはワクチン接種センターを増設し対応中であり、国レベルでの管理は機能している模様。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄小港五金賣場爆登革熱群聚　2人確診、8里列警戒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever cluster outbreak at a hardware store in Kaohsiung's Xiaogang District; 2 confirmed cases, eight neighborhoods placed on alert.
article.articleSummary: Two locally acquired dengue fever cases confirmed in Kaohsiung City's Xiaogang District, linked to a cluster at the 99 Hardware store on Xiaogang Road; residents live in Gangnan Li and Ganghou Li and both work at the store. Eight Li wards placed under alert. Health authorities urge people who visited the store between Oct 17 and Nov 2 to get tested and monitored on Nov 3–4. First case developed fever, malaise, myalgia, headache, and diarrhea on Oct 30; dengue fever type 2 confirmed. Second case began Oct 31 with fever and myalgia; rapid test positive, PCR confirmed. 61 samples collected; an environmental larval source found behind the store, indicating transmission risk. National totals as of 2 Nov: 16 locally transmitted dengue, 218 imported; Kaohsiung City: 12 locally, 38 imported. Imported sources: Vietnam 16, Philippines 8, Indonesia 4, Malaysia 3, Thailand 3.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄小港五金賣場でデング熱クラスター発生　2人確診、8里が警戒対象に
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市で局地的なデング熱クラスター発生が確認されたが、規模は小さく（2例）、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する段階と判断する。
triage.notes: 台湾（Taiwan）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。記事中のベトナム・フィリピン・インドネシア・タイ・マレーシアは輸入症例の由来国として言及されているのみで、発生地ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: في ظل تفشي 'إيبولا'... الصحة العالمية تدعو إلى اتفاق دولي لمواجهة الأوبئة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the wake of the Ebola outbreak, the World Health Organization calls for an international agreement to confront epidemics.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged finalization of the international pandemic treaty, saying any health threat anywhere can threaten everyone. Speaking during the ninth Geneva round of talks, he highlighted the Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing (PABS) mechanism as the treaty’s last piece. The agreement, reached in May 2025, aims to operationalize pandemic response, though nations remain divided on implementation. He cited current outbreaks: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) ongoing since May, with over 10,000 cases and about 5,000 deaths; and a Hantavirus outbreak linked to a cruise ship in Nice in April, killing three. He warned that COVID-19 demonstrated that vaccine access and benefits were unequally distributed, with some countries waiting while others had surpluses. Completing the treaty could enable safer, more equitable global preparedness and response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の最中、WHOがパンデミックに対応するための国際協定を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行が症例1万人超・死亡約5000人という極めて深刻な規模に達していることが言及されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事本文はWHO事務局長によるパンデミック条約締結を求める発言が主題であり、DRCのエボラ流行（5月以降継続、症例1万人超・死亡約5000人）は既知情報として言及されている。フランス・ニースのクルーズ船由来ハンタウイルス事例は対象国外のため除外。数値の正確性については記事本文がなく確認不可のため、続報での裏付けが望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Смертность от Эболы превысила 50%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola mortality rate exceeded 50%.
article.articleSummary: Ebola mortality rate exceeded 50% in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of 2026-11-02. The outbreak has reached about 10,400 Ebola cases, with roughly 5,400 deaths, yielding a case fatality rate of 51.6%. DRC authorities call this the largest and most deadly Ebola epidemic in the country’s history. The majority of confirmed cases and fatalities are in the DRC, with additional infections reported in Uganda, Kenya, and France. The epicenter remains Ituri Province, where most infections are concentrated. The article, citing Bloomberg’s briefing of the DRC Ministry of Health, notes ongoing transmission and cross-border spread, but provides no details on symptoms or infection sources. The information highlights a substantial healthcare burden and international concern amid a protracted outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの致死率が50%を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（約10,400症例、致死率51.6%）が継続し、ウガンダ・ケニア・フランスへの越境拡大も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ、ケニア、フランスが含まれるが、いずれも対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが主要な発生地であり対象国リストに該当する唯一の国。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch in Kongo: Warum das auch unser Problem ist
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Kongo: Why this is also our problem.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Kongo, Central Africa, has infected about 10,000 people with roughly 5,000 deaths in under six months, making it the deadliest Ebola surge in more than a decade. The West Africa 2014–2016 outbreak recorded 11,000 deaths but fewer infections in the first six months. The virus has crossed borders to Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria, while infected aid workers were treated in Germany, the Netherlands, France, the United Kingdom, and Switzerland. A U.S. entry ban for travelers who spent the past three weeks in the DRC underscores concerns about cross-border spread. Ebola transmission remains via contact with bodily fluids and is typically contagious only after symptom onset; isolation and contact tracing are most effective where health systems are functional. The piece argues against blaming aid but stresses the need for sustainable health infrastructure and shared knowledge.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行:なぜこれは私たちの問題でもあるのか
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で約1万人感染・5千人死亡という過去10年で最悪規模のエボラ流行が発生し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大、欧米諸国での感染者治療、米国の入国制限が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する重大な国際的懸念事案。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）が主たる発生国。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大、欧米諸国での感染者治療や米国の入国制限が言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。致死率（約50%）と規模（1万人感染）は西アフリカ2014-2016流行に匹敵する深刻度であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Global Alliance secures KSh 4.6 billion to fast-track vaccine for deadly Ebola strain in DRC - TV47 Digital
article.articleSummary: DRC Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak persists, with 10,060 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths reported as of Oct 25, 2026, making it the second-largest Ebola epidemic on record and a potential largest ever. There are no approved vaccines or specific treatments for Bundibugyo. The International AIDS Vaccine Initiative (IAVI) has secured an initial US$36 million (≈KSh4.68 billion) from BARDA, under a contract potentially up to US$99 million, to fast-track a single-dose vaccine targeting Bundibugyo. IAVI will lead clinical development, regulatory work, and FDA engagement. Singapore-based Hilleman Laboratories will manufacture initial doses; SK bioscience (South Korea) will scale up manufacturing; IDT Biologika (Germany) will handle fill/finish for stockpiling, with MSD Merck providing technical support. The vaccine uses an rVSV platform, same as the Zaire strain vaccine; the candidate builds on a 2007 Bundibugyo strain. BARDA funds a Phase 1 trial and potential ring vaccination in the DRC to curb spread and bolster preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 国際アライアンス、DRCの致死的エボラ株のワクチン開発加速のため46億ケニアシリング（約3600万米ドル）を確保
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は10,060例・4,887人死亡に達し、史上2番目の規模（最大規模となる可能性）。承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、国際的な資金・技術支援が動員されている重大事案。
triage.notes: 韓国・シンガポール・ドイツはワクチン製造・技術支援のパートナー国であり、実際のアウトブレイク発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。記事は主にワクチン開発資金調達に関する内容だが、背景として記載されたDRCでのエボラ流行規模（史上2番目の規模）は重大なシグナルと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 치명률 50% 넘어...누락된 사망자 추가
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola case fatality rate in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds 50%... missing deaths added.
article.articleSummary: New details in the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak push the case fatality rate above 50% after health authorities retrospectively added hundreds of previously uncounted deaths. As of Oct 30, cumulative confirmed Ebola cases stood at 11,414, with 5,372 deaths, for a case fatality rate of 51.6%. Ituri Province records were revised, adding 314 deaths to the tally. The current strain Bundibugyo ebolavirus generally carries a 30-50% fatality rate. Internationally, Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths; Kenya 9 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. Nigeria has one Swiss diplomat's wife with infection who was evacuated for treatment; additional suspected cases there tested negative. Separately, WHO began the 9th meeting in Geneva to finalize a pandemic treaty, focusing on pathogen access and sharing vaccines, diagnostics and therapies to improve outbreak responses.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ致死率が50%超え...漏れていた死者数を追加計上
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行の致死率が51.6%に達し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: Santé : l'épidémie d'Ebola rappelle l'urgence d'un traité sur les pandémies selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health: The Ebola outbreak highlights the urgency of a treaty on pandemics, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: On 2 November 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged governments at the ninth meeting of the Intergovernmental Working Group in Geneva to finish negotiations on a global pandemic treaty, including a mechanism for pathogen access and benefit sharing (PABS). He warned that recent deadly outbreaks underscore the urgency of a binding framework to protect populations and ensure equitable responses. The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused nearly 5,000 deaths and over 10,000 infections, predominantly in DRC, while a separate mysterious hantavirus outbreak killed three people aboard a cruise ship in April. Negotiations have stalled on the Annex outlining PABS; without it the treaty cannot enter into force. Tedros emphasized that no country can fully shield itself from pandemics, and lessons from COVID-19 demand shared access to vaccines, tests, and treatments.

triage.headline_ja: 健康：エボラ出血熱の流行がパンデミック条約の緊急性を改めて示す、とWHOが表明
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で死者約5,000人、感染者1万人超という大規模なエボラ出血熱流行が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性の両方が認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOのパンデミック条約交渉に関する内容が主題だが、その文脈としてDRCにおける大規模エボラ流行（死者約5,000人、感染者1万人超）が言及されている。数値の妥当性は一次情報での確認が必要。クルーズ船でのハンタウイルス流行は発生国不明で対象国に該当せず、スイス（ジュネーブ）は会議開催地であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Colombia investiga dos casos de malaria procedentes de la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Colombia investigates two malaria cases from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Two imported malaria cases in Colombian citizens who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo are under epidemiological investigation in Valle del Cauca, Colombia. One patient, 33 years old, died on Saturday at a hospital in Palmira; the other, 50 years old, is receiving care in Cali and remains isolated as follow-up procedures proceed. Preliminary laboratory assessments point to malaria caused by Plasmodium falciparum. Given the travellers' origin and fever symptoms, authorities are also reviewing for other high-priority diseases, including Ebola virus disease. Samples are undergoing laboratory verification, and to date the only confirmed diagnosis in both cases is malaria. The ministries emphasize that no panic is warranted while investigations continue, and containment measures focus on surveillance, contact tracing, and preventing local transmission in the Valle del Cauca department.

triage.headline_ja: コロンビア、コンゴ民主共和国由来のマラリア疑い2症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: DRCから帰国した渡航者における輸入マラリア症例（1名死亡）で、エボラウイルス病の可能性も検査中だが未確定であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコロンビア（Valle del Cauca県）における輸入マラリア症例の調査であり、感染自体はDRC滞在中に曝露した可能性が高いが、実際の発症・死亡・診断はコロンビアで発生している。コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。エボラウイルス病の検査結果は未確定であり、今後の検査結果次第で評価を更新する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: India issues advisory on mandatory Ebola declaration for all passengers
article.articleSummary: India's Bureau of Immigration, on 2026-11-02, issued an advisory requiring all international arrivals to complete the Air Suvidha Self-Declaration Form before travel, in response to an ongoing Ebola outbreak. The online declaration must be submitted by every passenger, regardless of nationality or travel history, including Indian passport holders, Overseas Citizen of India (OCIs) cardholders, and foreign nationals. The measure applies to all routes and aims to streamline entry procedures and clearance on arrival in India. Passengers are urged to complete the form on the official Air Suvidha website prior to departure to ensure smooth clearance and avoid delays at border controls.

triage.headline_ja: インドが全渡航者に対しエボラ出血熱の申告を義務化する勧告を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行への対応としてインドが渡航者申告を義務化したことを報じているが、実際の流行発生国・規模等の詳細情報が記事中に無く、情報不足のため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はインド国内でのエボラ発生ではなく、海外で発生中とされるエボラ流行への水際対策（渡航者申告義務化）を報じたもの。実際の流行発生国が明記されておらず、対象国リストとの照合ができないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Komşudaki tehlike kapımızda mı? Dr. Ramazan İnci'den Batı Nil Virüsü uyarıları
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the Danger Next Door at Our Doorstep? West Nile Virus Warnings from Dr. Ramazan İnci
article.articleSummary: West Nile Virus (WNV) warnings. As cases rise in Greece and Europe, Turkey faces potential risk. Transmission: birds serve as reservoirs and Culex mosquitoes are the main vectors; infection occurs when an infected mosquito bites a person. WNV has been reported across Africa, Europe, the Middle East, North America and West Asia, with outbreaks concentrated along bird migration routes. The illness is seasonal, mainly in summer and early autumn, with the peak typically in August–September. Climate conditions—milder winters and hot, humid summers—favor mosquito breeding, helping explain rising numbers in Greece and elsewhere. In Turkey, there is no current outbreak and the situation is not panicked, but authorities remain vigilant due to proximity to affected regions and neighboring Europe. The symptoms resemble flu and are distinguished by the absence of typical respiratory symptoms such as cough or sore throat.

triage.headline_ja: 隣国の危機は我が家の戸口に？ ラマザン・インジ博士による西ナイルウイルス警告
triage.triage_reason: 記事はトルコ・ギリシャにおける西ナイルウイルスの季節性注意喚起であり、トルコ国内では現在アウトブレイクは発生しておらず、対象国（日本側モニタリング対象リスト）に該当する国での発生報告もない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にChinaが含まれているが、記事本文はトルコ・ギリシャ・ヨーロッパにおける季節性西ナイルウイルスの注意喚起であり、中国での発生には言及がないため対象国として検証されない。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Ο Έμπολα αναδεικνύει την ανάγκη συνθήκης για τις πανδημίες
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola highlights the need for a treaty on pandemics.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused about 5,000 deaths and over 10,000 infections, primarily in the DRC, underscoring the need for a global pandemic treaty. At the ninth session of the Intergovernmental Working Group in Geneva (through November 13), WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged states to complete the agreement, emphasizing population protection. The article also notes a hantavirus outbreak on a cruise ship in April that killed three, illustrating ongoing threats. Following the May 2025 Global Accord for Pandemics, negotiations for a core instrument remain stalled after eight GTI meetings since July 2025. The Pathogens Access and Cross-Border Benefits-Sharing (PABS) system will define access to pathogens and benefits such as vaccines, tests, and treatments, described as the missing final piece. WHO warns that no country can shield itself from pandemics, and COVID-19 vaccine inequities prolonged outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ出血熱がパンデミック条約の必要性を浮き彫りに
triage.triage_reason: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）における大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行（死者約5,000人、感染者1万人超）に言及しており、数値が事実であればIHR基準の『深刻な公衆衛生影響』『異常性』の2項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOのパンデミック条約交渉に関する政治的文脈の中でDRCのエボラ流行統計（死者約5,000人、感染者1万人超）を引用しているが、これは既知の過去の流行規模（2018-2020年Kivu流行:死者約2,300人）と比べて異常に高く、数値の正確性・時期（累積か現在進行中か）について続報での確認が必要。ジュネーブでの会議やクルーズ船でのハンタウイルス事例は対象国に該当しないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Incendian un centro de tratamiento de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They torch an Ebola treatment center in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of November 2, 2026, unidentified attackers burned an Ebola treatment center in Bafwasende, in the Tsopo Province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, destroying two isolation rooms. Local doctor Marcel Likilo said staff fled, and patients suspected of Ebola were evacuated to Nia-Nia in neighboring Ituri Province. The incident follows a week after a mob lynched a health worker involved in the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. Health authorities warn that community resistance hampers containment. Ministry of Health figures indicate more than 10,000 confirmed Ebola cases and over 5,000 deaths since the outbreak began in May. The attack underscores ongoing security and public-acceptance challenges that complicate the response and risk further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ治療センターが放火される
triage.triage_reason: 死者5,000人超・感染者10,000人超に達する大規模エボラ流行下で治療施設への放火や医療従事者へのリンチが発生し、対応を著しく阻害しており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクを伴う。
triage.notes: 記事は治療センターへの放火事件を主題とするが、背景には2026年5月以降続く大規模エボラ流行（確定症例10,000超、死者5,000超）があり、コミュニティの抵抗・治安悪化が封じ込めを妨げている点が重大。既存の大規模流行イベントとして継続監視・フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: La conmovedora celebración de un hospital en el Congo por su último paciente con ébola. La crisis es enorme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The moving celebration of a hospital in the Congo for its last Ebola patient. The crisis is enormous.
article.articleSummary: MSF celebrates the exit of the last Ebola patients from a treatment center in Mongbwalu, DRC; first time since May that no confirmed cases are receiving care there, but authorities warn the outbreak remains highly concerning. Across Africa, over 10,000 Ebola cases have been detected, majority in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), which records 10,060 cases and 4,887 deaths in the latest balance. The Bundibugyo strain drives the current epidemic, the worst in DRC history, with about 9,700 cases and over 4,600 deaths previously reported. WHO warns containment is more complex as cases appear in East, Central, and now West Africa, including a confirmed case in Nigeria: a Swiss woman infected after travel to Uganda. Kenya reports two deaths since Oct 6; Uganda had 20 cases and two deaths before being declared Ebola-free in August. A large-scale Ervebo trial in RDC will assess cross-protection against Bundibugyo, starting in Bunia; the Tumaini trial uses ring vaccination. Two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are in early trials: Oxford’s ChAdOx1 and Moderna’s mRNA candidate.

article.articleHeadline: Evidence of widespread sequencing errors in global avian influenza study
article.articleSummary: As of 2 November 2026, concerns over Wannigama et al. (2025) arise from a global avian influenza study using guano samples from Africa (Madagascar, Mozambique, Somalia), the Middle East (Yemen), South Asia (Maldives, Sri Lanka), Southeast Asia (Indonesia, Myanmar, the Philippines) and Oceania (Papua New Guinea). While aiming to fill surveillance gaps and inform high-pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) incursion risk, the study’s sequences and conclusions clash with established influenza evolution. Key issues include 100% identity of HA and NA segments across disparate regions and years, which is implausible for rapidly evolving influenza A viruses with clock-like mutation rates (~1.8–8.4×10^-3 substitutions/site/year). Root-to-tip analyses (TempEst) reveal outliers; phylogenies show H7 and H5N1 sequences (PNG, Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Maldives, Mozambique) from 2021–2022 identical to an eradicated Australian H7N7, and PNG sequences identical to older GISAID records (2004–2018). Data quality problems in GenBank/GISAID hinder interpretation, risk assessments, and policy decisions.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的な鳥インフルエンザ研究における広範な配列決定エラーの証拠
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、過去の鳥インフルエンザサーベイランス研究（Wannigama et al. 2025）における配列データの信頼性・品質に関する科学的批判であり、公衆衛生上の実際のイベントではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の鳥インフルエンザ発生事例を報告するものではなく、既存研究のゲノム配列データにおける品質・信頼性問題（配列の同一性の不自然さ、系統解析の異常など）を指摘する科学的検証記事である。インドネシア・フィリピン・ミャンマーなどは研究対象国として言及されているが、実際の発生国として特定されていないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: SC conclui desinfecção dos três focos do vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease: Santa Catarina completes disinfection of the three virus foci.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease in Santa Catarina, Brazil, prompted a targeted outbreak response after three October foci were confirmed in Nova Itaberaba, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim. The first focus, confirmed Oct 18 in a turkey-rearing establishment in Nova Itaberaba, led to rapid depopulation of 6,526 birds from Oct 21–23, followed by cleaning and disinfection of the facility. A second focus in Coronel Freitas was identified Oct 24, with depopulation of 33,993 birds and control measures concluding Oct 29. A third focus was detected in Nova Erechim on Oct 26; details on bird counts were not provided. By early November, all three affected establishments had completed disinfection, and epidemiological surveillance had covered 100% of the third surveillance radius commercial establishments, with 70 tested negative for Newcastle disease so far. Ongoing containment measures and monitoring continue to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病：サンタカタリーナ州がウイルス発生3地点の消毒を完了
triage.triage_reason: 家禽の動物疾患であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響はなく、当局により既に封じ込め・消毒が完了しているため見送りと判断する。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽(七面鳥等)のニューカッスル病であり、ヒト感染症ではない。発生は既に当局により制御・消毒完了済みで、監視も継続中であり追加措置の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Aantal ebolaslachtoffers passeert de 5000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Number of Ebola victims surpasses 5,000
article.articleSummary: As of 2 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the largest ever recorded, with more than 5,000 deaths. The outbreak remains far from under control, and the epicenter has shifted to new regions across the country, signaling sustained transmission and logistical challenges. Beyond the DRC, infections have been reported in Nigeria and Kenya, underscoring cross-border spread risk. Experts warn that the virus could potentially reach Europe, highlighting international concern. VRT journalist Stijn Vercruysse has just returned from the hardest-hit area and witnessed the epidemic's consequences up close, describing overwhelmed health facilities and the personal toll on communities. The report emphasizes that containment remains difficult and that international vigilance is warranted.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ死者数が5000人を突破

article.articleHeadline: Mpox em alta no RJ: saiba sinais e formas de transmissão da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox on the rise in Rio de Janeiro: learn the signs and modes of transmission of the disease.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) is rising in Rio de Janeiro state, Brazil, with 211 confirmed cases in 2026; in the capital, 74 infections were confirmed in the last two months, about seven times the 2025 figure of 10. The health minister announced reinforced Mpox vaccine shipments to the state; nationwide 665 cases in 2026 to date. Transmission is mainly person-to-person via direct contact with skin lesions or bodily fluids (pus, saliva, blood), contaminated objects, and prolonged close contact with respiratory secretions. Incubation 3-16 days up to 21. Symptoms: rash/skin lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, myalgias, chills, fatigue. Lesions typically begin on the face and spread to body, including palms/soles and genitals; progress to fluid-filled vesicles then crusts. Treatment is supportive; most recover in 2-4 weeks. Vaccination advised for high-risk groups and post-exposure within 4 days of contact; stigma risk highlighted by OMS.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州でMpoxが増加：病気の兆候と感染経路について

triage.notes: リオデジャネイロ州で2026年に211例、州都で直近2か月に74例（前年同期比約7倍）、全国で665例と報告。保健省がワクチン増配を発表しており行政の関心は高いが、重症度や死亡例の記載はなく、国際的拡大の情報もないため一部基準は不明と評価。

article.articleHeadline: 七歲女童感染流感後病情嚴重　留醫深切治療部(劉倩桐報道)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven-year-old girl severely ill after contracting influenza; admitted to the Intensive Care Unit (Liu Qiantong reports).
article.articleSummary: Influenza A causes severe illness in Hong Kong: A previously healthy seven-year-old girl was admitted to Kwong Wah Hospital's Pediatric Intensive Care Unit with severe pneumonia after fever and cough; lab-confirmed Type A influenza. She had no travel during the incubation period and had not received the seasonal flu vaccine. By 2 November 2026, the Centre for Health Protection reports 29 pediatric severe influenza cases this season, with two deaths. The season began in June and has lasted about four months; overall influenza activity remains above baseline despite signs of easing. HKU pediatric and adolescent medicine clinicians note longer flu duration and faster progression this year, with risks of shock, multi-organ involvement, and possible cerebral symptoms. Parents are urged to seek early medical care and vaccinate children to reduce severe outcomes. No travel-related cases cited.

triage.headline_ja: 7歳女児、インフルエンザ感染後に重症化し集中治療室に入院（劉倩桐記者報道）

triage.notes: 本事例は季節性インフルエンザAの重症小児例報告であり、HK Centre for Health Protectionによる定例サーベイランス情報。今シーズンは経過が長く進行が速いとの臨床所見があるため、今後の重症例増加や流行動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Demokratische Republik Kongo: Ebola-Epidemie: WHO-Chef fordert Abschluss des globalen Pandemie-Abkommens
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola Epidemic: WHO Director-General Calls for Finalization of the Global Pandemic Treaty.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains deadly, with more than 10,000 infections and about 5,000 deaths reported by end-October; cases have also emerged in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. In Geneva, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged finalization of the Global Pandemic Treaty during the ninth negotiating round. The agreement, initially adopted in May 2025, hinges on the Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing (PABS) mechanism, which would require rapid data sharing about pathogens in exchange for access to tests, vaccines and medicines through WHO. Tedros warned that no country can tackle pandemics alone, since a threat anywhere is a threat everywhere. The piece also notes a spring Hantavirus outbreak on the cruise ship MV Hondius, with 13 infections and 3 deaths, including a German passenger.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ流行:WHO事務局長、パンデミック条約の最終合意を要求

triage.notes: 記事はWHO事務局長によるパンデミック条約合意要求が主眼だが、背景としてDRCでの大規模エボラ流行（1万人超感染、約5000人死亡）と周辺国（ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ）への拡大が報じられている。これらの国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。また記事後半のクルーズ船ハンタウイルス事例は別イベントであり、地理的に対象国と無関係。

article.articleHeadline: Confirman dos casos de malaria grave en Cali y Palmira tras llegada desde África | HSB Noticias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two cases of severe malaria confirmed in Cali and Palmira after arriving from Africa | HSB Noticias
article.articleSummary: Two imported cases of malaria caused by Plasmodium falciparum were confirmed in Cali and Palmira, Valle del Cauca, Colombia, in travelers arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. One patient, a 33-year-old man, died October 31 in Palmira; the other, a 50-year-old man, remains hospitalized in Cali under medical observation. Two additional travelers from the same group are under follow-up. Authorities activated surveillance, vector-control, and epidemiological monitoring in Valle del Cauca and Cauca, with additional testing to rule out other diseases, including Ebola; no Ebola cases confirmed. The National Institute of Health led laboratory confirmation. The public is urged to seek care if recently traveled from Africa and develops fever, chills, or headache. Health authorities in Popayán and northern Cauca reinforced hospital surveillance, stressing precaution rather than panic.

article.articleHeadline: Health: Ebola reminder of urgent need to finish pandemic tre
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo underscore the urgent need to finish an international pandemic treaty, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said on 2026-11-02. The ninth meeting toward finalising the agreement opened in Geneva as negotiators grapple with how the framework, adopted last year to handle future Covid-like pandemics, would operate in practice. Wealthy countries and developing nations remain at loggerheads over how the framework will work in practice. Tedros stressed that completing the treaty is about protecting people, citing several recent deadly outbreaks as motivation. The Ebola crisis in DRC is offered as a reminder of the stakes. This framework was adopted last year to handle future Covid-like pandemics.

article.articleHeadline: Zone de santé d'Itebero : 989 cas suspects de choléra et 61 décès enregistrés dans 14 aires de santé en 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Itebero Health Zone: 989 suspected cholera cases and 61 deaths recorded in 14 health areas in 2026.
article.articleSummary: 989 suspected cholera cases and 61 deaths were reported in 2026 in the Itebero Health Zone, Walikale territory, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, across 14 of 28 health areas. Epidemiological weeks 36–43 show worsening transmission, with week 43 alone recording 273 suspected cases and 17 deaths, up from 167 cases and 12 deaths in the previous week. Lukaraba health area is the most affected (421 cases, 14 deaths), followed by Kiuli (135 cases, 11 deaths) and Isangi (114 cases, 7 deaths); Busurungi reports 87 cases and 4 deaths. Laboratory confirmation remains limited: only one sample from Lowa, with support from MSF-Holland, tested positive for cholera, hindering full epidemiological characterization. Apparent case fatality among suspects is about 6.17%. The authorities urge strengthened surveillance, improved patient management, and preventive measures in affected communities.

triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州イテベロ保健地区でコレラ疑い989例・死亡61例（致死率約6.17%）が発生し、週を追うごとに悪化傾向にあることから、WPRO基準（重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）に複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断する。
triage.notes: コレラはDRCで地域流行性があるため「異常」ではないが、週43で症例・死亡数が急増しており悪化傾向が顕著。検査確定例は1件のみ（MSFホラント支援）であり、疫学的特性把握が不十分な点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Bareily News: प्राइवेट अस्पताल में भर्ती तीन मरीज मिले डेंगू पाजिटिव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bareilly News: Three dengue-positive patients admitted to a private hospital.
article.articleSummary: Three dengue-positive cases were confirmed in Bareilly district, Uttar Pradesh, as of 2 November 2026. Seven patients with dengue-like symptoms at a private hospital tested positive on rapid kits, and ELISA testing at the district hospital confirmed dengue in three individuals: a 39-year-old woman from Sanjay Nagar, a 27-year-old man from Nawabganj, and another woman admitted to a private facility. The district’s total dengue cases now stand at 28, with five new infections reported in the past week. Officials note a post-monsoon rise in dengue, alongside malaria, and are monitoring transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak has killed more than 5,000 people, while most new cases are emerging outside monitored contact chains
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 5,026 deaths among 10,351 cases (MOH data through Oct 31, 2026). It is the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak after 2014–2016 West Africa. About 80% of new infections occur outside established contact chains, and roughly one-third of deaths happen outside treatment centers, indicating transmission blind spots. Ituri and North Kivu are the epicenters, with 9,782 cases and 4,792 deaths in those provinces. CDC tallies 10,305 cases and 4,996 deaths as of Oct 28; Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths), Nigeria (1), Uganda (20), and France (1 imported) are also affected. No approved vaccine or treatment exists; care is symptom-based. A U.S. attestation rule, taking effect Nov 3, requires travelers to confirm no Congo exposure in the prior 21 days, with overall risk to the U.S. public deemed low.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで死者5,000人超、新規症例の大半は監視対象外の接触経路で発生

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por muerte de paciente con Malaria tras regresar del Congo: Ojo a los síntomas | HSB Noticias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert over the death of a patient with malaria after returning from the Congo: Watch for symptoms | HSB Noticias
article.articleSummary: Malaria due to Plasmodium falciparum identified in two Colombian nationals returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, triggering epidemiological surveillance in Valle del Cauca, including Palmira and Cali. One patient, 33, died on 31 October 2026 in a Palmira hospital; the second, 50, remains alive under isolation and receiving care in Cali. Laboratory confirmation confirms malaria for both cases; authorities are implementing surveillance protocols to exclude other priority diseases, including Ebola. Epidemiological investigations aim to map travel routes in Africa, exposure histories, and potential contacts, with field teams active in Cali and Palmira. Two additional individuals identified during initial contact tracing have malaria and are under treatment. The Ministry of Health and Protection and the National Institute of Health coordinate sample collection, testing, and adherence to protocols, with updates communicated through official channels.

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: Rio de Janeiro já tem mais casos em 2026 do que em todo o ano passado; veja os sintomas e quando procurar atendimento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: Rio de Janeiro already has more cases in 2026 than in all of last year; see the symptoms and when to seek medical attention.
article.articleSummary: Mpox in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. By 1 November 2026, Rio de Janeiro state reported 211 confirmed mpox cases, up from 119 in 2025 (≈77% rise); no deaths reported. SES-RJ data updated 27 October show 211 confirmed, 371 discarded, 119 under investigation, and seven probable cases. The capital reported 74 infections in the two months before publication, vs 10 in 2025. Mpox is caused by MPXV and transmits mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, secretions, body fluids, or contaminated objects; close, prolonged contact can spread via respiratory secretions. Incubation 3–16 days, up to 21. Symptoms: skin lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, myalgias, fatigue, chills; lesions may appear on face, hands, feet, mouth, genitals, or anus. Diagnosis: molecular testing from lesion secretions (or crusts). No specific approved drug; management is supportive. SUS vaccination exists for selected groups after exposure, not universal (e.g., lab workers handling Orthopoxvirus; HIV-immunosuppressed patients).

triage.headline_ja: Mpox：リオデジャネイロ州、2026年の症例数が昨年1年間を上回る；症状と受診の目安
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロ州でMpox症例が前年比約77%増加し、継続的な流行拡大が懸念される。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があり社会的関心（報道・保健当局データ公表）も確認されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 死亡例は報告されていないが、前年比で大幅な症例増加が確認されており、州保健局（SES-RJ）による公式データ公表と報道がある。国際的拡大や渡航制限への言及はなし。

article.articleHeadline: SC reforça vacinação contra dengue com chegada do calor - Visor Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SC steps up dengue vaccination with the arrival of warm weather
article.articleSummary: Santa Catarina, Brazil, steps up dengue vaccination ahead of the warm, rainy season. As of 2026-11-02, second-dose coverage is 27.45% and first-dose coverage 54.47% of the 10–14-year-old target. Vaccination is offered through SUS health units in municipalities under the SUS strategy; expansion began in 2024 with new municipalities added per Ministry of Health guidelines. Authorities stress checking vaccination status and completing the schedule to prevent severe dengue and hospitalizations. Vaccination complements, but does not replace, vector-control measures against Aedes aegypti; elimination of breeding sites—discarding water-collecting containers, sealing water tanks, and cleaning gutters—remains essential, with inspections of homes and businesses recommended as warmer months approach.
