triage.notes: 記事は定期的な季節前ワクチン接種キャンペーンの進捗報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Estados Unidos establece control sanitario de 21 días contra el ébola para vuelos internacionales
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United States establishes a 21-day health screening for Ebola on international flights
article.articleSummary: United States public health authorities will implement a new 21-day health-reporting requirement for passengers and crew on international air travel to prevent the entry of Ebola from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The rule takes effect on November 3, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. and requires travelers to sign a sworn declaration certifying they have not stayed in or transited through the DRC in the 21 days before boarding. It applies to U.S. citizens, permanent residents, foreign visitors, and crew on commercial, cargo, and private flights. Those with DRC exposure must refrain from entering the U.S. for the 21 days; day 0 is departure, so entry is allowed from day 22. Airlines must verify declarations; noncompliance can bar boarding, with authorized humanitarian exceptions. Providing false information is a federal offense. The measure lasts 45 days (through December 18, 2026) and may be revised; CDC says Ebola risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ対策として国際便に21日間の健康管理措置を導入
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行を受け米国が国際渡航制限を導入しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ発生を前提とした米国の渡航制限措置を報じているが、DRC国内の具体的な症例数・流行状況の詳細は本文に記載なし。米国自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。CDCはリスクは低いとコメントしている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: " On ne peut pas choisir entre la maladie et la faim " : à Bunia, la quarantaine Ebola contre le repas du soir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: You can't choose between illness and hunger: in Bunia, the Ebola quarantine threatens dinnertime.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues to strain daily life in Bunia, Ituri. A 21-day quarantine for contacts, while containment-focused, deprives households of income and food, hitting women hardest as market sellers, caregivers, and heads of households. The UN Development Programme (PNUD) has drafted a US$30 million socio-economic response, but it remains unfunded and relies on internal emergency resources while seeking donors. As of mid-September, Ituri reported 5,659 cases and 2,583 deaths, with 28 of 36 health zones affected; nationally, 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths as of October 18. PNUD says it has reached over 460,000 people in Ituri and supported 82 survivors. Community listening circles helped counter rumors that doctors inject the virus. Interventions involve 56 local leaders, 10 youth animators, 10 women-led civil groups, and two community radio stations; affected households receive dignity kits, hygiene products, and emergency food rations.

triage.headline_ja: 「病気と飢えのどちらかを選ぶことはできない」:ブニアでのエボラ隔離が夕食を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で大規模なエボラ流行（全国9,552症例、4,602死亡）が継続中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と社会経済的影響が顕著で、国際支援の必要性も明確なためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中アウトブレイクであり、すでにRRA対象となっている可能性が高いが、社会経済的影響・資金不足など新規情報を含むためPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Rio confirma 211 casos de mpox em 2026 e supera total de 2025
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro confirms 211 mpox cases in 2026 and surpasses the 2025 total.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro has confirmed 211 mpox cases in 2026, with 119 suspected under investigation (as of October), according to CIEVS-RJ. Confirmed cases this year already exceed the entire 2025 total of 119 by 77%. In September alone, 45 confirmations were recorded, the highest monthly count in three years. Ten people are hospitalized at Fiocruz in Manguinhos for treatment. Nationwide, Brazil reports 665 confirmed cases through October, per the Ministry of Health. Rio de Janeiro ranks second among Brazilian states, behind São Paulo, which has 268 cases in 2026. Mpox is caused by the MPXV virus, a zoonosis. Symptoms include skin eruptions/lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, body aches, chills, and weakness. Transmission is mainly via direct contact with lesions, bodily fluids, or contaminated objects; respiratory droplets can transmit during close, prolonged contact. Prevention emphasizes avoiding contact with suspected/confirmed cases, PPE when exposure is needed, hand hygiene, isolation for symptomatic individuals, and not sharing personal items.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロで2026年のMpox症例211件を確認、2025年の年間合計を上回る
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロ州で2026年のMpox確定例が前年比77%増加し、9月には過去3年で最多の月間新規確認数を記録するなど、持続的なヒト-ヒト感染拡大の兆候が見られるため、経過確認を含むフルリスク評価が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（リオデジャネイロ州・サンパウロ州含む）国内のMpox症例増加に関する保健当局報告であり、全国で665例確認（10月時点）。死亡例の報告はなく、重症度は中等度（入院10名）。継続的な感染拡大傾向のため今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: muertes de niños en Perú ya superan las registradas durante todo el 2025, según registros del Minsa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Child deaths in Peru already exceed those recorded for all of 2025, according to MINSA records.
article.articleSummary: By Oct 24, 2026, Peru reports 16,224 dengue cases in children aged 0–11, doubling 2025’s 8,067. MINSA records 23 pediatric deaths, exceeding all of 2024 (18) and 2025 (16). San Martín leads with 7 child deaths (ages 3–11), followed by Piura (5), Ucayali (3), and Lambayeque, Madre de Dios (2 each), with Amazonas, Junín, La Libertad, and Loreto each recording one. Children account for about 25% of nationwide dengue fatalities. Automedication is a recurring risk factor, with many families opting for private clinics or medications, delaying proper care. Dengue serotype 3 has circulated across nearly all regions since 2025, associated with faster replication and stronger inflammatory responses, increasing severity. El Niño conditions raise Aedes aegypti breeding, likely elevating cases in coming months. Authorities urge early warning recognition and timely health care, and call for pharmacy regulation to curb unsafe treatments.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：ペルーの小児死亡者数、2026年に既に2025年通年の件数を上回る（保健省記録）
triage.triage_reason: 本事象はペルー国内で発生しており、監視対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ等11カ国）のいずれにも該当しないため、本トリアージ運用の対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はペルー国内（サンマルティン州、ピウラ州等）のデング熱流行および小児死亡者数増加を報じている。発生地域リストにBrazilが含まれるが、記事の主題はペルーであり、ブラジルでの発生は言及されていないため除外。ペルーは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: 7歲女童感染甲流併發嚴重肺炎 目前情況嚴重 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 7-year-old girl infected with influenza A develops severe pneumonia; current condition is serious.
article.articleSummary: On 2 November 2026, Hong Kong’s Centre for Health Protection reported a single case of influenza A (H1) in a 7-year-old girl, with severe pneumonia and currently in a serious condition. The previously healthy child developed fever, cough and fatigue on 27 October, sought care at a private clinic, and was admitted to Kwong Wah Hospital on 29 October, later transferring to the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit as respiratory distress worsened. Respiratory samples tested positive for influenza A (H1). Preliminary investigation found no travel during the incubation period and that she had not yet received seasonal influenza vaccination. Household contacts experienced fever and mild upper respiratory symptoms but recovered without hospitalization. The CHP will continue investigation. Authorities urge vaccination against seasonal influenza to prevent severe disease and complications, and emphasize ongoing personal and environmental hygiene to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 7歳女児がインフルエンザA型に感染し重症肺炎を発症、現在重篤な状態
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1)の単発重症例で、家庭内接触者は軽症・回復しており、異常な広がりや国際的懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)による個別重症小児例。通常の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられ、ワクチン未接種が重症化要因とされている。続報の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Zone de santé d'Itebero : 989 cas suspects de choléra et 61 décès enregistrés dans 14 aires de santé en 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Itebero Health Zone: 989 suspected cholera cases and 61 deaths recorded in 14 health areas in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Itebero Health Zone, Walikale Territory, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Since the start of 2026, 989 suspected cholera cases and 61 deaths have been reported across 14 of the zone’s 28 health areas. Epidemiological weeks 36–43 show intensifying transmission, with week 43 recording 273 suspected cases and 17 deaths, up from 167 cases and 12 deaths the previous week. Lukaraba Health Area is the most affected (421 cases, 14 deaths), followed by Kiuli (135/11), Isangi (114/7), and Busurungi (87/4). A single Lowa sample tested positive for cholera with MSF/Holland support; the limited sampling hinders full epidemiological characterization and underscores the need for enhanced investigations and laboratory analyses. Apparent case-fatality rate among suspected cases is 6.17%. Urgent emphasis on surveillance, patient management, and community prevention in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: イテベロ保健地区：2026年に14保健地域で989件のコレラ疑い症例と61人の死亡が記録される
triage.triage_reason: CFRが6.17%と高く、感染拡大が継続しているコレラ流行であり、ラボ能力不足から国際支援（MSF）が既に介入していることから、社会的関心・管理可能性の観点でフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: コレラはDRCで地域流行性だが、今回の症例数増加傾向（週43で273件・17死亡）とラボ検査能力不足（単一サンプルのみ陽性確認）が懸念材料。MSF/オランダの支援が既に入っているが、調査・ラボ分析の強化が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Global health exposed as deadly viruses continue to spread, report finds | The National
article.articleSummary: Mpox has spread to more than 82 countries; the first nine months of 2026 recorded over 14,000 confirmed cases and 50 deaths. The IPPPR report Hiding in Plain Sight warns neglect of known threats fuels outbreaks and notes Africa’s missed target to vaccinate 6.4 million. In Central Africa, Ebola continues in DR Congo, with 5,340 deaths and 10,351 confirmed cases as of Oct 29, worsened by porous borders with Uganda and Rwanda and underinvestment in surveillance and vaccines. In Europe, Shamonda caused the first human death and Russian plague followed a Siberian lab incident. Dengue fever in Bangladesh has claimed 418 lives and over 133,000 hospitalizations as of Oct 30, with October the deadliest month; measles has killed more than 1,200 there. The WHO says the world has been in a health emergency for about 70% of time since Jan 30, 2020, amid trust deficits and ongoing global health collaborations (UAE, Riyadh-led WHO-GCC exercise).

triage.headline_ja: 世界の健康危機が露呈：致死性ウイルスが拡大を続けていると報告書が指摘
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の継続的流行（死者5,340人、確定症例10,351人）が深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を示し、国境を越えた拡大リスクも指摘されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は複数疾患・地域を横断するグローバルレビュー記事だが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのエボラ流行のみ。ウガンダ・ルワンダは国境リスクとして言及されるが主題の発生国ではないため除外。バングラデシュ・ロシア・サウジアラビア・UAEは対象国リスト外のため除外。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Hong Kong suspends import of poultry products from US county after outbreak of bird flu in region
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong's Centre for Food Safety suspended imports of poultry meat and products from Kittitas County in Washington state, United States, due to an outbreak of highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza in the area. The measure, effective immediately, covers poultry meat, products, and eggs from the county and follows a WOAH notification about the outbreak. The CFS has contacted American authorities and will closely monitor WOAH updates and the relevant authorities. The action aims to protect public health in Hong Kong, with further measures to be taken as the situation develops. This move underscores cross-border trade controls in response to avian influenza outbreaks and relies on ongoing international surveillance and information from WOAH and US authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 香港、鳥インフルエンザ発生地域の米国の郡からの家禽製品輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: H5N1の発生は米国ワシントン州キッティタス郡であり、対象国（中国・香港含む）では発生していない。香港は輸入停止という防疫措置を取ったのみで、自国内での発生事例ではないため対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 発生国は米国（ワシントン州）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。香港は家禽製品の輸入停止という貿易措置を講じたのみで、国内での感染事例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Senator Hospitalized After Stroke; Nationwide Supplement Recall; 5,000 Ebola Deaths
article.articleSummary: Measles in the United States: U.S. measles cases this year total 4,852, with concerns about pregnancy outcomes as CDC scientists sought a nationwide alert to clinicians on measles risks during pregnancy, reportedly blocked by HHS. Ebola in Congo: the confirmed death toll from the Congo outbreak has reached 5,026, underscoring a continuing high-mortality event. Food-safety: the FDA issued a nationwide recall of ashwagandha supplements sold at Whole Foods due to Salmonella contamination, highlighting a foodborne infection risk. The roundup emphasizes these infectious-disease items and related regulatory actions as public health measures. All points reflect updates as of 2026-11-02.

triage.headline_ja: 上院議員が脳卒中で入院、全国的なサプリメント回収、エボラ死者5,000人
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ(DRC)のエボラ流行による死者数が5,026人に達し、高致死率の継続的な公衆衛生危機であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の麻疹流行や食品回収についても触れているが、対象国リストに米国は含まれないため除外。DRCのエボラ流行死者数の継続的増加が主要な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: 猴痘｜33歲男確診生殖器官現皮疹並蔓延　曾在港與男子高風險性接觸
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox | A 33-year-old man diagnosed with a genital-area rash that appeared and spread; had high-risk sexual contact with a man in Hong Kong.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox confirmed in Hong Kong in a 33-year-old man. On October 21, a genital-area rash appeared, followed by fever, with the rash spreading to the chest and limbs. He was admitted for isolation at North District Hospital last Friday and is in stable condition. Laboratory testing by the Centre for Health Protection’s Public Health Laboratory Service detected monkeypox virus DNA, confirming a positive result. Based on the patient’s report, he had high-risk sexual contact with a man in Hong Kong during the incubation period. The Centre for Health Protection is conducting epidemiological investigations and will report the case to the World Health Organization. This marks another local monkeypox case detected in Hong Kong.

triage.headline_ja: サル痘｜33歳男性が陰部に発疹が出現し拡大して確定診断　香港で男性と高リスク性的接触歴
triage.triage_reason: 香港における単発のサル痘ローカル感染例であり、重症度は低く安定しているが、ヒト-ヒト感染（性的接触）による国内伝播の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 発生地域にIndia（Sikkim州）が含まれているが、記事サマリーは香港の症例のみを扱っており、インドでの発生は確認できないため除外した。香港はChina (1814991)に含めた。WHOへの報告が予定されている旨の記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Ο Έμπολα φέρνει ξανά στο προσκήνιο τον φόβο μιας νέας πανδημίας | AlphaTV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola brings the fear of a new pandemic back to the forefront.
article.articleSummary: Rising concerns about a renewed pandemic risk foreground Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which has approximately 5,000 deaths and over 10,000 infections, per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The agency convened the ninth session of the Intergovernmental Working Group in Geneva through November 13 to push finalization of the Global Pandemic Accord, with the key sticking point the Pandemic Access and Benefit-Sharing (PABS) framework. PABS would govern access to pathogens and distribution of benefits, including vaccines, diagnostics, and therapeutics. Also noted is a mysterious hantavirus outbreak traced to a cruise ship in April that killed three passengers. Tedros reminded that lessons from the COVID-19 pandemic show unequal vaccine access cost lives, prolonged outbreaks, and raised variant risk. He stressed no country can shield itself alone; completing PABS is the missing piece to the accord.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラが再びパンデミックへの恐怖を呼び起こす
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行に言及しているが、記事の主題はWHOのパンデミック協定（PABS）交渉であり、新規の疫学的詳細（発生時期・地域・最新動向）が不明なため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOのパンデミック協定交渉（PABS）を主題とし、DRCのエボラ（累計死者約5000人・感染者1万人超）はその文脈での引用。具体的な新規アウトブレイクの発生時期・地域・最新感染状況は記事から確認できず、既存流行の継続的言及の可能性がある。また言及されるハンタウイルス（クルーズ船関連）は発生地域が不明で対象国リストに該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Bunia : la sécurité rassurée aux équipes d'enterrement par un Bourgmestre - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bunia: Mayor reassures funeral teams about security - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 2 November 2026, in Bunia, capital of Ituri Province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Mbunya commune mayor, Jean-Marie Fwamba, reassured Red Cross volunteers assigned to dignified and secured burial (EDS) about their safety amid threats and violence at Mbiyo cemetery. He stressed the objective to cut the transmission chain of Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) and urged cemetery stewards to report disturbances, promising police protection and judicial action, with the procurer-general instructing authorities to arrest anyone opposing response activities. The mayor reaffirmed commitment to safeguarding volunteers so they can continue outbreak response without intimidation. EDS teams have endured three assaults at Mbiyo cemetery in recent days, a development that could disrupt Ebola containment efforts in the area.

triage.headline_ja: ブニアのエボラ:市長が埋葬チームに安全を保証 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州ブニアで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応に関する記事であり、埋葬チームへの暴力・脅迫が封じ込め活動を阻害するリスクがあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ対応における埋葬チームへの暴力・脅迫という社会治安面の問題を扱っており、既存アウトブレイクの封じ込め継続性に関わる重要な続報。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の有無は記事中に明記されていないため不明と評価した。

article.articleHeadline: Das Ebola-Paradoxon: Warum ein bekanntes Virus immer noch überrascht
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola Paradox: Why a well-known virus still surprises.
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains paradoxical in the current Bundibugyo-virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of November 2026; no licensed vaccine exists specifically for Bundibugyo. The Ebola family includes EBOV (Zaire), Bundibugyo (BDBV), and Sudan viruses; Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) protects against Zaire EBOV but has not been proven for other species. In 1976, near the Ebola River in what is now DR Congo, the first documented outbreak occurred; Uganda (2007) and DR Congo (2012) reported prior Bundibugyo incidents. A DZIF study tests whether Ervebo triggers cross-reactive T cells against Bundibugyo and partially Sudan viruses; results show cross-reactivity but do not prove protection or disease modification. Ethically challenging to deploy without efficacy data; mass vaccination could cloud assessment. Bundibugyo infections may be less virulent, potentially promoting transmission by mobility. This highlights the urgency of broader vaccine development and targeted public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラのパラドックス：よく知られたウイルスがなぜ今なお驚きをもたらすのか
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のBundibugyoエボラウイルス種によるアウトブレイクに言及しており、有効なワクチンが存在しない点から公衆衛生上の深刻さと異常性が認められるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで進行中のBundibugyoエボラウイルス種によるアウトブレイクを前提とした科学解説記事であり、具体的な症例数・死亡者数・拡大状況の記載はない。Ugandaは過去（2007年）の事例として言及されているのみで現行のアウトブレイク地ではないため除外した。続報で症例数・地理的拡大・WHO対応状況を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Minas Gerais confirma 33 casos de mpox; Brasil registra 665 em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais confirms 33 mpox cases; Brazil records 665 in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais reports 33 mpox (Monkeypox) cases in 2026 after Confins, in the Belo Horizonte Metropolitan Region, confirmed the municipality’s first case on Saturday, Oct 31. In the state, most cases involve people aged 15–34. Nationwide, Brazil records 665 mpox cases in 2026, per Health Minister Alexandre Padilha. Rio de Janeiro state has 211 cases, with 74 diagnoses in the capital between September and October; São Paulo totals 268 cases by Nov 1. The SUS remains vigilant, with reinforced vaccine shipments to Rio de Janeiro and vaccination ongoing for groups per health guidelines. Symptoms include skin lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, body aches, chills, and fatigue. Incubation is typically 3–16 days (up to 21). Transmission occurs mainly via direct contact with lesions, secretions or fluids, contaminated objects, saliva, and sexual contact. Diagnosis is via PCR on lesion material; isolation and PPE are advised; avoid sharing personal items.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州でエムポックス33例確認、ブラジル全体で2026年665例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで継続中のMpox流行に関する定例的な症例数報告であり、重症度や国際的拡大の新規情報はないが、感染拡大の継続とワクチン対応の動向は注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内（ミナスジェライス州、リオデジャネイロ州、サンパウロ州）における2026年のMpox症例報告の定例的な集計であり、保健省主導でワクチン接種が継続されている。Cladeの特定情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: 33歲男子確診猴痘 潛伏期曾在香港與男子有高風險性接觸 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 33-year-old man diagnosed with monkeypox; during the incubation period, had high-risk contact with a man in Hong Kong.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox diagnosed in a 33-year-old man in Hong Kong. During the incubation period he had high-risk contact with a man in Hong Kong. The patient is clinically stable. He developed genital rash on Oct 21, followed by fever, with the rash spreading to the chest and limbs. On Oct 30 he sought care at North District Hospital and was admitted for isolation. Laboratory confirmation showed monkeypox virus positive by the Centre for Health Protection’s Public Health Laboratory Services. Epidemiological investigations are ongoing, and the case will be reported to the World Health Organization. This case underscores ongoing monkeypox transmission risk related to close-contact exposures, with authorities conducting contact tracing and infection-control measures. Published date: 2026-11-02.

triage.headline_ja: 33歳男性が猴痘（サル痘）確診、潜伏期間中に香港で男性とハイリスクな性的接触があった
triage.triage_reason: 香港における単発のMpox散発症例であり、重症例・クラスター拡大の情報はないが、ヒト-ヒト感染（性的接触）が確認されており継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 香港の症例は対象国リストのChina (1814991)に含める。患者は臨床的に安定しており、濃厚接触者調査が進行中。単発症例であり現時点で大規模流行の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans la Tshopo : appel à la sécurisation du personnel soignant à Bafwasende - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: Call to Safeguard Healthcare Workers in Bafwasende - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Bafwasende, Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, prompts urgent calls by zone medical chief Dr. Marcel Likilo to secure healthcare workers and restore order. Authorities must identify those responsible for the death of a nurse and the destruction of health facilities amid mob-justice rumors that medical staff are spreading Ebola. The newly built Ebola Treatment Center, funded by International Medical Corps, narrowly escaped arson on Saturday night; security guards intervened. As a result, operations at the center have halted, raising fears of outbreak escalation in the coming days. Observers urge provincial MPs to visit Bafwasende to sensitize the population and ensure swift accountability for attackers and rapid patient care. The article provides no laboratory confirmation details.

triage.headline_ja: ツショピ州のエボラ出血熱:バフワセンデで医療従事者の安全確保を求める訴え - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国バフワセンデでエボラ出血熱の発生が報告され、看護師の死亡や治療センターへの放火未遂により医療活動が停止するなど、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と拡大リスクが懸念されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事内には検査確認情報がなく、エボラの実験室診断は未確定。治療センターの運営停止や暴徒による医療従事者への暴力など、二次的な公衆衛生・治安リスクも高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mambasa : 85 cas confirmés et 51 décès enregistrés - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mambasa: 85 confirmed cases and 51 deaths recorded - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks persist in the Mambasa health zone, Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo. As of 2 November 2026, 85 confirmed Ebola cases have been recorded across four health areas in Mambasa, with 51 deaths and 15 recoveries. Nineteen patients are being treated at the Ebola Treatment Center. Response teams continue surveillance, case management, and prevention activities to limit transmission. The zone has seen an uptick in community death alerts, now totaling 18, triggering rapid Safe and Dignified Burials to prevent further spread. Health authorities urge strengthening of human resources, equipment, and logistics to bolster the outbreak response and curb propagation.

triage.headline_ja: マンバサでのエボラ出血熱:確定症例85例、死亡51例を記録 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的なアウトブレイクで致死率が高く(51/85)、人的・物的資源の不足が指摘されており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクを有するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 致死率約60%と高く、コミュニティでの死亡アラートも増加しており感染拡大の継続が懸念される。人的・物的資源の支援要請が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai Food Poisoning: Newlywed Couple Among 45 Taken Ill After Bhandup Wedding, Case Registered Against Caterer
article.articleSummary: At least 45 people, including a newlywed couple, fell ill after a wedding feast in Bhandup, Mumbai on 1 November 2026, with kalakand suspected as the source. Guests experienced vomiting and diarrhoea; 28 patients were admitted to MT Agarwal Hospital Mulund and are stable, having arrived around 11:40 pm. The Nahur West Hall function hosted ~400–500 attendees, with about 40–50 ill toward the end of the event. Additional patients were taken to Kamgar Hospital Mulund (four children), a hospital in Vikhroli (one), and Rajawadi Hospital (five; some discharged against medical advice). A case has been registered against Kalash Caterers owner Mulsingh Harisingh Rajpurohit for alleged food-quality and hygiene negligence under sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. FDA informed; stomach-wash samples collected; medical reports awaited to establish the cause.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイの食中毒：バンドゥープの結婚式で新婚夫婦含む45人が発症、ケータリング業者に対し告発状
triage.triage_reason: 単一の結婚式での食中毒事例であり、原因特定・被疑者摘発が進んでいる局地的事案。ヒト-ヒト感染の懸念はなく、国際的拡大リスクも低い。
triage.notes: 食品由来の集団発生（食中毒）で、原因食品（カラカンド）と業者が特定され法的措置も取られている。感染症のヒト-ヒト伝播の懸念はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威とは評価されない。

article.articleHeadline: 江苏疾控发布11月防病提示：深秋呼吸道肠道传染病高发，"一老一小"等重点人群需加强防护
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jiangsu CDC Issues November Disease-Prevention Tips: In late autumn, respiratory and enteric infectious diseases are on the rise, and the elderly and young children, among other high-risk groups, should strengthen protection.
article.articleSummary: Jiangsu Province, China faces a late-autumn surge in respiratory and enteric infections. The Jiangsu Center for Disease Control and Prevention highlights influenza, varicella (chickenpox), scarlet fever, scrub typhus, hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS), and carbon monoxide poisoning. Influenza is highly transmissible; priority vaccination is advised for the elderly, children, pregnant women, and those with chronic disease. For the 2026–2027 season, rural residents aged 65+ and compulsory-education students receive one free dose of the trivalent influenza vaccine; some employers offer a “two people, one free” promo for key groups. Varicella and scarlet fever remain common in schools; vaccination and strict hygiene, with isolation after illness, are urged. Scrub typhus peaks October–November; prevention includes protective clothing and timely treatment for eschars/lesions. HFRS vaccination is encouraged for 16–60-year-olds; risk is highest among farmers, loggers, and outdoor workers; rodent control and proper food storage reduce risk. For CO poisoning, ensure ventilation and detectors.

triage.headline_ja: 江蘇疾病対策センターが11月の予防提案を発表：晩秋は呼吸器・腸管感染症が流行期、「高齢者と子ども」など重点層は防護強化が必要
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の定例予防啓発情報であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す内容はない。
triage.notes: 毎年恒例の季節性感染症予防啓発記事であり、インフルエンザ、水痘、ツツガムシ病、腎症候性出血熱などの通常の秋冬季注意喚起。異常な集団発生や重症例増加の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: saiba como ocorre a transmissão e como se prevenir da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: Learn how transmission occurs and how to prevent the disease.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) is an infectious disease caused by MPXV. In Brazil, transmission occurs mainly through close contact with an infected person, including direct contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, and objects. Intimate contact, such as sexual activity, can spread the virus, and it can also transmit via shared clothing, towels, linens, and respiratory secretions in prolonged close contact. An infected person can transmit from symptom onset until all lesions crust and a new skin layer forms, making isolation a key prevention measure. Symptoms include skin lesions, fever, headache, muscle aches, chills, weakness, and lymphadenopathy; lesions may appear on face, hands, feet, mouth, and genitals, with incubation of 3–16 days. Diagnosis relies on clinical evaluation and laboratory testing when indicated. Prevention emphasizes reduced exposure, hygiene, cleaning, and PPE for caregivers; vaccination is available in Brazil for selected groups after health assessment. Suspected cases should seek care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox:感染経路と予防方法について知る
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例や症例数増加を報じるものではなく、Mpoxの感染経路・予防に関する一般的な啓発記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は疾病啓発・予防情報の一般解説であり、具体的な発生状況（症例数、地域拡大、流行動向等）の記述がないため、Brazilを含め発生地域としての検証はできない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Crisis Highlights Urgency Of Pandemic Treaty -- WHO
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged completing the international pandemic treaty as the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo persists, with nearly 5,000 deaths among more than 10,000 infections, most in DRC, after the outbreak was declared in May. He cited a recent hantavirus cruise-ship outbreak that killed three, as proof that pathogen threats anywhere threaten everyone. At the ninth meeting in Geneva aimed at finalizing the Pandemic Treaty, officials contend over how the Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing (PABS) mechanism should operate to share pathogens and benefits like vaccines, tests, and treatments. Tedros warned that no country can protect itself alone, noting Covid-19 lessons about inequitable vaccine access that prolonged the pandemic. Completing PABS is described as the key to unlocking a safer future and ending inequities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機がパンデミック条約の緊急性を浮き彫りに ― WHO
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5月以降、感染者1万人超・死者約5000人に達するエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続しており、WHOがパンデミック条約の完成を訴えるなど国際的関心・対応の必要性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行。スイス（ジュネーブ）はパンデミック条約交渉の開催地であり、発生地域ではないため除外。クルーズ船でのハンタウイルス流行は発生国が特定されておらず対象国に該当しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Epidemie im Kongo: Zahl der Todesfälle auf mehr als 5300 gestiegen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Congo: the death toll has risen to more than 5,300.
article.articleSummary: During the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, deaths have surpassed 5,300. Africa CDC reports 5,372 fatalities in DRC and two each in Uganda and Kenya, with 10,444 confirmed infections and a case fatality rate over 50%. Official notification of the outbreak occurred in mid-May, though experts believe the virus circulated undetected for months earlier; it is now the worst Ebola epidemic in DRC's history. Ebola spreads through direct contact with the body fluids of infected persons, causing fever, muscle pain, diarrhea, internal bleeding, and organ failure. Over the past 50 years, Africa has seen more than 15,000 Ebola deaths. The current outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo variant; unlike the Zaire variant, there is no approved vaccine or treatment yet, though several therapeutics are in testing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：死者数が5,300人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率50%超、国境を越えてウガンダ・ケニアにも感染拡大しており、DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行でワクチン・治療法未承認であるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアでも死者が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみ記載。Bundibugyo変異株でワクチン・治療法未承認の点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: Save the Children, entro il 2027, 30.3 milioni di persone rischiano di non avere cibo a sufficienza. L'epidemia di ebola aggrava l'emergenza per i bambini - Giornale L'Ora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Save the Children, by 2027, 30.3 million people are at risk of not having enough to eat. The Ebola outbreak worsens the emergency for children - Giornale L'Ora.
article.articleSummary: Save the Children warns that by mid-2027 roughly 30.3 million people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may face insufficient food, as the Ebola outbreak worsens a protracted hunger crisis. IPC data show 28.8 million people facing acute food insecurity (Sept–Dec 2026), up from 26.5 million (Jan–Jun 2026), with North Kivu, South Kivu and Ituri hardest hit. Ebola, alongside conflict and movement restrictions, is shrinking livelihoods and access to food and health services, increasing malnutrition risk among children, especially those under five, due to dehydration from diarrhea and vomiting. Africa CDC and WHO report over 2,700 pediatric Ebola cases and hundreds of child deaths. Between June and September 2026, 800+ children were treated for severe acute malnutrition at Save the Children–supported facilities in Ituri, exceeding expectations. The charity calls for urgent investments in food assistance and Ebola response, including food aid, safe spaces, psychosocial support, and neonatal feeding support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：セーブ・ザ・チルドレン、2027年までに3030万人が食料不足のリスク。エボラ流行が子どもたちの緊急事態を悪化させている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ流行が小児を中心に多数の死者・重症化を伴い、食料危機と相まって深刻な人道的影響をもたらしており、国際支援の必要性が明確に示されている。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存のエボラ流行による人道的・食料危機への影響を報じるものであり、新規発生の探知ではないが、流行の深刻化と国際支援の必要性が強調されているためPICKUPと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in DR Kongo: Schon fast 5.400 Tote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: Almost 5,400 Deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 5,372 deaths, with two additional fatalities each reported in Uganda and Kenya, bringing total deaths to 5,376 among 10,444 infections. The case fatality rate exceeds 50%. The outbreak was officially declared in mid-May, but experts believe the virus circulated undetected for months beforehand, making it the worst Ebola epidemic in the DR Congo's history. Ebola spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected people. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant. There is no approved vaccine or treatment at this time.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：死者数ほぼ5,400人に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率50%超、死者5,376人、感染者10,444人に達し、DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行であり、ウガンダ・ケニアへの国際拡大も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認されたワクチン・治療法がない点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ nguy kịch sau nhiễm cúm, bác sĩ lưu ý các dấu hiệu bất thường
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Child in critical condition after influenza infection; doctors warn of abnormal signs.
article.articleSummary: Eight children at Vietnam's National Children’s Hospital have developed severe complications after influenza infection, including three deaths; five remain in critical condition as of November 2, 2026. Hospitalizations for influenza A are rising. Beyond respiratory illness, influenza can trigger myocarditis, necrotizing encephalitis, and acute encephalopathy following infection (ITES). ITES denotes a group of acute brain disorders occurring during or after infection and may be linked to influenza and other viruses; brain injury may arise from post-infectious immune responses rather than direct viral invasion. A rare but serious neurological complication, acute necrotizing encephalopathy (ANE), can follow days of fever and respiratory symptoms and present with altered consciousness, drowsiness, seizures, or coma. There is no universally effective targeted therapy; management is primarily supportive, focusing on seizure control, brain edema, and multidisciplinary care. Parents should seek urgent care for fever with seizures or rapid mental-status decline.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ感染後に小児が重篤化、医師が異常な兆候に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでインフルエンザA感染後の小児死亡例・重症脳症例が報告されており、公衆衛生上の重症度が高く、メディアの注目度も高いためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は単一病院（国立小児病院）からの報告であり、国全体の流行状況や国際的拡大の証拠は不明。続報でインフルエンザA株の特定や流行範囲の拡大有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria en el Valle activa alerta sanitaria | HSB Noticias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria in the Valley triggers a health alert
article.articleSummary: As of 2 November 2026, Valle del Cauca, Colombia is monitoring two imported malaria cases caused by Plasmodium falciparum in Colombian nationals returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. One patient, 33, died on 31 October at a Palmira medical center; the second, 50, remains hospitalized in Cali. Malaria due to P. falciparum is among the most dangerous forms, risking severe complications if not identified and treated promptly. The Ministry of Health and the National Institute of Health are investigating patient itineraries, potential contacts, and whether others require follow-up. Additionally, two other travelers who had arrived from Africa are under observation and medical evaluation. No Ebola cases have been confirmed in connection with this situation. Travelers recently returning from the DRC are urged to report fever or malaise.

triage.headline_ja: バジェ県でマラリアが保健警報を発動
triage.triage_reason: コロンビア人がコンゴ民主共和国から帰国後に輸入性熱帯熱マラリアに感染し、1名が死亡、1名が入院しており、公衆衛生上の深刻性と異常性（非流行国での輸入例・死亡）からIHR基準2項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコロンビア（バジェ・デル・カウカ県）での輸入性マラリア症例と死亡であり、発生地域リストにあるDRCは患者の渡航元に過ぎず、同国内での発生事象ではないため対象国として計上していない。コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。エボラについては記事内で感染確認が否定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Officials warn 'unprecedented' disease outbreak is 'very dire': 'All countries should know that they are not safe'
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo variant) is the fastest-spreading on record in Africa, with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reporting over 10,200 cases and nearly 5,000 deaths. The World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern in May after cases emerged in the DRC. Nigeria reported its first case in more than a decade last month; Uganda had 20 cases in May–June with two deaths but currently has no active Ebola cases. The Bundibugyo strain has a high death rate and no approved treatment or vaccine. Non-African cases include a France patient who recovered after returning from the DRC in June, and a US citizen previously treated in Berlin. Transmission occurs via contact with blood, bodily fluids, or contaminated objects. In light of rapid spread, cross-border cooperation is urged; US travel rules from Nov 3 require travelers to certify no DRC exposure in the past 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: 当局が『前例のない』感染症流行は『非常に深刻』と警告:『すべての国が安全ではないことを認識すべき』
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がアフリカ史上最速の拡大を見せPHEICが宣言され、ナイジェリアでも症例確認、国際的な渡航制限も発生しておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダでの症例も記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。フランス・米国・ドイツは輸入症例のみで対象国外。DRCが主たる発生国として確定。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي إيبولا يؤكد ضرورة استكمال اتفاق الجوائح وتعزيز التعاون ‏الدولي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The Ebola outbreak underscores the need to complete the Pandemic Accord and strengthen international cooperation.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo underscores the urgent need to complete the Pandemic Accord and strengthen international cooperation, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said during the ninth round of INB negotiations in Geneva. He urged all nations to finish negotiations and resolve outstanding issues, stressing that a health threat anywhere can become a global danger. The hantavirus outbreak earlier this year and ongoing Ebola in DR Congo highlight the necessity of collective pandemic preparedness. A key sticking point remains the Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing (PABS) system, which governs exchange of samples and genetic data for pandemic pathogens in return for fair benefits such as vaccines, diagnostics, and treatments. inequities in COVID-19 vaccine distribution were cited. The WHA adopted the international agreement in May 2025; the annex on benefit-sharing was postponed, with results due at the WHA in May 2027.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラ出血熱の流行はパンデミック協定の完成と国際協力強化の必要性を裏付ける
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱流行がWHO事務局長により言及され、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として強調されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO事務局長のパンデミック協定交渉に関する発言が主題であり、新たな症例数や地域の詳細は含まれていないが、進行中のDRCでのエボラ流行を背景として言及している。続報で疫学的詳細の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Amazonas confirma 21 casos de sarampo e reforça vacinação na fronteira
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amazonas confirms 21 measles cases and reinforces vaccination at the border.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Amazonas, Brazil, with 21 confirmed cases from Sept 1 to Oct 26, spanning Brazilian and Peruvian residents, including Indigenous people, amid cross-border circulation in the Brazil-Colombia-Peru tri-border area. The Amazonas Surveillance Foundation (FVS-RCP) intensified vaccination in Tabatinga, Benjamin Constant, Santo Antônio do Içá, and São Paulo de Olivença, deploying house-to-house campaigns and vaccination drives at schools, ports, and markets to raise coverage. Vaccination is indiscriminate for ages 6 months to 59 years, regardless of prior vaccination, with support from municipal health secretariats, Indigenous districts (DSEIs), and Casai. A Dia D vaccination day is planned for November 7 to improve access. Vaccines are available at all basic health units. Since February, FVS-RCP has strengthened surveillance, trained staff, run weekly epidemiological alerts, and promoted cross-border vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾナス州、はしか21症例を確認し国境地帯でのワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ペルー・コロンビア国境地帯での麻疹の越境伝播が確認されているが、重症度や拡大規模に関する情報が限定的であり、当局が既に対応を強化している段階である。
triage.notes: ペルー・コロンビアも関連国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。地元当局（FVS-RCP）が既に積極的な対応（ワクチン接種拡大、サーベイランス強化）を実施中であり、外部支援の必要性は現時点で示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - L'épidémie d'Ebola a fait plus de 5.300 morts, selon l'Africa CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - The Ebola outbreak has killed more than 5,300 people, according to Africa CDC.
article.articleSummary: 5,376 Ebola deaths (5,372 in the Democratic Republic of Congo, 2 in Uganda, 2 in Kenya) and 10,444 cases reported in Africa, per Africa CDC as of 2 November 2026. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, centered in the DRC, with six months since official declaration; response hampered by limited resources in remote areas and armed groups. Cross-border spread includes Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths) and Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths); a Nigeria case in October involved a 42-year-old Swiss woman who had traveled to Uganda. Case fatality rate exceeds 50%. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids, causing severe hemorrhagic fever. There is no licensed vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo; initial doses of Ervebo (effective against Zaïre strain) have been given to volunteers in the DRC as part of a clinical trial.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 - アフリカCDCによると、エボラ出血熱の流行で5,300人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国を中心に致死率50%超のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国境を越えた拡大が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア（スイス人渡航者由来）での症例も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ブンディブギョ株には認可ワクチン・治療法がなく、Ervebo（ザイール株用）の臨床試験が開始されている点にも留意。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue en las Américas cae 58%, pero Colombia sigue en situación de brote y concentra la mayor cifra de casos entre los países reportados por la OPS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue in the Americas falls 58%, but Colombia remains in outbreak status and accounts for the largest number of cases among the countries reported by PAHO.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in the Americas drops 58% in 2026 through week 37, with 1,692,937 suspected cases, 523,102 lab-confirmed, 3,413 severe dengue (0.2%), and 571 deaths (case fatality 0.034%). Colombia reports the largest burden, with 83,905 suspected through week 38 and 28,677 confirmed; incidence 157.12 per 100,000 and 856 severe cases. Four dengue serotypes circulate nationwide (DENV-1–4), with DENV-3 predominant since late 2025, raising severe-disease risk upon reinfection. Colombia remains in outbreak status per the endemic channel; 16 departments (and cities like Cali, Cartagena, Barranquilla) show >30% increases. INS BES week 42 notes seven dengue deaths in that week; 94,618 cases in 2026 and 64 deaths overall. Barranquilla reports 2,895 cases; Qdenga vaccination is offered free to 9-year-olds. Chikungunya totals: 213,919 suspected cases and 88 deaths, concentrated in Brazil and Bolivia.

triage.headline_ja: 米州でデング熱が58%減少も、コロンビアは依然として流行状況が続き、PAHO報告国の中で最多の症例数
triage.triage_reason: コロンビアを中心とした既知の季節性デング熱流行の経過報告であり、IHR基準には該当しないが、重症例・死亡者数・流行継続性の観点からWPRO基準の一部に該当するため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコロンビアにおけるデング熱の流行状況（PAHO統計）であり、コロンビア・ボリビアは対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジルはチクングニア熱症例の集中地域として一文で言及されるのみで記事の主題ではないため、verified_locationsには含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Está en un estado crítico", revelan parte médico de paciente diagnosticado con malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "He is in critical condition," a medical bulletin reveals that the patient has malaria.
article.articleSummary: Four malaria cases confirmed in Colombia, triggering prevention and surveillance protocols. Two cases involve Colombian nationals who arrived in Cali and Palmira, Valle del Cauca, after traveling from the Democratic Republic of the Congo; infections are Plasmodium falciparum, the most deadly malaria species. One patient, a 33-year-old, died October 31 in Palmira; the other, a 50-year-old, is in critical condition in Cali. The remaining two cases were found through epidemiological surveillance to determine exposure and contacts; two symptomatic contacts are also malaria cases receiving treatment. Laboratory samples were taken to exclude other infections, including Ebola; Ebola risk in Cali is considered non-existent. Authorities are coordinating with Migración Colombia to trace each traveler’s route; travelers from DR Congo are urged to report symptoms such as fever.

triage.headline_ja: 「重体です」――マラリアと診断された患者の医療報告書が明らかに
triage.triage_reason: コロンビアでコンゴ民主共和国からの渡航者由来の熱帯熱マラリア（死亡1例・重症1例含む）が確認され、IHR基準の重大な公衆衛生影響と異常性の2項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: マラリア症例はコロンビア国内で診断された輸入例であり、発生地であるコンゴ民主共和国は患者の渡航元として言及されているのみで、同国内での発生事象ではないため対象国リストには含めない。コロンビア自体も対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Rio de Janeiro confirma 211 casos de mpox em 2026 e supera marca do ano anterior
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro confirms 211 mpox cases in 2026 and surpasses the previous year's record.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro recorded 211 mpox infections in 2026, with 119 suspected cases under investigation, according to CIEVS-RJ. The consolidated tally shows a 77% rise from 2025, when 119 diagnoses were confirmed; September had the highest surge in three years, with 45 confirmations. Ten patients are hospitalized for mpox treatment at Fiocruz in Manguinhos, Rio's North Zone. Health ministry reported 665 confirmed cases through Oct 2026. Rio remains second in incidence, behind São Paulo (268 diagnoses). Mpox is a zoonosis caused by MPXV, transmissible between animals and humans, and through person-to-person contact. Symptoms include skin eruptions/lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headaches, pains, chills, and weakness. Transmission occurs mainly via contact with lesions or fluids, or contaminated objects; droplet spread is possible with close contact. Guidance emphasizes avoiding contact with suspected or confirmed cases, using PPE when interaction is required, hand hygiene, isolation, and not sharing utensils, towels, or bedding until transmission ends.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ、2026年のmpox症例が211件に達し前年の記録を上回る
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでMpox症例が前年比77%増加し入院例もあるが、既知の流行病原体の継続的増加であり新規性・緊急性は限定的。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: リオデジャネイロおよびサンパウロでMpox症例が増加傾向にあり、保健省（CIEVS-RJ）が監視中。入院例は10名で重症度は中程度。既知の疾病動向の更新情報であり、新たな国際的脅威の兆候は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'épidémie a fait plus de 5 300 morts en Afrique, dont l'immense majorité en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the outbreak has killed more than 5,300 people in Africa, the vast majority in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Africa has killed more than 5,300 people, with the vast majority of deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), which remains the epicenter. Africa CDC data, provided to Agence France-Presse on 2 November 2026, highlight the outbreak’s heavy mortality burden and geographic concentration in the DRC. The excerpt does not give a breakdown between confirmed and probable cases, nor details on symptoms, transmission settings, or public health responses. The report focuses on the mortality toll and distribution, underscoring a sustained impact across the region and the need for ongoing surveillance and response efforts as of the publication date. Information is limited to the figures and location given in the Africa CDC update conveyed to AFP on 2026-11-02.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:アフリカでの流行で死者5,300人以上、その大部分がコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によるDRCを中心とした5,300人超の死者という重大な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、国際的拡大・支援の必要性も示唆されるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はAfrica CDCのデータに基づく死者数報告のみで、確定例・疑い例の内訳、感染経路、対応状況などの詳細情報は不明。継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ebola provocou mais de 5.300 mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic caused more than 5,300 deaths.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola epidemic in Africa has caused more than 5,300 deaths. Africa CDC reports 5,376 total fatalities, with 5,372 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and two in Uganda and two in Kenya, as of 2026-11-02. The outbreak, centered in the DRC—a country with more than 100 million inhabitants—was officially declared on May 15, about six months earlier, though health authorities acknowledge the virus circulated earlier. Ebola transmits via contact with bodily fluids and causes a severe hemorrhagic fever. The current epidemic is driven by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. By comparison, RDC’s previous major outbreak (2018–2020) caused about 2,300 deaths and 3,500 cases, highlighting ongoing public health risk in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行、死者5,300人以上に
triage.triage_reason: DRCを中心としたエボラ出血熱の大規模流行で死者5,300人超、複数国（ウガンダ・ケニア）への拡大が確認されており、ワクチン未承認の株による重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアでの死亡例も報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyo株による流行でワクチン・治療薬が未承認である点が重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: 中共通報一例鼠疫死亡病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CCP Reports a Fatal Case of Plague.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-02, China reports a fatal plague case amid broader concerns about a Russian incident. A 28-year-old female employee at a Russian plague-prevention research institute died in early October from an illness described as pneumonia of unknown cause, fueling speculation of a laboratory-related Yersinia pestis event. On 2026-10-29, China CDC released the September 2026 national notifiable diseases overview: eight Class A diseases in total, including seven cholera cases and one plague death, but without case-specific details (onset time or location). Plague persists in mainland China in a low-level, sporadic pattern with occasional deaths, hotspots in Inner Mongolia, Ningxia, Qinghai, and Yunnan, typically linked to wildlife exposure or pastoral activity. Reports note information-opacity concerns, with Beijing scholars and media citing a possible link to a Russian returnee in Chengdu’s Shuangliu District (Oct 16).

triage.headline_ja: 中国共産党、ペスト（鼠疫）による死亡例を1件報告
triage.triage_reason: 中国CDCの月次報告でペスト死亡1例・コレラ7例が確認されたほか、ロシアでの原因不明肺炎（ペスト研究機関職員）との関連が疑われる情報不透明性と報道関心の高まりが見られるため、詳細確認のためフルリスク評価に進める。
triage.notes: ロシアでの原因不明肺炎（ペスト研究機関職員）に関する憶測は未確認情報であり、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国側の報告は内モンゴル・青海・雲南・四川（成都）など既知の風土病多発地域での散発例として記載されているが、詳細（発症時期・場所）が公表されていない点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak kills more than 5,300 people - Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak across the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring countries has killed 5,376 people, including 5,372 in the DRC and two in Kenya and Uganda, Africa CDC data published 2026-11-02. A total of 10,444 cases have been confirmed, for a case-fatality rate above 50%. The outbreak began in mid-May, marking its 17th Ebola outbreak, and is transmitted by contact with bodily fluids causing haemorrhagic fever. It involves the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. The virus has crossed borders multiple times. Uganda has logged 20 cases (mostly travelers from the DRC) before being declared Ebola-free in August. Kenya reported nine infections in October—the country’s first Ebola case. Nigeria reported a single imported case: a 42-year-old Swiss woman in Abuja, whose husband works at the Swiss embassy; the couple had traveled to Uganda. Ervebo vaccine trials have begun but target the Zaire strain, not Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、アフリカで5,300人以上が死亡—アフリカCDC
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境拡大し、致死率50%超、承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在しないため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアでも症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株に対する承認済みワクチン・治療法は存在せず、Ervebo試験はZaire株対象のため有効性未確認。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Ancaman DBD saat Musim Hujan, Sejumlah Fasilitas Operasional di LRT Jabodebek Jalani Fogging
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware Dengue Threat During the Rainy Season as Several Jabodebek LRT Operational Facilities Undergo Fogging.
article.articleSummary: On 30 October–1 November 2026, Jakarta’s Jabodebek LRT conducted fogging at multiple operational facilities to counter rising mosquito populations during the rainy season and reduce dengue fever risk. Fogging covered sites including the Operation Control Center (OCC) offices, train stabling areas, maintenance facilities, workers’ housing, and a number of unit technical offices (UPTs), as well as other work areas with potential water accumulation or limited lighting. Radhitya Mardika, Public Relations Manager, said environmental vector control and fogging are part of broader efforts to keep the workplace healthy and safeguard service delivery. Health workers provided education on environmental cleanliness and regular checks for standing water. Safety measures during fogging included temporary evacuation, and securing food, drinks, medicines, and personal items. The piece does not report dengue cases or outbreaks; authorities stress fogging must be complemented by ongoing hygiene and preventive actions.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季のデング熱脅威に警戒、ジャボデベックLRTの複数施設でフォギング実施
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な症例や流行の報告はなく、季節性の予防的防疫活動を伝える内容であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や社会的関心の高まりは確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的な蚊防除活動（フォギング）の実施報告であり、デング熱の症例数や発生状況についての言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي الأوبئة الفتاكة يؤكد الحاجة الملحة لاستكمال معاهدة الجوائح الدولية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Health: The outbreak of deadly epidemics underscores the urgent need to complete the International Pandemic Treaty.
article.articleSummary: In Geneva on November 2, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said deadly epidemics, including the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, underscore the urgent need to finish the International Pandemic Treaty as negotiations enter their ninth round. He warned that any health threat anywhere can become global and urged nations to complete talks and resolve outstanding issues. Citing the earlier hantavirus outbreak this year alongside the ongoing Ebola situation in DRC, he highlighted persistent global health risks and the need for more effective international cooperation mechanisms. He noted that the COVID-19 experience shows no country can insulate itself from pandemics and called for equitable sharing of information and health resources. Members remain divided over the mechanism for access to pathogen samples and benefit-sharing, which governs sample/data exchange and benefits such as vaccines, therapies, and diagnostics. Finalizing this mechanism is the last step to completing the treaty.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：致死的な感染症の流行は国際パンデミック条約の早期完成の緊急性を裏付ける
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長がDRCのエボラ流行や過去のハンタウイルス流行を引き合いにパンデミック条約交渉の必要性を訴える政策的声明であり、新規の感染症発生に関する具体的なデータ（症例数、死亡者数等）が含まれていないため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO事務局長によるパンデミック条約交渉に関する政策的声明が主題であり、DRCのエボラ流行は既知の継続事象として言及されているのみで新規の疫学データはない。スイス（ジュネーブ）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Amazonas reforça vacinação contra o sarampo na região da tríplice fronteira
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amazonas reinforces measles vaccination in the Triple Frontier region.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination intensified in the Amazonas triple-border region (Brazil, Colombia, Peru) as FVS-RCP expands immunization across Tabatinga, Benjamin Constant, Santo Antônio do Içá, and São Paulo de Olivença. Indiscriminate vaccination targets ages 6 months to 59 years, regardless of vaccination history, with house-to-house visits and campaigns in schools, fairs, ports and shops. Dia D vaccination day is scheduled for November 7 (a Saturday) to boost access for those unable to reach health posts. Between September 1 and October 26, 21 measles cases were confirmed, involving Brazilian and Peruvian nationals, including Indigenous individuals. Vaccination is available at all basic health units; efforts are coordinated with Municipal Health Secretariats and Indigenous health bodies (DSEIs, Casai). Since February, reinforcement includes training, Dia S vaccination, mass-event monitoring, risk communication, and weekly epidemiological reports to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾナス州、三国国境地域での麻疹ワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ペルー・コロンビアの三国国境地域で麻疹症例が継続発生し、先住民を含む住民への感染拡大とヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があり、行政が大規模ワクチン接種で対応している。
triage.notes: ペルー・コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。症例の重症度や死亡者数に関する情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: NCDC Defends N10bn Emergency Fund, Says Allocation Covers Multiple Diseases
article.articleSummary: On 2 November 2026, Nigeria’s NCDC defended a N10 billion emergency intervention fund, clarifying it targets preparedness across multiple epidemic-prone diseases rather than Ebola alone. DG Dr. Jide Idris said the allocation strengthens prevention, early detection, rapid response and recovery for diseases including Lassa fever, cholera, cerebrospinal meningitis, diphtheria, measles, monkeypox and antimicrobial resistance. Approved by President Tinubu in June 2026 after the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo escalated to a global emergency, the fund was released directly to NCDC, not to the Presidential Task Force on EVD. Prior allocations rose from N4b (2024) to N7b (2025) and a N5b intervention fund later in 2025; the 2026 appropriation stands at N22b. Nigeria, population over 240 million, emphasizes sustained health-security investment. Regarding Ebola, Nigeria confirmed its first imported Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease case on Oct 20, 2026 in Abuja; no active cases, but 21-day contact follow-up continues.

triage.headline_ja: NCDC、100億ナイラの緊急基金を正当化し、複数疾患をカバーする配分であると説明
triage.triage_reason: 記事はナイジェリアの予算配分・行政対応に関する内容であり、対象国リストに含まれる国での具体的な感染症発生イベントを主題としていないため。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリアの予算配分に関する内容であり、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCのエボラ流行は背景情報として言及されているが記事の主題ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola Salgınında Ölü Sayısı 5 Bini Aştı: 10 Binden Fazla Vaka Var, Aşı da Tedavi de Yok
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo death toll surpasses 5,000: More than 10,000 cases, no vaccine or treatment.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed over 5,000 of 10,351 cases as of 31 October 2026, the deadliest since 2014–16. Ituri province is the epicenter, with WHO noting 7,040 confirmed cases and 3,271 deaths there (Oct 20) and the CDC counting 9,782 cases and 4,792 deaths across Ituri and North Kivu. The virus has reached 178 health zones; 50 have active transmission. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment; common symptoms include fever, severe headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and unexplained bleeding. A Bunia vaccine trial, TUMAINI, began Oct 23. International spread includes Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths), Nigeria (imported), Uganda (20), France (imported); the US has no cases. CDC imposes a Congo-travel declaration from Nov 3 to Dec 18; WHO opposes travel bans. About 80% of new infections are outside traced contact chains; 30,130 contacts are being followed, with 79.7% visited in the past 24 hours (target 95%).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行、死者数が5000人を突破：症例1万件超、ワクチンも治療法もなし
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大、渡航制限）し、WPRO基準も全て該当する重大なエボラ流行であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、フランスへの症例の国際的拡大が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストには含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。CDCは2026年11月3日から12月18日までコンゴへの渡航宣言を課しており、WHOは渡航制限に反対している。ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株による2014-16年以来最悪の流行。

article.articleHeadline: Nigerian health chiefs confirm negative results in Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Nigeria’s NCDC said two individuals were isolated as contact tracing and lab testing continued; Nigeria confirmed its first Ebola case in more than a decade on 23 October, a 42-year-old Swiss woman who travelled to Uganda and returned to Abuja. She and her husband left for Switzerland on 26 October; this remains the only confirmed Bundibugyo strain Ebola case in Nigeria. Uganda had registered 20 cases and two deaths but was declared Ebola-free by WHO in August. Kenya has nine cases and two deaths, with most infections linked to travel to the DRC, where the outbreak has killed more than 5,000 since May. DRC’s outbreak prompts CAR to tighten border checks along a 1,500-km frontier; M'Poko Bac pier checks are underway. Across the region, Ebola has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa over 50 years. Vaccine Ervebo is being tested for cross-protection against Bundibugyo, which lacks approved treatments or vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア保健当局、エボラ疑い例の検査結果が陰性であることを確認
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでの10年ぶりのエボラ症例確認に加え、DRCでは5000人以上の死者を出す大規模アウトブレイクが継続中であり、複数国への国際的拡大とCARの国境検問強化など渡航関連措置も発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでのエボラ陰性確認だが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。DRCは5000人以上死亡の大規模アウトブレイクの発生源として記事の中心的内容の一つであるため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: "Всички страни трябва да знаят, че не са в безопасност": Експерт предупреждава, че еболата може да достигне Европа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "All countries must know that they are not safe": An expert warns that Ebola could reach Europe.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in Africa shows no signs of abating. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the epidemic has recorded over 10,200 cases and roughly 5,000 deaths. Uganda reported 20 cases and two fatalities in May–June; the country currently has no active cases. The World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern in May for Congo and Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain is associated with high mortality; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment at present. Transmission occurs through contact with blood and other bodily fluids of an infected person and via contaminated objects. Outside Africa, France has confirmed a single case in a traveler from DRC; an American earlier tested positive and was treated in Berlin. In the United States, starting November 3, travelers must declare no Congo exposure within 21 days; airlines oppose the date. Dr. Jean Kaseya urges stricter border screening and preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 「すべての国が安全ではないと知るべきだ」：専門家がエボラ熱の欧州到達を警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1万人超の症例・約5000人の死者を出すエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が続き、WHOがPHEICを宣言。フランス・米国・ドイツへの国際的な症例拡大も確認されており、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダも言及されているが現在活動症例なしで、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。米国・フランス・ドイツは渡航関連の輸入症例であり、対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 5300 وفاة بـ إيبولا في إفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 5,300 Ebola deaths in Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in Africa have killed more than 5,300 people, predominantly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The DRC officially declared the outbreak on May 15, 2026; experts say the virus was detected late and resurfaced in a country with over 100 million people. Ebola, transmitted by contact with bodily fluids and causing severe febrile hemorrhagic illness, has caused more than 15,000 deaths in Africa over the last five decades. In the current Africa-wide outbreak, Africa CDC reports 10,444 cases and 5,376 deaths, with 5,372 deaths in the DRC and two deaths in Uganda and two in Kenya. The current outbreak is attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no licensed vaccine or treatment exists. Recently, doses of the Ervebo vaccine, effective against Zaire ebolavirus, were used in the DRC as part of a clinical trial.

triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアでも死亡例が報告されているが、両国は評価対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。承認済みワクチンがないブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる大規模流行であり、臨床試験としてErvebo（ザイール型用ワクチン）が使用されている点は特記事項。

article.articleHeadline: وباء إيبولا أودى بأكثر من 5300 شخص %
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola outbreak has claimed the lives of more than 5,300 people.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in Africa has claimed more than 5,300 lives, with the vast majority in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the outbreak’s epicenter. The DRC officially declared the outbreak on May 15, about six months before publication. Experts say the virus resurfaced in a country with more than 100 million people after several months. Ebola, transmitted by contact with bodily fluids and causing acute hemorrhagic fever, has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past five decades. The worst DRC outbreak on record killed about 2,300 people out of 3,500 cases between 2018-2020. According to Africa CDC data cited by AFP, the current outbreak has caused 5,376 deaths, including 5,372 in the DRC, two in Uganda, and one in Kenya, from a total of 10,444 cases. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, which currently has no approved vaccine or treatment.

triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアでも死亡例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。Bundibugyo株は承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、流行制御の難易度が高い点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: La crisis del ébola supera la barrera de los 5.100 muertos con una letalidad del 49% en la República del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola crisis surpasses the 5,100-death toll with a case fatality rate of 49% in the Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak has surpassed 5,100 deaths with a CFR of 48.8% as of October 31, 2026, per the Ministry of Public Health. Confirmed cases total 10,467, with 2,824 recoveries and 980 in isolation or Ebola Treatment Centers, across eight provinces and 67 zones. Ituri remains epicenter, 70.8% of cases; North Kivu CFR 55.7%. In past 24 hours, 53 new cases (Ituri 32, North Kivu 18, Alto Uele 3) and 45 deaths (26 community, 19 in centers) were recorded; 21 patients were discharged after negative tests. Active follow-up covers 31,621 of 36,517 contacts (86.6%). FIP publishes the 2026 Ebola Reference Guide for pharmacists, emphasizing frontline roles and precise Orthoebolavirus identification. For Zaire ebolavirus, vaccines/monoclonals exist; for Sudanense and Bundibugyoense, care is supportive with strict IPC and lab confirmation. Pharmacists should use paracetamol for fever/pain and opioids for moderate-severe pain; avoid NSAIDs and anticoagulants due to bleeding risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ危機、致死率49%で死者5,100人の大台を突破

triage.notes: Ituri州が症例の70.8%を占め震源地。North Kivuでは致死率55.7%とさらに高く、複数の異なるOrthoebolavirus種（Zaire, Sudanense, Bundibugyoense）が関与している可能性が示唆される点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Uélé : la surveillance des foyers miniers au cœur de la stratégie de lutte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Upper Uele: monitoring mining hotspots at the heart of the Ebola response strategy
article.articleSummary: As of 2 November 2026, Ebola virus disease remains the focus in the Haut-Uélé province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where mining site hubs are prioritized for surveillance as part of the national response. Governor Jean Bakomito Gambu, returning to Isiro after a three-day intra-action review (RIA) held in Kisangani (Tshopo province) with Health Ministry experts and partners, outlined progress in line with the presidential Task Force led by President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo. While coordination and response measures are praised, authorities stress sustaining epidemiological surveillance and sanitary controls in mining hotspots, seen as strategic due to population concentration and economic activity. The public is urged to maintain vigilance, observe barrier measures, and promptly report suspected Ebola symptoms to health facilities. The fight against the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak requires continuity of surveillance and mobilization of all stakeholders, particularly in mining areas with high population movement.

triage.headline_ja: オート・ウエレ州:鉱山地帯の監視をエボラ対策戦略の中心に

article.articleHeadline: Кения потребовала от Саудовской Аравии отменить ограничения из-за Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya demanded that Saudi Arabia lift restrictions due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Kenya condemned Saudi Arabia’s visa ban and entry restrictions on travelers from Kenya amid Ebola cases. On October 30, Saudi Arabia halted visa issuance for arrivals from Kenya and barred entry for anyone who had been in Kenya in the prior 21 days. Nairobi called the measures excessive and not supported by epidemiological data, demanding WHO scientific justification and warning of escalation to Africa CDC. Kenya reports nine Ebola infections and two deaths, all linked to a single imported index case; no new cases have been registered since October 19, and the outbreak is reportedly under control. The stance unfolds in a broader Ebola context, including the Democratic Republic of Congo where fatalities exceed 5,000, and a case in Nigeria linked to a Swiss embassy employee’s wife, with Kenya advocating evidence-based travel restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラを理由としたサウジアラビアの渡航制限の解除を要求
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでのエボラ発生を受けたサウジアラビアの渡航制限措置に対し、ケニア政府がWHOの科学的根拠提示やAfrica CDCへの問題提起を示唆するなど外交的緊張が生じており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・渡航貿易制限）に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアで発生したエボラ（9例・死亡2例、10/19以降新規感染なし）を巡るケニア・サウジアラビア間の渡航制限問題。DRCやナイジェリアのエボラ状況は背景情報として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題発生国ではない。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Antalet döda i ebola överstiger 5 000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola exceeds 5,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 November 2026, the current Ebola outbreak attributed to the Bundibugyo variant has resulted in 5,376 deaths from 10,444 confirmed cases since it began in mid-May in Kongo-Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo. The case fatality rate stands at about 50%. The majority of fatalities are registered in Kongo-Kinshasa, with two deaths reported in Uganda and two in Kenya. The virus has crossed borders multiple times in October, including the first recorded case in Nigeria, indicating cross-border transmission within the region. The episode is identified as Ebola virus disease (EVD) caused by the Bundibugyo variant, underscoring the ongoing cross-border spread and the scale of this outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: Ahmedabad शहर में डेंगू ने बढ़ाई चिंता, 10 महीने में ही टूट गया पिछले साल का रिकॉर्ड | Ahmedabad News Amc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Raises Concerns in Ahmedabad City; Last Year's Record Broken in Just 10 Months | Ahmedabad News Amc.
article.articleSummary: Ahmedabad, India, reports a dengue surge in 2026. Jan–Oct total dengue cases reach 1,857, up from 1,591 in all of 2025 (surplus of 266). September remains the peak month with 756 dengue cases, followed by 513 in October; comparable months last year were 448 and 258, respectively. Other mosquito-borne diseases include malaria (63 cases) and falciparum malaria (15), with chikungunya reported in 2 cases. Waterborne illnesses show Typhoid at 194 cases, along with vomiting/diarrhea (167) and jaundice (42). The Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation conducted extensive water testing in October: 52,997 chlorine tests (11 lacking chlorine) and 7,569 water samples (20 non-potable). In October, 98,515 blood samples were tested for various illnesses, with dengue serology (12,137 serum samples) yielding 513 positives. Public health measures include fogging, insecticide spraying, and ongoing disease prevention activities in affected areas.

triage.notes: 記事はインド・アーメダバード市における季節性デング熱の増加を報告。地方自治体（AMC）による水質検査・防疫活動が実施されており、国際的な拡大や渡航制限の兆候はない。重症度（死亡者数等）の情報は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Bengal: Nadia tops among districts in tuberculosis eradication campaign program
article.articleSummary: West Bengal's Nadia district tops the Pradhan Mantri TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan, with 98 of 185 village panchayats TB-free. Gold Standard: 15 panchayats report zero TB in three years; Silver Standard: 33 panchayats in two years; Bronze Standard: 50 panchayats in one year. This TB-free status reflects sustained detection, treatment, surveillance, and awareness, according to district magistrate Dr. Srikanth Palli. He notes the district's TB burden was about 30 times higher two decades ago and stresses long treatment durations, typically six to 18 months, to prevent drug-resistant TB. In Nadia, around 350 volunteers work as 'Nikshay Mitra' to assist patients with treatment and nutrition, contributing to ongoing eradication efforts.

article.articleHeadline: تفشي إيبولا في أفريقيا يقتل 5,376 شخصاً ويسجل أسرع انتشار للوباء حتى الآن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Africa kills 5,376 people and records the fastest spread of the epidemic to date.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has killed 5,376 and infected over 10,000 since May, fastest-spreading and most expansive on record, concentrated mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Africa CDC reports 5,372 deaths in the DRC, plus 2 in Kenya and 2 in Uganda. Uganda logged 20 cases, largely among people who traveled from the DRC and was declared Ebola-free in August. Kenya recorded 9 cases in October, their first. Nigeria confirmed a case in October: a 42-year-old Swiss woman whose husband works at the Swiss embassy in Abuja; the couple had traveled to Uganda before returning to Nigeria. The outbreak stems from Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or treatment yet. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids causing hemorrhagic fever. Ervebo vaccine trials have shown efficacy against the Zaire ebolavirus variant.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Africa: quasi 5.400 morti, l'epidemia più rapida mai registrata
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Africa: almost 5,400 deaths, the fastest epidemic ever recorded.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola in Africa: more than 10,000 cases since May, with 5,376 deaths as of Oct 31, spanning the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and extending to Kenya, Uganda, and Nigeria. The outbreak is the fastest Ebola epidemic on record, with a case fatality above 50%: 5,372 deaths in the DRC and two in Kenya and two in Uganda. Uganda has 20 cases, mostly travelers from the DRC, and was declared Ebola-free in August. Kenya recorded nine infections in October, its first Ebola cases. Nigeria reported one case—a 42-year-old Swiss woman whose husband works at the Abuja embassy; the pair had traveled to Uganda. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever. No licensed vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo; Ervebo vaccination trials are underway, though Ervebo targets the Zaire strain, not Bundibugyo.

triage.notes: 発生地域にはナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアも含まれるが、対象国リストにはDRCのみが該当するため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。ワクチン(Ervebo)は対象株(ブンディブギョ)に非対応で有効な治療法が存在しない点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch in Afrika: Über 5.300 Tote, schnellster bisher
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Africa: Over 5,300 deaths, fastest so far.
article.articleSummary: The ongoing Ebola outbreak in Africa is caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus and has infected over 10,000 people since May in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with 5,376 deaths (5,372 in DRC, 2 in Kenya, 2 in Uganda), making it the fastest-spreading and most widespread Ebola outbreak recorded. Uganda has 20 cases, nearly all linked to arrivals from the DRC, and was declared Ebola-free in August. Kenya reported nine infections in October, its first Ebola case. Nigeria reported a single October case involving a 42-year-old Swiss woman; the couple had traveled to Uganda before returning to Abuja. The Bundibugyo virus is rare and, unlike the Zaire strain, there is no licensed vaccine or treatment. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever. Ervebo vaccine trials have begun and show efficacy against the Zaire strain.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ出血熱が流行：死者5,300人超、過去最速の拡大

triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアでも症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主要発生国はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）。Bundibugyo株によるアウトブレイクで、ザイール株用のワクチン（Ervebo）の有効性は限定的である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Afrika'da rekor hızla büyüyen Ebola salgınında 5.376 kişi öldü
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 5,376 people died in Africa's Ebola outbreak, which is growing at a record pace.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has infected over 10,000 people since May, with 5,376 deaths as of October 31, predominantly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), where 5,372 fatalities occurred. Africa CDC notes the outbreak is the fastest-growing and most widespread on record. Kenya and Uganda have each reported two deaths and a total of 20 (Uganda) and 9 (Kenya) infections in October—the latter marking Kenya’s first Ebola cases. Nigeria reported one imported case in October: a 42-year-old Swiss woman in Abuja whose husband works at the embassy; the couple had traveled to Uganda prior to returning home. Transmission occurs via body fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo virus; Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) vaccine trials began recently and have shown efficacy against the Zaire strain.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Afrique : près de 5 400 morts dans la flambée record en RDC

Ervebo vaccine trials, shown effective against the Zaïre strain, have begun.
