article.articleHeadline: Epidemia eboli w Afryce: 5376 zabitych, najszybciej narastająca
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in Africa: 5,376 killed, the fastest-growing epidemic.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in Africa, driven by the Bundibugyo virus, has infected more than 10,000 people since May and spread to Kenya, Uganda, and Nigeria. Africa CDC reports 5,376 deaths: 5,372 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and two each in Kenya and Uganda. The DR Congo outbreak, first identified in May, exceeds 10,000 cases with a case-fatality rate over 50%, making it the fastest-growing and most widespread Ebola outbreak in history as of 31 October. Uganda recorded 20 infections, mostly among arrivals from the DRC; Kenya reported nine infections in October, their first Ebola cases. Nigeria documented a case in a 42-year-old Swiss woman whose husband works at the Swiss embassy in Abuja; the couple had previously traveled to Uganda. The Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccine or treatment. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever. Ervebo vaccine trials have begun, shown effective against the Zaire strain of Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ流行：5,376人死亡、史上最速の拡大規模
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速・最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行で、DRCを中心に複数国へ国際的拡大が確認されており、致死率も50%超と深刻なため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアでも感染確認があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認済みワクチン・治療法がない点、過去最大規模の流行である点が特に注目される。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil: São Paulo reports four cases of hantavirus infection so far this year
article.articleSummary: Four hantavirus infections have been confirmed in São Paulo state this year, with one death, per a Oct 26 alert by SES-SP highlighting a high fatality risk. Hantavirus infection, transmitted by wild rodents, can lead to heart and respiratory failure. Since 2007, São Paulo has 199 cases and 101 deaths (case fatality ~50.8%), higher than Brazil’s national CFR ~46.5%. As of Sep 2026, four local cases are recorded. Primary reservoirs in Brazil are the rice rat (Oligoryzomys) and Necromys lasiurus (field mouse) in the Cerrado. Although globally rare, hantavirus disease is typically severe in Brazil, with most patients requiring hospital care. From 1993–Mar 2026, Brazil reported about 2,400 cases and ~960 deaths; peak activity occurred 2004–2011, with CFRs up to 53%. Most activity is in the South, Southeast, and Central-West; 16 of 27 states have hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome, affecting rural, male adults 20–39 through exposure to rodents or contact with their habitats.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル：サンパウロ州、今年これまでにハンタウイルス感染4例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いハンタウイルス感染が散発的に報告されているが、症例数は少なくヒト-ヒト感染もないため国際的拡大リスクは低い。地域の風土病的性質が強く、継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: ハンタウイルスはげっ歯類からの感染でヒト-ヒト感染はなく、ブラジル南部・南東部・中西部で例年発生している風土病的疾患。致死率は高いが新規性・国際的拡大の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στην Αφρική: Σχεδόν 5.400 νεκροί στην ταχύτερα εξαπλούμενη επιδημία σύμφωνα με το Africa CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Africa: Almost 5,400 deaths in the fastest-spreading epidemic according to Africa CDC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has infected over 10,000 people since May and spread to Kenya, Uganda, and Nigeria. Africa CDC says by Oct 31 the outbreak has caused 5,376 deaths, of which 5,372 are in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, plus two in Kenya and two in Uganda. Case fatality exceeds 50%. Uganda previously reported 20 cases largely among travelers from DRC and was declared Ebola-free in August. In October Kenya recorded its first Ebola cases (9 infections); Nigeria confirmed one case in a 42-year-old Swiss woman whose husband works at the Abuja embassy; the couple had traveled to Uganda. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever. No approved vaccine or therapy exists for Bundibugyo; Ervebo vaccine trials have begun, with prior evidence of protection against Zaire ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、アフリカで史上最速の拡大ペース:Africa CDCによれば死者数5,400人近くに

article.articleHeadline: مركز أفريقي يكشف حصيلة وفيات تفشي إيبولا الأخير
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An African center reveals the death toll from the latest Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-02, Africa CDC reports 5,376 Ebola deaths across Africa from the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak, with the bulk (5,372) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and two deaths in Uganda and two in Kenya, among 10,444 total cases and a case-fatality rate above 50%. The outbreak, officially declared in the DRC about six months ago on May 15, stems from a Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain that currently has no approved vaccine or treatment. Ebola spreads by contact with infected body fluids and causes acute hemorrhagic fever. The Africa CDC data, provided to AFP, indicate most fatalities are in DRC. In recent weeks, the DRC has administered doses of the Ervebo vaccine, known to be effective against the Zaire ebolavirus strain, as part of a clinical trial, though its applicability to Bundibugyo is experimental.

triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模流行（症例10,444件、死者5,376人、致死率50%超）がDRC中心に複数国に拡大しており、承認済みワクチン・治療法がないことからIHR基準の複数に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Mắc não mô cầu có cơ hội hồi phục khi được điều trị sớm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal meningitis patients have a chance of recovery if treated early.
article.articleSummary: Neisseria meningitidis meningitis, Group B, in the Ho Chi Minh City area. A child living in Bình Dương near Ho Chi Minh City was admitted to Children’s Hospital 2 with fever and headache; CSF confirmed meningococcal meningitis Group B. After about two weeks of antibiotics, the patient recovered with no sequelae and was discharged. This hospital has treated two pediatric cases since the outbreak. In October 2026, Ho Chi Minh City saw several meningococcal cases, mainly among school-age children. A cluster of four Group B cases occurred at Hai Ba Trung Secondary School, Hiệp Phước commune; one student died from septicemia and multi-organ failure. By Oct 19, three other children were stable on antibiotics at Tropical Diseases Hospital. On Oct 21, another student in Thuong Tan commune was diagnosed. The Department of Health has mobilized Tropical Diseases Hospital and three pediatric hospitals to ensure rapid diagnosis, vaccination, and prompt treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は早期治療で回復の可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市近郊の学校で髄膜炎菌(Group B)のクラスター発生があり、死亡例を含む複数の重症例が確認されているため、WPRO基準の複数項目に該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ホーチミン市とビンズオン省の学校を中心に髄膜炎菌Group Bのクラスターが発生し、1名死亡、複数の入院例が報告されている。保健当局が複数病院を動員し対応中。続報でクラスターの拡大状況や他地域への波及、ワクチン接種状況の確認が望ましい。

article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Africa is the fastest and most expansive on record, with more than 10,000 infections and 5,376 deaths as of October 31, 2026. Originating in the Democratic Republic of Congo in May, the outbreak has spread to Kenya, Uganda, and Nigeria. Africa CDC reports 5,372 deaths in the DRC, plus two deaths in Kenya and two in Uganda. Uganda records 20 cases, nearly all linked to travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo before August when cases subsided. Kenya reports 9 cases in October, its first Ebola cases. Nigeria reports one imported case: a 42-year-old Swiss woman whose husband works at the embassy in Abuja; they traveled to Uganda before returning home. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; ERVEBO vaccine trials have begun, but ERVEBO targets Zaire ebolavirus.

Uganda reports 20 cases (primarily travelers from the DRC) and was declared Ebola-free in August. Kenya records 9 infections in October—the country’s first Ebola cases. article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي الأوبئة الفتاكة يؤكد الحاجة الملحة لاستكمال معاهدة الجوائح الدولية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Health: The spread of deadly epidemics underscores the urgent need to complete the International Pandemic Treaty
article.articleSummary: As of 2 November 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stressed that deadly epidemics, such as the Ebola outbreak continuing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and an earlier hantavirus outbreak, underscore the urgency of completing the International Pandemic Treaty. Speaking at the ninth round of negotiations in Geneva to finalize the treaty, he warned that a health threat anywhere can become a global threat and urged countries to finish negotiations and resolve outstanding issues. The continued Ebola situation in the DRC and the year’s hantavirus activity highlight ongoing global health risks and the need for more effective mechanisms for international cooperation. He noted that the COVID-19 experience proved no country can protect itself alone and emphasized equitable information and resource sharing. Members remain divided on the pathogen samples access and benefit-sharing mechanism, governing data and sample exchange and related vaccines, therapies and diagnostics.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：致死的な感染症の流行が、国際パンデミック条約完成の緊急性を裏付ける
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はWHO事務局長によるパンデミック条約交渉に関する政治的声明が主題であり、DRCのエボラ流行やハンタウイルスは既知の継続事例として言及されているのみで、新規の疫学的情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はジュネーブでのパンデミック条約交渉に関するWHO事務局長の発言が主旨であり、DRCのエボラ流行は既存の継続中事例として引用されているに過ぎない。新規シグナルとしての価値は低いが、DRCのエボラ流行自体は既知の重大事案として別途モニタリング対象である可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief: Ebola outbreak shows urgent need for pandemic treaty
article.articleSummary: 2 November 2026 - WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that recent Ebola outbreaks and hantavirus show why the international public health treaty must be finalised without delay. The deadly Ebola Bundibugyo virus outbreak ongoing in Africa and an earlier hantavirus outbreak underline the urgency of the Pandemic Treaty. Negotiations in Geneva come as countries remain at odds over how the agreement's core mechanism, the Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing (PABS) system, should operate. PABS would govern how pathogen samples with pandemic potential are shared and how products such as vaccines, tests and treatments derived from them are distributed. Tedros argued that completing the treaty is about protecting people, since a threat anywhere can become a threat everywhere, including the ongoing Ebola epidemic in the DRC. Hans Kluge noted that timely access to vaccines and affordable medicines was a recurring concern in COVID-19, reinforcing calls for fair sharing and rapid data exchange.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長:エボラ出血熱の流行がパンデミック条約の緊急性を示している
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、WHO事務局長が国際的な対応の緊急性を強調しているため、フルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はジュネーブでのパンデミック条約交渉に関する内容だが、エボラ流行の実際の発生地はDRCであるためDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。スイス・ジュネーブは交渉の場であり発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-Chef Tedros: Neue Virusausbrüche machen Pandemievertrag dringlich
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General Tedros: New Virus Outbreaks Make the Pandemic Treaty Urgent.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns that recent deadly outbreaks of the Ebola Bundibugyo virus in Africa and a resurgence of Hantavirus underscore the urgent need to finalize the Pandemic Treaty. While the framework was approved last May to guide responses to future COVID-like pandemics, countries have yet to determine how its central instrument will function, including the Pathogen Access and Benefit‑Sharing System (PABS) for procuring pathogens with pandemic potential and distributing vaccines, tests, and treatments. Tedros stressed that protecting people requires timely, equitable access and rapid data and specimen sharing. He cited the year’s Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and current Hantavirus outbreaks as reminders that a threat anywhere can threaten everywhere. WHO Europe Director Hans Kluge echoed calls for a system ensuring fair allocation of vaccines and medicines, preventing past inequities from repeating.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長テドロス氏:新たなウイルス流行がパンデミック条約を急務にする
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行とハンタウイルスの再燃に言及しているが、本記事はパンデミック条約の必要性を論じる政策的内容であり、具体的な症例数・規模等の詳細情報が不足しているため続報注視とする。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOのパンデミック条約に関する政策論評が主題で、エボラ・ハンタウイルスの発生詳細（症例数、地域、期間等）は言及されていない。DRCでのエボラ流行について具体的データが得られ次第、フルRRAでの再評価を推奨する。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ébola causa más de 5 mil muertos según agencia UA

Transmission occurs through contact with bodily fluids and leads to severe hemorrhagic fever. Context: Africa’s Ebola history includes over 15,000 deaths in the last 50 years; the worst RDC outbreak (2018–2020) caused about 2,300 deaths and 3,500 cases.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans le Haut-Uele : la population appelée à s'impliquer d'avantage dans la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uele: the population urged to get more involved in the response - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Haut-Uele, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompted a call from the provincial governor for intensified community involvement in the response. At a meeting evaluating the Ebola epidemiological situation in the affected provinces of the Greater East, the governor urged residents to strengthen community engagement, adhere to prevention measures, and regularly monitor field activities, with emphasis on mining-area households. Haut-Uele’s response teams were praised, and provincial decisions have helped limit spread; officials say the province is on the right track. Upon returning to Isiro, the Matari airport was a hub for the governor’s reception by the vice-governor and security and provincial government members. The report underscores community participation as crucial to eradicating Ebola in Haut-Uele and the broader northeast.

triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国ハウト・ウエレ州でエボラの対応継続中であり、重症度・流行可能性が高く、行政・住民双方の関心も確認されるためフルリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta: surtos recentes de vírus mostram urgência em concluir tratado pandémico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns: Recent virus outbreaks show urgency to finalize a pandemic treaty.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 November 2026, the WHO warns that recent deadly outbreaks underscore the urgency to finalize the Pandemic Treaty. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cites the ongoing Ebola Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and a hantavirus outbreak earlier this year as examples of why a global framework is needed. The Pandemic Treaty, approved in May 2025, still lacks operational details for its core mechanism, the Access to Pathogens and Benefit-Sharing (PABS) system, which would govern acquisition of potentially pandemic pathogens and distribution of derived vaccines, diagnostics and therapeutics. Wealthier and poorer nations remain at odds over how the treaty should function in practice. Tedros emphasizes that a pathogen threat anywhere can become a threat everywhere, and notes delays in vaccine access during COVID-19. Hans Kluge urges rapid sample and data sharing and fair access to vaccines and medicines to avoid repeating inequalities.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告:最近のウイルス流行はパンデミック条約締結の緊急性を示している
triage.triage_reason: 記事はパンデミック条約の政策議論が主題であり、DRCのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行自体への新規情報は乏しいが、進行中のアウトブレイクとして継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOのパンデミック条約に関する政策提言が主眼であり、DRCのエボラ流行の詳細（症例数・死亡者数等）は記載なし。既知のアウトブレイクに関する既存情報として扱うべきか、別途RRA済みか確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: رئيس منظمة الصحة العالمية يدعو لاستكمال اتفاقية الجائحة بعد تفشيات قاتلة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General urges completion of the pandemic treaty after deadly outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged completing the global pandemic treaty without delay, citing recent deadly outbreaks of Bundibugyo Ebola virus and hantavirus in Africa as proof of urgency. Speaking at a Geneva negotiation, he said the treaty, adopted May 2025, must finalize the Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing (PABS) mechanism to secure high-risk pathogens and equitably distribute vaccines, tests, and treatments. Persistent divisions between rich and developing countries over how the mechanism should operate threaten the treaty’s effectiveness. He recalled COVID-19 lessons: vaccines were developed rapidly, but many countries were left waiting while others received surplus doses. Hans Kluge, WHO Europe regional director (on leave while seeking the director-general post), emphasized timely, affordable access and a system to share samples and data quickly, ensuring equitable sharing of products derived from them and avoiding past inequities. Ongoing Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo were cited as context for urgency.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、相次ぐ致死的アウトブレイクを受けパンデミック条約の早期完成を訴える
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国での致死的なエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクを緊急性の根拠として挙げており、重症度・流行性・国際支援の必要性が高く社会的関心も強いため。
triage.notes: 本記事はパンデミック条約交渉に関するWHOの政策的声明が主題であり、エボラ・ハンタウイルスの具体的な疫学データ（症例数・死亡数・地域拡大状況等）は提供されていない。DRCでのエボラ発生は既知の継続中アウトブレイクとして言及されているため、詳細はRRAまたは続報で確認が必要。スイス（ジュネーブ）は発生地域ではなく会議開催地のため対象外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-főigazgató: a halálos víruskitörések sürgetik a pandémiaszerződés lezárását
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General: Deadly Virus Outbreaks Are Pressing for the Conclusion of the Pandemic Treaty.
article.articleSummary: 2026-11-02: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged rapid finalization of the Pandemic Treaty, citing recent Africa-wide deadly outbreaks, including Ebola Bundibugyo virus and hantavirus, as proof of the need. He warned that a pathogen threat anywhere can become a threat everywhere, pointing to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and recent hantavirus activity. Negotiations remain divided between wealthy and developing countries over how the treaty’s core mechanism should function; the agreement, adopted in May 2025, left key operational details unresolved. The Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing (PABS) system would govern access to high-risk pathogens and the distribution of vaccines, tests, and treatments. Tedros urged a system for rapid sample and data sharing with equitable access to countermeasures, noting COVID-19-era inequities; European regional director Hans Kluge agreed on the need for timely access.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長：致命的なウイルスの発生がパンデミック条約の締結を後押し
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長がパンデミック条約交渉促進の文脈でDRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）とハンタウイルスの流行に言及しているが、具体的な症例数・死亡者数等の疫学データが本記事に含まれておらず、新規シグナルとしての評価に必要な情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOのパンデミック条約交渉に関する政策報道が主題であり、DRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は既知情報として引用されているのみ。症例数・地理的拡大状況等の一次情報がないため、DRCのエボラ発生状況について別途続報を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Oms, Tedros: le nuove epidemie di Ebola e hantavirus mostrano l'urgenza del trattato pandemico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO, Tedros: the new epidemics of Ebola and hantaviruses show the urgency of the pandemic treaty
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that recent outbreaks of the Ebola Bundibugyo virus spreading across Africa and hantavirus outbreaks in early 2026 underscore the urgent need to finalize the International Pandemic Treaty. Adopted in May 2025, the treaty's core mechanism, Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing (PABS), outlines how potentially pandemic pathogens are accessed and how vaccines, tests, and treatments derived from them are shared. Negotiations in Geneva have exposed disagreements between rich and developing countries on operational details. Tedros stressed that during COVID-19 the world quickly developed vaccines, but many nations waited while others secured excess supply. He called for rapid sharing of pathogen samples and data and for equitable access to vaccines, diagnostics, and medicines to prevent repeating past inequities, including the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and hantavirus events in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、テドロス事務局長：エボラ出血熱とハンタウイルスの新たな流行はパンデミック条約の緊急性を示している
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国における進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行とアフリカでのハンタウイルス発生に言及しており、国際的公衆衛生上の懸念及び国際支援の必要性が示されているため。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOのパンデミック条約交渉に関する政策的文脈が主だが、コンゴ民主共和国における進行中のエボラ流行について具体的に言及されているため、当該国を発生地域として検証対象とした。ハンタウイルスについては『アフリカ』とのみ記載され具体的対象国が特定できないため、verified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Bunia : " fermer un CTE ne signifie nullement la fin de l'épidémie " - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bunia: "Closing an Ebola Treatment Center does not mean the end of the epidemic" - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola persists in Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, despite the announced closure of the Elikya Ebola Treatment Center. As of 2 November 2026, confirmed cases continue in multiple health zones and community deaths are being reported after a period of decline. Dr. Justin Munkokole, head of the response care pillar, notes that closing a treatment center does not end the outbreak; several centers were established, and as case numbers drop, centers are reduced and staff redeployed to remaining hotspots. The overall transmission trend is downward, but surveillance and rapid response must be maintained. In the Bunia health zone, ongoing transmission and community deaths indicate persistent activity. Residents are urged to maintain barrier measures to prevent a resurgence and help bring the epidemic to a close.

triage.headline_ja: ブニアでのエボラ出血熱：「ECTの閉鎖は流行の終息を意味しない」―ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2の即時通知対象疾患であり、DRCで感染が継続中であることから、フルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中アウトブレイク（DRC・イトゥリ州ブニア）の続報。治療センター閉鎖後も地域社会での死亡例が報告されており、サーベイランス継続の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: प्रधानमंत्री टीबीमुक्त भारत अभियान में पश्चिम बंगाल का नदिया जिला अव्वल, 98 ग्राम पंचायतें बनीं टीबीमुक्त | Bengal: Nadia tops among districts in tuberculosis eradication campaign program (Photo: @SuvenduWB/X)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Prime Minister's TB-Free India Campaign, West Bengal's Nadia district tops the list; 98 gram panchayats have become TB-free.
article.articleSummary: West Bengal’s Nadia district has achieved the top spot in the Prime Minister’s TB-Free India Campaign, with 98 of its 185 gram panchayats declared TB-free. Under Gold Standard (no TB in 3 years) 15 panchayats; Silver Standard (no TB in 2 years) 33 panchayats; Bronze Standard (no TB in 1 year) 50 panchayats. The district administration attributes this to intensified TB detection, regular treatment, surveillance, and awareness. District Magistrate Dr. Shrikant Palli notes that about 20 years ago, TB cases in Nadia were roughly 30 times higher. Treatment duration ranges 6 to 18 months depending on severity. He emphasizes adherence to the full course to prevent drug-resistant TB. Approximately 350 volunteers, termed 'Nishtha Mitra', assist affected people with treatment and nutrition. This reflects ongoing efforts to consolidate progress toward elimination under the national TB program.

triage.headline_ja: 首相TBフリー・インディア・キャンペーンで西ベンガル州ナディア県がトップに、98のグラムパンチャーヤトがTBフリーに
triage.triage_reason: 結核撲滅キャンペーンの成果報告であり、新規の公衆衛生リスクや異常な流行を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核撲滅プログラムの進捗・成功事例を報じるポジティブなニュースであり、感染症危機シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : inquiétudes face au relâchement des mesures barrières à Bunia - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Concerns over the easing of protective measures in Bunia - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola concerns persist in Bunia, Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, despite a general downward trend in cases. Dr. Justin Munkokole, head of the Ebola response pillar in Ituri, warns that easing protective measures risks a resurgence, noting that the decline should not be mistaken for an end to the outbreak. Ongoing transmission pockets and the persistence of confirmed cases and community deaths in the Bunia health zone indicate continued risk, with some residents resisting interventions such as decontamination, listing and follow-up of contacts. The official calls for heightened community involvement to sustain the response and prevent a rebound, stressing that relaxation in outbreak control can cause the curve to rise. No specific case counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ブニアで感染予防策の緩和に懸念 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準に該当しやすい重篤な疾患であり、DRCブニアで感染対策緩和による再燃リスクが報告されているため、フルRRAによる継続評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラ流行の継続事案であり、具体的な症例数は記事内に記載なし。コミュニティの抵抗と対策緩和により再拡大リスクが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : insuffisance logistique et personnel non formé parmi les défis à Mambasa - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: logistical shortcomings and untrained personnel among the challenges in Mambasa - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola response in Mambasa, Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, is hampered by logistics and staffing gaps. Since response began on May 21, 2026, providers have been paid only once; the zone reports three months without operating costs, fuel, or adequate funding. Dr. Yunga Abedi, the zone health chief, highlights shortages of qualified personnel across response pillars, notably risk communication and community engagement (CREC) and infection prevention and control (PCI). Mobility bottlenecks impede dignified and safe burials (EDS); three EDS teams operate with only one vehicle to move staff and transport bodies. The zone typically records four to six deaths per day, but currently has 18 community death alerts, signaling delays in interventions due to transport constraints in the Ebola response.”} }{type:

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：マンバサにおける物流不足と未訓練の人員が課題に - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州マンバサで進行中のエボラ対応において、資金・物流・人員不足により地域社会での死亡アラートが増加しており、対応能力の限界が示唆されるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のエボラ流行（2026年5月21日開始）の対応状況に関するもので、新規発生ではなく資金・物流課題を主題としている。地域社会の死亡アラートが通常の4〜6件/日に対し18件と増加しており、対応遅延による拡大リスクに注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola deaths pass 5,000 as Ituri review may raise toll
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed 5,058 people among 10,414 confirmed cases (case fatality rate 48.6%) as of 30 October 2026. An Ituri province death review could raise the toll to 5,372 (51.6%), but current figures remain lower while validation continues. Declared 15 May, the outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain; there is no approved vaccine or targeted treatment for this strain. Frontline workers in Ituri have received Ervebo (Zaire strain) as potential cross-protection, and a Bunia vaccine trial is underway. Ituri accounts for 70.9% of cases, with transmission across 67 of 178 health zones in eight provinces. The 30 October update recorded 63 new cases and 32 deaths (23 community deaths). Cross-border spread includes Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths) linked to Congo travel via Uganda; Nigeria reports one imported case from Uganda treated in Switzerland. US travel rules tighten from 4 November to require Congo-exposure screening within 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が5,000人を突破、イトゥリ州の再調査で増加の可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は死者5,000人超・致死率48.6%に達し、承認ワクチンなし、周辺国（ケニア・ナイジェリア）への越境拡大と米国の渡航規制強化も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（特にイトゥリ州）が震源地。ケニア・ナイジェリア・米国・スイスへの波及は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ブンディブギョ株に対する承認ワクチン・治療法が存在しない点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 【禁聞】中共低調通報鼠疫死亡病例 陸媒沉默 | 深圳APEC峰會 | 菜刀上鎖 | 安保
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Forbidden News] The CCP Quietly Reports Plague Deaths; Mainland Media Silent | Shenzhen APEC Summit | Locking Up Kitchen Knives | Security
article.articleSummary: China reports 1 plague death on Oct 29, 2026, with no disclosed details; Sept 2026 national infectious disease overview lists 8 Class A cases—7 cholera and 1 plague—resulting in 1 plague death, but only limited information on the deceased (name, age, province, infection route, and strain). Earlier, a Russian plague research institute employee died in early October from unknown pneumonia, fueling online rumors of a laboratory plague virus leak, though officials have not confirmed spillover. Mid-October, a Chengdu Shuangliu District resident with fever was linked to a person returning from Russia, but no official notification followed. As Shenzhen prepares for the APEC Summit, security is intensified and a “Xinjiang-style” knife-lock policy spreads to the city, with reports of restaurant kitchen knives being chained. Online posts claimed plague reached Henan, Inner Mongolia, Shanghai, and Chongqing, but mainland media remained silent. (Published 2026-11-02)

triage.headline_ja: 【禁聞】中共、ペスト死亡例を低調に通報も中国メディアは沈黙｜深圳APEC首脳会議｜包丁の施錠｜警備強化
triage.triage_reason: 中国でペスト（検疫法上のA類感染症）による死亡例が公式に報告されているが、詳細情報が極めて限定的で、他省への拡大はオンライン上の未確認情報にとどまる。透明性の欠如により続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は政治色の強いメディア（NTD、法輪功系）による報道であり、ペストの河南・内モンゴル・上海・重慶への拡大は未確認のオンライン上の噂として扱われている。公式確認済みの情報は2026年9月の全国統計（コレラ7例、ペスト1例・死亡1例）および10月29日のペスト死亡報告のみ。ロシアの研究所職員の死亡との関連も未確認。続報での公式発表を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Șeful OMS cere măsuri urgente după noile focare de virusuri mortale: "Lumea a dezvoltat vaccinuri în timp record, dar prea multe țări au fost lăsate să aștepte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief calls for urgent measures after new deadly virus outbreaks: "The world has developed vaccines in record time, but too many countries have been left waiting."
article.articleSummary: The WHO chief, Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, urges urgent action to operationalize the Pandemic Treaty adopted in 2025, focusing on the pathogen access and benefit-sharing (PABS) mechanism that governs obtaining pandemic pathogens and distributing derived vaccines, tests, and treatments. Citing recent deadly outbreaks—an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and a hantavirus outbreak earlier this year—he warns that a threat anywhere is a threat everywhere. The report notes persistent inequities during COVID-19, where vaccines were developed rapidly but many countries faced delays in access. WHO Europe regional director Hans Kluge reiterates the need for timely data and sample sharing and insists that vaccines and medicines be distributed equitably, cautions against repeating the disparities seen in the COVID-19 era. The article frames these measures as essential to protect global health and prevent future pandemics.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、致死的ウイルスの新たな流行を受け緊急対応を要請:「世界はワクチンを記録的な速さで開発したが、多くの国々が待たされたままだ」
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長によるパンデミック条約運用化を求める政策的発言記事であり、DRCのエボラ流行やハンタウイルス流行に言及しているが、いずれも具体的な新規発生情報や規模・重症度の詳細が記載されておらず、情報不足のため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO事務局長によるパンデミック条約・PABSメカニズムの運用化を求める政策論評が主題であり、DRCのエボラ流行は過去の事例として引用されている。新規の一次情報としての詳細（症例数、死亡者数、発生時期・地域の具体性）は記載がないため、フルリスク評価に進む根拠は現時点では不十分。

article.articleHeadline: Amazonas intensifica vacinação contra o sarampo - Amazonas | Portal do Holanda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amazonas ramps up measles vaccination - Amazonas | Portal do Holanda
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak response in Brazil's Amazonas: 21 cases confirmed between Sept 1 and Oct 26 in the tri-border region with Colombia and Peru, involving Brazilians and Peruvians including Indigenous people. The Amazonas Health Surveillance Foundation (FVS-RCP) is intensifying vaccination in strategic municipalities Tabatinga, Benjamin Constant, Santo Antônio do Içá, and São Paulo de Olivença. Strategy uses house-to-house outreach and high-traffic locations such as schools, fairs, ports, and shops. Target population: 6 months to 59 years, regardless of prior vaccination. Day D vaccination drive scheduled for Saturday, Nov 7; vaccines available at all basic health units. Ongoing surveillance and emphasis on keeping immunization records up to date to prevent spread to other parts of the state. Efforts align with February directives with the Ministry of Health, including training and lab capacity and transparent data sharing.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾナス州、麻疹ワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・コロンビア・ペルーの三国国境地域で麻疹21例が確認され国境を越えた感染拡大の兆候があるが、重症度や社会的関心の高まりは不明であり、現時点では自治体レベルのワクチン接種対応に留まっている。
triage.notes: コロンビア・ペルーも関与しているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。先住民を含む脆弱な集団への感染拡大と、国境を越えた人の移動による拡散リスクに注意が必要。続報（11月7日のワクチン接種デーの結果等）を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 【早間】鼠疫登革熱皆保密 中共僅證實一人染鼠疫亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Morning Edition: Both plague and dengue fever kept secret; the CCP has only confirmed one person infected with plague who died.
article.articleSummary: As of November 2, 2026, Russia’s plague outbreak remains unclear. China’s CDC reported that in September more than 2,000 infectious-disease deaths occurred, with one death attributed to plague; the victim’s identity and transmission details were not disclosed. In Sanya, Hainan, dengue fever outbreaks were reported at several construction sites, with hundreds infected and thousands quarantined, but no official public report. In Chengdu’s Shuangliu District, a fever patient prompted inquiries about plague; testing for plague was not performed, and local staff said plague information is confidential and that no plague investigations were underway. Online posts claimed plague in Henan, Inner Mongolia, Shanghai, and Chongqing, which authorities denied. Separately, in Pingdingshan, Henan, a father infected with a Kansas bacterium died after 27 days; in Xinxiang, a brother died two months after mucormycosis. Rights groups condemn press suppression.

triage.headline_ja: 【早報】ペストとデング熱はいずれも隠蔽、中共はペストによる死亡者1名のみ確認
triage.triage_reason: 中国CDCがペスト死亡例を確認し、海南省三亜市では数百人規模のデング熱アウトブレイクが報告される一方、複数地域での情報隠蔽疑惑があり、公衆衛生上の深刻性と社会的関心の高さからフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: ロシアのペスト流行については対象国リストに含まれないため除外。河南・内モンゴル・上海・重慶でのペスト疑惑は当局が否定しており未確認情報。情報源（NTD）は中国政府に批判的な立場のメディアであり、報道内容の独立検証が必要。

article.articleHeadline: N10bn not enough to tackle Ebola, other epidemics, says NCDC
article.articleSummary: Nigeria’s NCDC says the N10 billion emergency intervention fund approved by President Tinubu is insufficient to tackle Ebola and other epidemic‑prone diseases. Nigeria requires about N104.4 billion annually to implement the National Action Plan for Health Security (NAPHS 2.0, 2025–2029), with a five‑year cost of N522 billion. The N10 billion equals roughly 2% of annual costs. The fund aims to strengthen prevention, preparedness, early detection, rapid response and resilient recovery for diseases including Lassa fever, cholera, meningitis, diphtheria, measles, Mpox and antimicrobial resistance, in addition to Ebola. It was released to NCDC, not the Ebola task force. Tinubu’s funding for NCDC has risen from N4B (2024) to N7B (2025), then N22B (2026) and an extra N10B approved in June 2026 after a Bundibugyo Ebola case in the DRC. Nigeria had no active Ebola cases after Oct 20; monitoring continues for 21 days. Global estimates suggest $240–$480 million annually for Nigeria’s 240 million people; no mass gathering bans or election postponement recommended.

triage.headline_ja: NCDC、「100億ナイラでは不十分」とエボラなど感染症対策予算の不足を指摘
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリア当局がDRCで発生したブンディブギョ型エボラ症例を契機に緊急予算を計上し国境を越えた監視を行っている点、及びエボラという重篤な感染症が関与している点から、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の該当が認められるためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はナイジェリアNCDCの予算不足に関する政策的議論だが、その背景にDRCでのブンディブギョ型エボラ症例があり、ナイジェリア国内での21日間監視が継続中とされる。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外し、実際の感染症発生国であるDRCのみを記載した。続報でDRCにおける症例数・感染拡大状況の詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kanem : lancement de la campagne annuelle conjointe de vaccination contre la PPR et la PPCB entre le Tchad et le Niger - Tchadinfos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kanem: Launch of the Annual Joint Vaccination Campaign Against PPR and CBPP Between Chad and Niger - Tchadinfos
article.articleSummary: On November 2, 2026, Chad’s Minister of Livestock Pr Abderahim Awat Atteïb presided in Tchili, Kanem, near Mao, over the official launch of the joint vaccination campaign against Peste des petits ruminants (PPR) and Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP) for 2026–2027. Attending were the General Delegate of the Government for Kanem, General Issaka Koty Yacoub, a provincial council representative, local authorities, a sizable Nigerien delegation, and numerous livestock-sector actors. After Liwa (Lac Province) and Sayam (Diffa, Niger), Tchili hosts the campaign’s kickoff. The initiative reflects the Chad government’s and partners’, notably PRAPS-2, commitment to strengthening animal health and supporting the pastoral sector’s development. Beyond the launch, authorities aim to bolster prevention against health threats by vaccinating both small ruminants and cattle to reduce disease spread and protect herds.

triage.headline_ja: カネム：チャドとニジェール間でPPR及びCBPPに対する年次合同ワクチン接種キャンペーンが開始
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（小反芻獣疫・牛肺疫）に対する予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンの開始を伝える内容であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な発生事象ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はチャドとニジェールの家畜（小反芻獣・牛）を対象とした予防接種キャンペーンに関するものであり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。人獣共通感染症としてのヒト感染リスクの記載もない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO zbog ebole i hantavirusa traži hitan dogovor o budućim pandemijama
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO seeks urgent agreement on future pandemics over Ebola and hantaviruses.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros warned in Geneva that an urgent, workable future pandemics framework is needed, citing the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak spreading in Africa and a current hantavirus outbreak, along with the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Although a pandemic treaty was adopted in May 2025, negotiators have not resolved the core mechanism, the PABS system, which governs exchange of samples and data on dangerous pathogens and the fair allocation of vaccines, tests, and medicines developed from them. Hans Kluge, WHO Europe regional director, urged a system enabling rapid sample/data sharing coupled with equitable, affordable access to vaccines and medicines, highlighting disparities seen during COVID-19. The aim is to prevent any pathogen from becoming a global threat by ensuring timely collaboration and equity across regions.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱とハンタウイルスを受けて将来のパンデミックに関する緊急合意を求める
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクがアフリカ内で拡大しているとWHOが言及しており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOのパンデミック条約交渉（PABSシステム）に関する国際的政策記事だが、DRCでのエボラ・ブンディブギョ株アウトブレイクおよびアフリカでのハンタウイルスアウトブレイクが実際の感染症イベントとして言及されている。スイス・ジュネーブはWHO本部の所在地であり、発生地域ではないため除外した。ハンタウイルスの発生国は本文中で特定されておらず対象国リストに該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Uma ameaça em qualquer lugar pode tornar-se uma em todo o lado": OMS deixa aviso após novos surtos de vírus mortais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "A threat anywhere can become one everywhere": WHO issues warning after new outbreaks of deadly viruses.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns that a threat anywhere can become a threat everywhere, urging finalization of the Pandemic Accord to strengthen global health preparedness. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cites the Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and a hantavirus outbreak earlier this year as examples of how infectious diseases cross borders and require rapid threat identification, data sharing, and access to diagnostics and treatments. The Pandemic Accord, adopted in May 2025, lacks a crucial component—the Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing (PABS) mechanism—that would govern sharing of samples and information and ensure equitable distribution of vaccines, tests, and therapeutics. European regional director Hans Kluge supports rapid, fair access to medical tools. Negotiations in Geneva continue until 13 November 2026 to resolve PABS and operationalize the Accord.

triage.headline_ja: 「どこかの脅威はあらゆる場所の脅威になり得る」：WHOが新たな致死性ウイルスの発生を受けて警告
triage.triage_reason: 記事はWHOのパンデミック協定交渉に関する政策的声明が主題であり、DRCのエボラ出血熱流行やハンタウイルス流行は例示として言及されているのみで、具体的な症例数・最新状況などの新規疫学情報が不足しているため。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はWHO事務局長によるパンデミック協定（PABSメカニズム）推進の呼びかけであり、DRCのエボラ出血熱とハンタウイルス流行は過去の事例として引用されているのみ。新規の症例数や発生状況の詳細は記載されていないため、具体的な疫学的評価のためには続報の確認が必要。スイス（ジュネーブ）は交渉開催地であり発生地域ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: ₦10bn Intervention Fund Not For Ebola Only, Covers Multiple Disease Threats -- NCDC
article.articleSummary: Nigeria's ₦10 billion emergency intervention fund, approved in June 2026 amid the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak, was released directly to the NCDC to bolster broader health security: prevention, preparedness, early detection, rapid response and recovery for diseases including Ebola, Lassa fever, cholera, meningitis, diphtheria, measles, monkeypox and antimicrobial resistance. NCDC Director-General Dr. Jide Idris said the money was not for the Presidential Task Force on Ebola but for wider national health security, noting it represents about 2% of the five-year National Action Plan for Health Security (NAPHS) 2.0, costing ~₦522 billion (≈₦104.4 billion annually). Budgeted allocations rose from ₦4B (2024) to ₦7B (2025) to ₦22B (2026); a ₦5B fund in 2025 preceded the ₦10B boost. Idris cited a Global Preparedness Monitoring Board gap of US$240–US$480 million annually for 240 million Nigerians, in the context of the imported Bundibugyo Ebola case confirmed in October, and urged transparency to curb misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: 100億ナイラの緊急対策基金はエボラ専用ではなく、複数の疾病脅威に対応――NCDC
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はナイジェリアの健康安全保障基金の予算配分に関する政策報道であり、DRCのエボラ流行やナイジェリアでの輸入症例（Bundibugyo株）については詳細情報が乏しいため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリアの予算配分政策（NCDC向け100億ナイラ基金）が主題で、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのエボラ流行は背景情報として言及されているが、輸入症例（Bundibugyo株、10月確認）の詳細（感染経路、患者状況、対応措置など）が記事内に記載されておらず、情報不足のためWATCHと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: 50 años después, un virus conocido sigue sin vacuna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 50 years later, a known virus still has no vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Fifty years after the first Ebola outbreak in the region now called the Democratic Republic of Congo, an ongoing RDC outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), a less common Ebola species. BDBV was identified in Uganda in 2007 and caused Congo outbreaks in 2012; currently, no vaccine is approved for Bundibugyo. The Ervebo vaccine targets the Zaire strain and offers limited benefits for Bundibugyo. The Tumaini study in Congo tests several vaccine candidates—an Oxford University vaccine candidate, a Moderna mRNA vaccine, and Ervebo—to assess efficacy against BDBV. Ebola vaccines are more effective for some species than others, fueling longer-term efforts for a universal vaccine. Bundibugyro may be less virulent but could hinder containment due to longer infectious periods and subtler symptoms. Large-scale vaccination could be feasible by mid-2027 if efficacy is demonstrated.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：50年後も、既知のウイルスにワクチンなし
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のBundibugyoエボラウイルス（BDBV）による流行が継続しており、承認されたワクチンが存在しない状況。IHR基準で複数該当し、国際的な研究・支援の動きもあることからフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ発見50周年を振り返る内容だが、DRCで継続中のBundibugyoウイルス（BDBV）によるアウトブレイクに言及し、Ervebo以外のワクチン候補（Tumaini試験）について述べている。Uganda言及は2007年の過去の症例に関するものであり、現在進行中の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: OMS cobra países por acordo final sobre pandemias em meio a surto de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO presses countries for a final agreement on pandemics amid an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 November 2026, a severe Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has infected more than 10,000 people and caused about 5,000 deaths since May, intensifying WHO pressure to finalize the 2025 pandemic treaty. In Geneva, the ninth session of the Intergovernmental Working Group is racing to complete the last missing piece: the System of Access to Pathogens and Benefit-Sharing (PABS). Without PABS, the treaty cannot enter into force. PABS governs sharing pathogen samples and genetic sequences and mandates equitable distribution of vaccines, tests, and treatments derived from them. Rich and developing nations remain at odds over its mechanics despite eight meetings since July 2025, underscoring the COVID-19-era lesson that no country can lock itself down against pandemics. The agreement, approved in May 2025, will be reviewed by the 80th World Health Assembly in May 2027; a special session could precede it, and the treaty takes effect 30 days after 60 ratifications. Also cited was a hantavirus cruise-ship outbreak with three deaths in the first half of the year.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ流行の最中にパンデミック条約の最終合意を各国に迫る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で10,000人超が感染、約5,000人死亡という大規模エボラ流行であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOパンデミック条約交渉が主題だが、DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（10,000人超感染、致死率約50%）が背景として報告されており、重大な公衆衛生イベントとして扱うべき。スイス（ジュネーブ）は交渉の開催地であり発生地域ではないため除外。ハンタウイルスのクルーズ船アウトブレイクは国・場所が不明のため評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 외국인 유학생 4000명 시대"...계명대, '결핵 제로' 캠퍼스 만든다
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Era of 4,000 International Students... Keimyung University to Build a 'Tuberculosis Zero' Campus
article.articleSummary: Keimyung University expanded tuberculosis screening to exchange and language students, conducting 1,035 chest X-ray screenings Oct 28–30, 2026 with the Korea Tuberculosis Association Daegu-Gyeongbuk branch mobile unit; the university bore all costs. The effort, requested by the KDCA and Daegu City and conducted via Dalseo District Public Health Center, targets early TB detection to prevent local transmission as international students exceed 4,000. If abnormal results arise, follow-up testing and treatment are coordinated with health authorities and epidemiological investigations supported. Going forward, TB testing will be included in March health checks for international students, with September chest X-rays to maintain health across enrollment. A Vietnam-origin student expressed relief. Keimyung University also provides free health checks and education; the Nursing College previously hosted a Health Fair for about 80 students.

triage.headline_ja: 「外国人留学生4000人時代」...啓明大学、『結核ゼロ』キャンパスを作る
triage.triage_reason: 大学による予防的な結核スクリーニング活動の報告であり、異常発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国・大邱の啓明大学における留学生向け結核予防スクリーニング事業の紹介であり、対象国リストに含まれる国でのアウトブレイクではない。言及されたベトナムは学生の出身国としての記述のみで、ベトナムでの感染症発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Health Review: Ebola case, child malnutrition, medicine security, other developments that shaped October
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case since 2014: a 42-year-old Ugandan-born woman in Abuja who recently returned from Uganda (confirmed Oct 20). Nigeria identified 44 close contacts; two suspected cases in Adamawa tested negative; Abuja case remains the only lab-confirmed infection. The patient and her husband were evacuated to Switzerland on Oct 26 (Geneva and Zurich). WHO says no active confirmed Ebola case in Nigeria post-evacuation, but surveillance continues; NCDC expanded health declarations to all international travellers to boost entry screening. An N10 billion emergency disease response fund was clarified to support surveillance, lab work, PPE, and isolation facilities for Ebola, Lassa and other threats. North-east Nigeria reports an 18% rise in child malnutrition admissions, nearly 20,000 Jan–Sept 2026. Nigeria partners with US Operation End Starvation to mobilize >$1B against malnutrition across sub-Saharan Africa, with Nigeria a priority. Imported drug ingredients raise medicine-security concerns, prompting calls for domestic production amid infrastructure, electricity, financing and regulatory barriers. WHO notes about 24.6 million undiagnosed diabetics in Africa (≈75%). Ebola outbreak worsens in DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ヘルスレビュー:エボラ症例、小児栄養失調、医薬品安全保障など10月の主な動向
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで2014年以来初のエボラ確定例が発生し国際搬送・接触者調査・渡航スクリーニング強化など国際的対応が生じており、DRCでも流行が悪化している点からIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア(2014年以来初のエボラ症例、スイスへの患者搬送)だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでのエボラ流行悪化についても言及があり対象国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, dall'Africa l'epidemia potrebbe raggiungere anche l'Europa. "Nessun Paese può considerarsi al sicuro"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the epidemic from Africa could reach Europe as well. "No country can consider itself safe."
article.articleSummary: Ebola from Bundibugyo virus now affects multiple African regions, with over 10,000 cases and about 5,000 deaths, concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province where the outbreak was declared May 15, though circulation began in February. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya warns that three African regions are affected simultaneously and no country is safe without stronger surveillance and preparedness. The outbreak has spilled into Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria (Abuja case from Uganda); France in Europe has also reported a doctor who returned from DRC. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood or bodily fluids and via handling the bodies of the deceased during funerary practices. No approved cure exists for Bundibugyo Ebola; experimental vaccines could yield initial results in 3–6 months. Funding gaps remain: about $3 billion pledged, more than $2 billion still needed, with Africa contributing $120 million and the rest from international donors.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、アフリカからの流行は欧州にも及ぶ可能性。「安全と言い切れる国はない」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国を中心に複数のアフリカ地域で1万人超の症例・約5000人の死亡が報告され、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大、さらに欧州(フランス)への波及も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な国際的懸念事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへの波及が記載されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。主要な発生地はDRCイトゥリ州。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Urges Pathogen-Sharing Rules as Congo Ebola Cases Reach 10,467 | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak reaches 10,467 confirmed cases and 5,103 deaths through Oct 31, with a case-fatality rate of 48.8% and the epidemic spanning 67 health zones in eight provinces, per the National Institute of Public Health. The ninth negotiating session on the WHO Pandemic Agreement runs in Geneva through Nov 13 as Tedros urges completion of the Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing (PABS) annex to govern exchange of pathogen materials and sequence information and link sharing to fair access to vaccines, therapeutics, and diagnostics. The agreement, adopted May 20, 2025, can open for signature after PABS adoption and 60 ratifications. Separately, a July update reported 13 Andes hantavirus cases and 3 deaths linked to the cruise ship M/V Hondius, with the outbreak contained and no further transmission expected. A UK statement cites outstanding PABS issues; WHA decision is expected May 2027 or a 2026 special session.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ症例が10,467件に達する中、病原体共有ルールを推進
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ出血熱が10,467症例・致死率48.8%と大規模に拡大しており、8州67保健地区に及ぶ深刻な公衆衛生イベントであるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事内のハンタウイルス関連情報はクルーズ船(M/V Hondius)での事例で既に収束しており、対象国リストに該当する発生国はないため除外。ジュネーブでのWHOパンデミック協定交渉やスイス・英国の記載は会議開催地・発言国であり、感染発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: American Airlines Flight Attendants Told: Sign Ebola Attestation Or Get Stuck in a Foreign Country At Your Own Expense
article.articleSummary: All travelers flying to the United States from international destinations must sign an Ebola attestation stating they have not been in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) in the previous 21 days, effective 11:59 p.m. EST on November 3, 2026. Noncompliance will block boarding and may leave individuals stranded abroad at their own expense. The CDC invoked emergency powers earlier this year to restrict entry for those who had been in the DRC and later extended the ban to all travelers, including U.S. citizens and permanent residents. American Airlines flight attendants must verbally attest to the Captain, who will sign for the crew. APFA warned members they could not return to the U.S. without completing the form. Airlines groups urged delays and exemptions; IATA criticized the measure, while the CDC defended it as a risk-reduction tool amid the DRC Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカン航空の客室乗務員に通達：エボラ誓約書への署名を拒否すれば、自己負担で外国に足止めされる可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを受け、米国が全渡航者に対する入国制限・誓約書義務化という異例の措置を取っており、IHR基準の渡航制限・国際的拡大リスクに該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国側の渡航制限措置だが、感染症の発生国はDRCであり、米国は対象国リストに含まれないため発生地域としては計上しない。DRCのエボラアウトブレイクは既知の継続事案であり、続報でCDC措置の影響や国際的反応を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Смертность от Эболы в ДР Конго превысила 50%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola mortality in the DR Congo exceeded 50%.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 November 2026, Ebola Virus Disease mortality in the Democratic Republic of Congo reached 51.6% among 10,414 laboratory-confirmed cases, with 5,372 deaths. The rise from 48.6% reported last week results from retrospective data corrections by the local data‑processing team and outbreak response unit in Ituri Province, not a sharp daily spike. The National Institute of Public Health under the Congolese Ministry of Health confirmed these figures. Earlier in the outbreak, infections had reached about 8,500. A healthcare worker involved in the response was killed by locals protesting procedures, highlighting security risks in outbreak control. The data indicate an ongoing Ebola outbreak primarily centered in Ituri Province, with continued confirmed cases and fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の致死率が50%を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（1万人超の確定症例、致死率50%超）が継続しており、医療従事者殺害など対応上の治安リスクも報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 致死率上昇は遡及的データ修正によるもので急激な悪化ではないが、既存の大規模アウトブレイクが継続中であり、医療従事者殺害事件は対応の治安リスクを示唆する。継続的なモニタリングと既存RRAの更新が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ahmedabad records 513 dengue cases in Oct, 1,857 so far this year
article.articleSummary: Ahmedabad (Amdavad), Gujarat, reports 513 dengue cases in October 2026, boosting the year-to-date dengue tally to 1,269 as of Oct 31, 2026. Dengue figures this year have already surpassed the 2025 total of 1,591, with 1,857 dengue cases recorded for the first 10 months of 2026. In October 2026, the AMC health department also logged 63 malaria cases (including 15 falciparum malaria) and 2 chikungunya cases; September had 137 malaria, 41 falciparum malaria, and 10 chikungunya. Dengue hotspots include Gota, Jagatpur, Chandkheda, Bodakdev, Thaltej, as well as Vastral, Lambha, and Nikol. Preventive measures focus on eliminating stagnant water from water coolers and air conditioners, regular water changes, and sealing breeding sites at commercial units and construction sites. October water testing recorded 52,997 chlorine samples (11 with zero chlorine) and 7,569 bacteriological samples (20 unfit).

triage.headline_ja: アーメダバード、10月のデング熱症例513件を記録、年初来累計1,857件に
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・マラリア・チクングニア報告で、例年比で増加傾向だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の懸念は見られず、地域の季節的流行として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 例年のデング・マラリア・チクングニア報告記事であり、昨年比で症例数が増加しているが、地方自治体による通常の対策（防疫・水質検査）が継続されている。重症度や死亡者数についての言及はなし。

article.articleHeadline: 36 hospitalised after eating at Mumbai wedding, food poisoning suspected
article.articleSummary: Suspected food poisoning at a Mumbai wedding led to 31 hospitalisations on Nov 1, 2026. Guests, including four children, developed vomiting and diarrhoea after dining at Kalash Caterers’ feast; the bride and groom also fell ill. About 11:40 p.m., 27 people were admitted to MT Agarwal Municipal General Hospital, four children to Kamgar Hospital, and five others to a hospital in Vikhroli. Total hospitalisations reported: 31. The Maharashtra FDA collected food samples and the state’s food safety authority is investigating under sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. Bhandup Police registered a case against Kalash Caterers owner Mulsingh Harisingh Rajpurohit and staff. The wedding reportedly drew around 500 attendees; lab confirmation pending from food samples.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイの結婚式で食事後36人が入院、食中毒の疑い
triage.triage_reason: 単発の食中毒事例であり、国際的拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威には該当しない。感染症（ヒト-ヒト感染）の懸念もなく、通常の食品安全事案として処理可能。
triage.notes: 食中毒事案であり感染症イベントではない。地元当局（FDA、警察）が調査中だが、国際的な対象国リストに該当する感染症事例ではないためverified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Deaths in Congo Near 5,000 Mark
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo (Bundibugyo virus) has 4,992 confirmed deaths as of 28 Oct 2026 (CDC); WHO counts 9,704 cases with 4,687 deaths (20 Oct), and ECDC/INSP lists 10,141 cases and 4,928 deaths (27 Oct). The outbreak is concentrated in Ituri province (7,040 cases, 3,271 deaths by 20 Oct) across 66 health zones in eight provinces. Kenya reports its first imported case (6 Oct); 9 cases and 2 deaths linked to that case, with the initial patient dying in Nairobi. Nigeria confirms one imported case in Abuja (20 Oct) who traveled to Uganda and was flown to Switzerland; more than 50 contacts under follow-up (26 Oct). No approved vaccine; the TUMAINI vaccine trial began 23 Oct in Bunia. US guidance: CDC bans travelers who were in Congo within 21 days of departure; starting 3 Nov, international travelers must attest to not having been in Congo, and Americans are advised to avoid Ituri and Nord-Kivu (Kenya Level 1).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数、5,000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: DRCで約1万症例・約5000人死亡の大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境例やスイスへの搬送例も発生、米国の渡航制限措置も取られておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの輸入症例も報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCのイトゥリ州・北キブ州を中心に流行中。ワクチン未承認でTUMAINI試験が開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: 中國新冠變異株疫情攀升 結局或如愛滋病人 | 中國新冠疫情 | 確診病例 | 併發症
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's SARS-CoV-2 variant outbreak on the rise; prognosis may be similar to that of AIDS patients | China's COVID-19 outbreak | Confirmed cases | Complications.
article.articleSummary: China’s SARS-CoV-2 outbreak is rising, with Omicron lineage PQ.16.1.1 and its sublineages predominant. As of September 2026, China reported 346,000 new confirmed COVID-19 cases, 271 severe cases, and 9 deaths (all with underlying diseases). Local genomic surveillance covered 15,996 sequences, all Omicron. Virologists warn the true infection burden is higher and that severe cases exhibit immune complications; one advocate describes AIDS-like immune exhaustion that can lead to fatal bacterial or fungal infections. On Oct 26, Cao Yunlong’s team published findings that the BA.3.2.2 variant has an immune mechanism favoring transmission in children. They note first vaccine doses leave a lasting immune imprint and domestic vaccines have weak protection, contributing to pediatric infections. Another virologist claims inactivated vaccines may accelerate cancer and diabetes, and cites risks of myocarditis, pericarditis, immune thrombosis, and nerve damage; vaccine discussions are politically sensitive in China. Overall prognosis may resemble AIDS in severe immune dysfunction.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の新型コロナウイルス変異株感染拡大、転帰はエイズ患者に似る可能性 | 中国COVID-19流行 | 確定症例 | 合併症
triage.triage_reason: 中国でオミクロン系統PQ.16.1.1等の感染拡大が報告されているが、重症化率・死亡率は相対的に低く、情報源（NTD）の政治的偏向や未検証の免疫破壊・ワクチン陰謀論的主張が含まれるため、現時点でIHR基準を満たすとは言えず続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 情報源は反中国共産党系メディア（NTD/大紀元系）であり、免疫破壊やワクチンによる発癌リスクなど科学的検証が不十分な主張を含むため、内容の信頼性に注意が必要。中国当局の公式統計（346,000例/月、重症271例、死亡9例）自体は深刻度としては比較的限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases surge in city, daily average triples in Oct
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases surge in Lucknow city: 21 fresh dengue cases reported on Monday, with October district total at 425, up from 288 in the same period last year; the daily average nearly tripled to about nine in the first week of October. Post-monsoon conditions have created favorable mosquito breeding. District malaria officer Dr Ritu Srivastava says the rise is being monitored and the situation remains under control, and cooler weather in coming days could reduce mosquito activity and dengue cases. Public health experts urge intensified surveillance, timely testing, and aggressive source-reduction; residents with fever, severe headache, body ache or weakness should seek prompt medical care, and community participation is essential to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 市内でデング熱症例が急増、10月の日平均が3倍に
triage.triage_reason: 季節的なデング熱症例増加で当局は「管理下にある」としており、IHR基準の該当は乏しいが、地域的な流行動向として継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱は季節性の地域流行として報告されており、当局は管理下にあるとコメント。重症度・死亡者数に関する情報は記事内に記載なし。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Bhopal coughs, labs have no answers: Is it pollution or a changing flu strain?
article.articleSummary: Bhopal, India, 2 November 2026 — Prolonged cough, cold and fever are increasingly common among patients visiting OPDs in Bhopal. The State Virology Laboratory at Gandhi Medical College (GMC) has not conducted genome sequencing and has passed responsibility to AIIMS Bhopal, leaving uncertainty about whether a changing flu strain or other respiratory pathogens are driving the surge. Some doctors privately suspect seasonal influenza, including H1N1, though no circulating strain has been confirmed by sequencing. AIIMS Bhopal has been approached for clarification and has not yet responded. GMC Pomnologist Dr Vikas Gupta attributed the pattern to significant temperature variations and environmental factors from rapid construction, Metro rail work, and urban development, with dust exposure and changing weather contributing to flu-like infections. Many patients and coughing episodes are reported in crowded spaces, including cinema halls. Precautionary guidance urged for those predisposed to respiratory illnesses; ideal genome sequencing to guide preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: ボパールで咳が蔓延、検査機関も原因不明：大気汚染か、変化するインフルエンザ株か？
triage.triage_reason: インドのボパールで原因不明の咳・発熱症例が増加しているが、ゲノムシーケンシング未実施で病原体の特定や重症度データが不足しており、現時点では季節性インフルエンザか環境要因かも不明なため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 原因病原体が未確定（ゲノムシーケンシング未実施）であり、季節性インフルエンザ・大気汚染・都市開発による環境要因のいずれが主因か不明。AIIMS Bhopalの回答待ちであり、続報（検査結果）を注視すべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: Hapur News: बक्सर में 30 वर्षीय महिला को डेंगू की पुष्टि, संख्या पहुंची 11
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hapur News: Dengue confirmed in a 30-year-old woman in Buxar; the number has reached 11.
article.articleSummary: Dengue confirmed in a 30-year-old woman in Buxar village, Simhawli area, Hapur district, raising total dengue cases to 11. The positive case was reported Monday after testing at government facilities. Nine Community Health Centers and the district hospital have mosquito-netted dengue wards (four-bed wards at each CHC; district hospital has a six-bed dengue ward). Government hospitals continue fever treatment and dengue testing. Health authorities dispatched teams to the affected village to assess household contacts and monitor residents; all contacted family members were reported healthy. With changing weather, fever outbreaks persist; officials urge cleanliness around homes to curb mosquito breeding and transmission.

triage.headline_ja: Hapurニュース: バクサールで30歳女性のデング熱感染確認、感染者数11人に到達
triage.triage_reason: インド・ハプール地区における季節性デング熱の局地的な小規模発生であり、公衆衛生当局が通常の対応（病棟確保、接触者調査）を行っている程度で、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも該当せず社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: インドにおけるデング熱は毎年季節的に発生しており、本記事は地方の一地域(ハプール地区)での小規模症例報告に過ぎず、地方自治体レベルで対応可能な事案と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Mudanças climáticas já causam aumento de doenças infecciosas no País
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate change is already causing an increase in infectious diseases in the country.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreaks in Rio Grande do Sul (≈210,000 confirmed infections and 281 deaths) and Bahia (≈163,000 cases, 188 deaths) in 2024 illustrate climate-driven expansion of Aedes aegypti. A Fiocruz study (2006–2024) shows dengue epidemic microrregions rising from 110 to 292, now representing about 54% of Brazil, while 46% remain medium to low risk. Extreme temperature anomalies underpin this spread, with transmission unlikely to revert to zero. Oropouche fever surpassed 12,000 infections in 2025 across 23 states and the Federal District. Hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome records 530 infections and 212 deaths since 2016; floods fuel leptospirosis and hepatitis A risk. Droughts and fires may drive rodent‑borne and fungal threats as temperatures rise. El Niño–related extremes are expected to intensify these trends across the country.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動がすでに国内の感染症増加を引き起こしている
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は気候変動とデング熱・オロプーシュ熱・ハンタウイルス等の長期的増加傾向を分析する総括記事であり、特定の新規急性アウトブレイクを報告するものではないため、個別シグナルとしての緊急対応は不要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は2016年〜2025年の累積統計・トレンド分析であり、新規の急性イベントを示すものではない。デング熱・オロプーシュ熱・ハンタウイルス・レプトスピラ症・A型肝炎など複数疾患を気候変動の文脈で扱っているが、いずれも既知の継続的リスクとして言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Colombia reporta casos de malaria por Plasmodium falciparum en viajeros provenientes de la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Colombia reports cases of falciparum malaria in travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Two Colombians returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo were diagnosed with Plasmodium falciparum malaria in Colombia's Valle del Cauca region. The first case, a 33-year-old man, died on October 31 in Palmira; the second, a 50-year-old man, is isolated and under care in Cali. Feverish symptoms were present on arrival. Health authorities activated epidemiological surveillance and ruled out other high-priority diseases such as Ebola. The Ministry of Health and the National Institute of Health confirmed the diagnosis of P. falciparum malaria, the most severe form, which can rapidly damage multiple organs. Field investigations are ongoing in Cali and Palmira, with two additional people reported malaria and under treatment. Travelers from the DRC are urged to report exposures or symptoms to help prevent imported transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コロンビア、コンゴ民主共和国からの渡航者に熱帯熱マラリア（Plasmodium falciparum）の症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者2名がコロンビアで熱帯熱マラリアと診断され1名が死亡したが、現時点では地域内での二次感染や大規模な拡大は確認されておらず、続報を注視する段階と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコロンビア国内での輸入マラリア症例報告であり、コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）は感染源として言及されているのみで、DRC国内での発生状況についての記述はないため、対象国リストに含まれるDRCをverified_locationsには含めなかった。コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれないため、該当国なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: prevenção da raiva em Itatiaiuçu - Jornal Panorama
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies Prevention in Itatiaiuçu - Jornal Panorama
article.articleSummary: Three-day training in Itatiaiuçu focused on preventing rabies through hematophagous bats (vampire bats). Expert Jomar Otávio Zatti led sessions on identification, capture, control, and field monitoring of these animals, coupled with practical demonstrations to reduce rabies transmission risk. The program emphasized measures to protect animal and public health, including monitoring procedures and preventive care. It also highlighted vaccination against rabies for livestock such as cattle and horses, and other animals, as a key preventive strategy. A resident discussion was included to connect technical guidance with community realities. The training sought to translate knowledge into routine practices by teams responsible for prevention and surveillance. The ongoing takeaway is to maintain vigilance on vaccination and preventive measures to minimize rabies risks in Itatiaiuçu.

triage.headline_ja: イタタイアイウスでの狂犬病予防訓練 - ジョルナル・パノラマ
triage.triage_reason: これは実際の狂犬病症例の発生報告ではなく、吸血コウモリによる狂犬病予防のための研修活動を報じた記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防研修・啓発活動に関する内容であり、具体的な狂犬病症例の発生は報告されていない。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、本記事は実際の感染イベントではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola mortality in DR Congo exceeds 50%
article.articleSummary: The Ebola mortality rate in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 50%, with 10,414 laboratory-confirmed cases and 5,372 deaths, a case-fatality rate of 51.6% as of 2026-11-02. The increase is attributed to retrospective data adjustment by the Ituri Province outbreak response team, not a single-day spike. The outbreak began in eastern DRC and Uganda on May 15 and has become the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak in Africa, with cases in eight Congolese provinces. Ugandan outbreak ended July 28; WHO confirmed Aug 25. First cases in Kenya on Oct 6 and Nigeria on Oct 20. The virus is Bundibugyo; a vaccine is still in development. Symptoms include fever, weakness, muscle pain, headache, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, kidney and liver impairment, and sometimes bleeding. Transmission via contact with blood and body fluids; incubation 2-21 days; healthcare workers, family, close contacts at higher risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、致死率50%超え
triage.triage_reason: 致死率51.6%・1万人超の確定例という深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、複数国（DRC・ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア）への拡大が確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの感染拡大にも言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。主たる発生国はDRC。ワクチンは開発中で未承認、致死率が非常に高い点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Zoonotic diseases: Experts urge signal-based surveillance, labs upgrade
article.articleSummary: At Bengaluru-based One Health Conclave (IISc), public health experts urged shifting from symptom-based to signal-based surveillance to curb zoonotic diseases, highlighting early warning signs, stronger laboratories, and better inter-department coordination as of 2 November 2026. They cited Kyasanur Forest Disease (KFD), or monkey fever, in Karnataka—where cases continue to be missed despite mortality declines in Shivamogga—and noted the first human death from the animal-borne Shamonda virus. Calls were made to recognize gram panchayats as One Health stakeholders, prioritize resource allocation, and integrate milk and meat production considerations. Although advanced technology exists, deployment mechanisms are lacking; village- and ward-level committees showed value during COVID-19 and should be expanded. Emphasis was placed on system-based SOPs, improved information-sharing among departments, and collaboration with local organizations to strengthen surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: 人獣共通感染症：専門家が症状ベースではなくシグナルベースの監視体制と検査機関の強化を提言
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はベンガルールで開催されたOne Healthカンファレンスにおける監視体制強化の提言を報じるもので、具体的な新規アウトブレイクや症例急増等の事実は報告されていないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はKarnataka州におけるキャサヌール森林病（KFD/サル熱）やShamonda virusの既存状況に言及しつつ、主眼は監視システム改善に関する専門家提言であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。KFD自体は継続的な地方病として存在するが、本記事からは新たな急性事象の発生は確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Volaris pedirá declarar viajes al Congo para abordar vuelos hacia EU por ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Volaris will ask that trips to the Congo be declared in order to operate flights to the EU because of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa prompts new CDC travel controls; Volaris will require U.S.-bound passengers to sign a sworn declaration confirming no physical presence in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) within the 21 days prior to travel. Effective 11:59 p.m. EST on November 3, 2026, the form must be submitted before boarding and can be printed or digital. The declaration, mandated by the CDC, covers any entry or transit through Congolese territory by air, land, or sea, including layovers in Congolese airports, with the sole exception of overflights. The rule applies to all travelers to the United States, regardless of nationality. Volaris advises travelers who have been in the DRC to contact the airline for guidance. These measures reflect heightened surveillance to prevent Ebola importation amid ongoing outbreaks in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: ボラリス航空、エボラ出血熱を理由に米国便搭乗にコンゴ渡航歴の申告を義務化へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行を受け米CDCが渡航管理措置を発動しており、IHR4基準すべてに該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行に対する米国CDC・航空会社（Volaris）の渡航管理措置に関するもの。米国は規制実施国であり発生国ではないため除外。DRC国内の症例数・死亡者数など詳細情報は記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا حين تختلف حسابات الوقاية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: When Prevention Calculations Differ
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains a global concern as the Democratic Republic of Congo sustains a wide outbreak since May, with over 10,000 confirmed cases and about 5,000 deaths, and the virus has spread to Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment; existing Ebola vaccines target other strains and have not proven efficacy against Bundibugjo, while clinical trials are ongoing. A Nigerian case illustrates delayed detection: a woman arrived from Uganda four days before symptom onset on Oct 7, sought care in Abuja four days later, and was confirmed on Oct 20, 13 days after onset, underscoring cross-border transmission and contact-tracing challenges. Saudi Arabia in June suspended entry visas from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, later extending to Kenya, as a precaution tied to incubation. WHO does not advocate broad travel bans; instead, a risk-based, time-bound approach should complement domestic readiness and international support.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：予防策の計算が食い違う時
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）大規模流行が1万例超・死者約5000人に達し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境拡大、ワクチン・治療薬未確立かつ渡航制限措置も発生しており、IHR4基準全てに該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行を主題とし、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・スーダン・サウジアラビアへの言及があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬が未承認である点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Tusindvis er døde af frygtet virus: Ekspert frygter gentagelse af corona - Dagens
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thousands have died from the feared virus: An expert fears a repeat of the coronavirus - Dagens.
article.articleSummary: More than 10,000 people have been infected and nearly 5,000 have died in an Ebola outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo variant across four African countries, which began in May. The Democratic Republic of Congo hosts the largest, most deadly Ebola crisis since the 2018–2020 outbreak. Jean Kaseya, Director-General of the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, warns the disease could reach the United Kingdom and other countries if not quickly contained, drawing a parallel with the early COVID-19 phase when risk was underestimated. Ebola transmission remains primarily via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals and does not spread in the same way as coronavirus. The article underscores the urgent need for rapid public health response to limit further spread and potential export of cases.

triage.headline_ja: 何千人も恐怖のウイルスで死亡：専門家はコロナ禍の再来を懸念
triage.triage_reason: DRCを中心に4か国で1万人以上が感染、約5000人が死亡する大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行であり、国際的拡大の懸念も専門家から指摘されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は英国への拡散リスクを警告しているが、英国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。発生国はDRCを含む4か国とされるが、サマリーで明示的に国名が挙がっているのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 10 آلاف إصابة بإيبولا في إفريقيا والوفيات تتجاوز 5300
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 10,000 Ebola cases in Africa, with deaths exceeding 5,300.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Africa: 10,444 cases and 5,376 deaths tracked by Africa Union’s Africa CDC as of 2026-11-02, with the majority (5,372) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; Uganda and Kenya report 2 deaths each. The current outbreak, declared May 15, centers in DRC; authorities warn the Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or approved therapy. Case fatality rate exceeds 50% among reported cases. In recent weeks, the Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) vaccine has been administered in DRC as part of a trial, though this vaccine is proven against the Zaire strain, not Bundibugyo. The article notes Africa’s history with Ebola, including a 2018–2020 outbreak in DRC (about 2,300 deaths among 3,500 cases) as a reference point.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ感染者1万人超、死者5300人を上回る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国を中心に致死率50%超のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が1万例以上・死者5300人超に達し、ウガンダ・ケニアへの拡大も報告されており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアでの死亡例報告があるが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。ブンディブギョ株には承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、Ervebo（ザイール株対象）の試験的投与が行われている点にも留意。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола и хантавирус ускорили тревогу ВОЗ: мир призвали готовиться к новым пандемиям
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola and Hantavirus Intensify WHO Alarm: World Urged to Prepare for New Pandemics.
article.articleSummary: New Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and a hantavirus surge underscore the urgency of completing the international pandemic accord. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus told Geneva negotiators that cross-border infection threats require a formal pact on access to pathogens and benefit-sharing (PABS). Adopted in May 2025, the accord still lacks consensus on how samples and data are exchanged and how vaccines, tests, and therapeutics developed from them are fairly distributed. Tedros warned that during COVID-19, vaccines were developed rapidly but many countries faced delays or stockpiling by others. WHO Europe Regional Director Hans Kluge likewise stressed equitable access to medicines and vaccines. The world must avoid repeating COVID-19 inequities and advance a binding framework to prepare for future pandemics.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとハンタウイルスがWHOの警戒を加速：世界に新たなパンデミックへの備えを呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの新たなエボラ出血熱の発生が言及されているが、具体的な症例数・発生地域・時期等の詳細情報がなく、記事自体はWHOのパンデミック条約交渉に関する政策的内容が主体であるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOのパンデミック条約（PABS）交渉に関する政策報道が主眼であり、DRCでのエボラ出血熱発生は文脈として言及されているのみで、発生規模・場所・時期等の一次情報は含まれていない。ハンタウイルスについても発生国の明記がないため評価対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: Muara Enim Siapkan Strategi Percepat Eliminasi TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Muara Enim Prepares Strategy to Accelerate TB Elimination.
article.articleSummary: Muara Enim Regency in South Sumatra is accelerating tuberculosis (TB) elimination by drafting a Regent Regulation (Perbup) on the Regional Action Plan (RAD) for TB Control 2026–2029. The regulation aims to align targets, indicators, roles, activities, monitoring, evaluation, and financing. TB cases total 1,266 with case finding at 52.14%. Lawang Kidul records 136 cases, followed by Muara Enim district (107) and Ujan Mas (82); Ujan Mas reports the highest case finding at 80.75%. TB cure rate stands at 85.73%, below the 90% target. The plan emphasizes cross-sector involvement beyond the Health Office, including Bappeda, BPKAD, PMD, districts and villages, health facilities, private sector, and civil society. The discussion, led by Health Office head Dr. Eni Zatila and P2P official Erdius, seeks coordinated actions and financing to accelerate elimination.

article.articleHeadline: Deoria News: विशेष संचारी अभियान में सुअर बाड़ों में हुआ छिड़काव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deoria News: Spraying carried out in pig pens as part of a special contagious disease campaign.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-02, Deoria district, Uttar Pradesh: In Godhanpur Chaube village of Baitalpur block, the Department of Animal Husbandry launched a special campaign to prevent contagious diseases in livestock. Under the leadership of Livestock Extension Officer Nishkant Tiwari, a team inspected pig pens, sprayed disinfectant, and distributed free deworming medicines and disease information pamphlets. Farmers were instructed on symptoms and prevention, including timely animal vaccination, hygiene, and eliminating standing water; sick animals should be isolated. Officials noted post-monsoon conditions heighten risk of infectious diseases, making the anti-contagion drive timely. The effort targets preventing outbreaks among pigs and other livestock, reinforcing vaccination and sanitation to curb spread in the village and surrounding areas of Deoria.
