article.articleHeadline: Este es el nuevo requisito a viajeros que exigirá Estados Unidos por brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This is the new requirement for travelers that the United States will impose due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in central Africa, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has triggered a new U.S. travel requirement. The Democratic Republic of the Congo (RDC) is the outbreak’s epicenter, with an eastern origin declared May 15 and spread to additional provinces. As of Oct 31, more than 5,000 deaths have occurred, and the RDC’s National Institute of Public Health reports 10,351 laboratory-confirmed infections and 5,026 deaths through Oct 29; 2,788 recovered and 1,101 hospitalized or isolated. International concern is rising. To prevent cross-border transmission, the United States will require travelers to submit a declaration certifying they have not been in RDC, not even in transit, within the preceding 21 days before boarding. The rule, announced by Avianca and aligned with CDC guidance, applies to travelers with U.S. connections and takes effect for departures after 11:59 p.m. Eastern on November 3, 2026; declarations may be digital or printed.

triage.headline_ja: これが米国がエボラ出血熱の流行を受けて渡航者に課す新たな要件だ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）流行が5,000人超の死者を出し、米国が渡航制限措置を導入するなど国際的拡大・渡航制限の両基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 米国は発生地ではなく渡航制限措置の実施国として記載されているため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: ₦10bn Health Security Fund: Nigeria Needs ₦522bn To Fight Outbreaks - NCDC
article.articleSummary: Nigeria's NCDC says Nigeria needs about ₦522 billion to strengthen health security from 2025–2029 (NAPHS 2.0), far more than the ₦10 billion emergency intervention allocated directly to NCDC. This leaves a funding gap of about ₦512 billion, translating to roughly ₦104.4 billion per year. With a population over 240 million, the country would require US$240–$480 million annually to prepare for outbreaks. Nigeria's funding has risen from ₦4b (2024) to ₦7b (2025), plus a ₦5b intervention in 2025; the 2026 appropriation allocates ₦22b, and a ₦10b emergency fund was approved in June 2026 amid a global Ebola alert linked to the DRC, but Idris says the fund targets multiple threats (Lassa fever, meningitis, monkeypox, antimicrobial resistance) and not just Ebola. He rejects claims the money went to the Presidential Task Force, and urges sustainable funding, evidence-based decisions on mass gatherings, travel, and elections.

triage.headline_ja: 健康安全基金100億ナイラ：ナイジェリアは感染症対策に5220億ナイラが必要 - NCDC
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はナイジェリアの感染症対策予算不足に関する政策・財政報告であり、対象国における実際の感染症発生イベントを報告するものではない。

In biotech news, FDA has accepted uniQure’s Huntington’s disease gene therapy filing, with a decision due by May 1, 2027. Indian drugmaker Dr Reddy’s received FDA provisional approval to manufacture an effective HIV PrEP generic, aiding lower-income countries. Danish vaccine maker Bavarian Nordic won a UK four-year contract to supply the MVA-BN vaccine for mpox and smallpox. Tiziana Life Sciences reported Phase II results showing reduced brain inflammation with its experimental MS therapy and good safety. Teva halted an oral trial for the rare neurodegenerative disease Multiple System Atrophy due to low probability of success, while Novartis’ large trial targeting lipoprotein(a) failed, fueling debate on Lp(a)’s role in heart disease.

article.articleHeadline: Homens representam maioria dos casos de síndrome respiratória grave
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Men account for the majority of severe acute respiratory syndrome cases.
article.articleSummary: In Acre, Brazil, Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) in 2026 totals 1,651 confirmed cases with 46 deaths, incidence 187.48, updated to October 26, 2026. Men account for 56% of SRAG cases and women 44%. Age distribution shows 65+ with 150 women and 132 men; 50–64 with 60 women and 56 men; 15–49 with 100 men and 94 women; 5–14 with 102 boys and 81 girls; 2–4 with 133 boys and 89 girls. Racial distribution is predominantly pardos (83.8%), Indigenous 11%, White 3.8%, Black 0.8%, Asian 0.2%, and 0.4% unknown. Detected respiratory viruses in early 2026 weeks among hospitalized SRAG patients include RSV and rhinovirus; deaths are associated with influenza A(H1N1), metapneumovirus, adenovirus, bocavirus, and COVID-19. Geographic focus: Acre state, Brazil, with ongoing monitoring of demographic and etiologic patterns.

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي إيبولا يؤكد الحاجة إلى استكمال معاهدة الجوائح
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak underscores the need to complete the Pandemic Treaty.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus underscored the urgent need to finish the Pandemic Treaty, citing the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as evidence. The outbreak, with over 10,000 cases and more than 5,000 deaths, was declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17 and has spread to Nigeria after earlier detections in Kenya and Uganda, with the majority of cases in the DRC. Separately, a hantavirus outbreak earlier in 2026 caused three deaths on a cruise ship. As nine rounds of Geneva negotiations aim to finalize the treaty, authorities debate how to implement the core mechanism, the PABS system (Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing). The WHO chief warned that vaccine inequities during COVID-19 prolonged the pandemic and risked new variants, emphasizing that no country can stay safe alone.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）：エボラ流行がパンデミック条約完成の必要性を裏付ける

triage.notes: 記事はWHO事務局長によるパンデミック条約交渉に関する発言が主題だが、背景として言及されているDRCのエボラ流行自体がPHEICで既に重大事案として扱われているためPICKUPと判断。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれず除外。クルーズ船でのハンタウイルス流行は別事案で詳細情報不足のため本評価には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: وسط اتساع رقعة التفشي.. إيبولا يحصد أكثر من 5300 وفاة في إفريقيا | التلفزيون العربي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid the widening spread of the outbreak, Ebola has claimed more than 5,300 deaths in Africa | Al Arabiya TV
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak across Africa has claimed 5,376 lives and surpassed 10,000 confirmed infections, with the vast majority in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Africa CDC data show 5,372 deaths in the DRC and two deaths each in Uganda and Kenya, among 10,444 total cases, yielding a fatality rate above 50% and signaling spread beyond the DRC. The outbreak, officially declared in the DRC on May 15, is linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus lineage, for which no licensed vaccine or treatment exists. In a recent response, DRC authorities administered doses of the Ervebo vaccine in a clinical trial to assess protection against this strain. Across Africa, Nigeria has confirmed a case, Kenya’s total rose to 9 after a travel-associated case, and Uganda reported 20 cases in May–June before WHO declared Uganda outbreak-free in August, with no new infections reported since. The current outbreak is the second-largest in Africa by cases and deaths, after 2014–2016 West Africa.

article.articleHeadline: Kampala and Juba: Fally Ipupa's upcoming concerts postponed due to Ebola travel restrictions - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak-related travel restrictions prompted the provisional postponement of Fally Ipupa's concerts in Kampala, Uganda, and Juba, South Sudan, originally planned for November 21–22, 2026. A Kinshasa-based press release, dated November 2, 2026, says the precautionary move follows the current health situation and Ugandan authorities' travel limits linked to Ebola. Production companies Ham's and KBCM will issue formal new dates once health conditions and travel arrangements permit safe events. The notice does not provide Ebola case numbers, lab confirmation, infection sources, symptoms, or local transmission details. It also does not indicate any imported/exported cases related to the performances. New dates will be announced promptly when conditions allow and authorities provide guidance. The venues are in Kampala (Uganda) and Juba (South Sudan).

article.articleHeadline: Cuiabá já vistoriou 958.373 imóveis contra dengue e reforça importância da prevenção dentro de casa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cuiabá has already inspected 958,373 properties to combat dengue and reiterates the importance of prevention inside the home.
article.articleSummary: Cuiabá, Brazil reports 931 locally acquired dengue cases in 2026, with Aedes aegypti control emphasized inside homes. The municipality notes 65 autochthonous chikungunya cases with no deaths, and no new locally transmitted Zika cases in the latest week; there have been no Zika deaths in 2026. In Week 42 (as of 29 October), six new dengue cases were reported, plus 41 cases from prior weeks, contributing to a 4.2% year-over-year increase through the period. Environmental health teams have inspected 958,373 properties, treating 100,614 and addressing 114,317 deposits, while eliminating 29,015 other potential breeding sites. The health department urges residents to eliminate standing water, keep water tanks covered, and regularly clean gutters, plant pots, tires, and bottles. Vector-control agents conduct home visits to identify breeding sites, and public participation is essential to interrupt Aedes aegypti transmission.

article.articleHeadline: EU impondrá nuevo requisito a viajeros por brote de ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: EU to impose new travel requirement for travelers amid Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts a new US travel rule. Beginning November 3, 2026, the US CDC requires any international flight bound for the United States to present a signed declaration stating the traveler has not been in the DRC during the 21 days before departure. Airlines must modify check-in processes, implement electronic signatures, adjust airport procedures, and train staff, incurring higher compliance costs. The International Air Transport Association (IATA) and Airlines for America urged the CDC to reconsider, citing the tight implementation window. Mexican carriers Aeroméxico, Volaris, and Viva have not yet detailed how they will meet the requirement, but are expected to announce procedures soon.

article.articleHeadline: Trabalho preventivo em cemitérios de Santa Cruz visa eliminar focos do Aedes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Preventive work in Santa Cruz cemeteries aims to eliminate Aedes breeding sites.
article.articleSummary: In Santa Cruz, Endemic Disease Control Agents from the Municipal Health Department targeted cemetery sites to curb Aedes aegypti breeding and reduce dengue transmission. On Saturday, Oct 31, teams worked at seven cemeteries: Municipal, Católico, Guarda de Deus, Ecumênico da Paz Eterna, Aliança, and Linha Santa Cruz (including Católico and Evangélico sectors). Agents provided preventive care guidance to cemetery managers and families about eliminating standing water and other mosquito habitats. Coordinator Alexandre Goularte noted that in the coming weeks the initiative will expand to more than 30 cemeteries across the city and neighboring countryside to remove debris and potential proliferation sites. The effort represents routine vector control in settings with increased container habitats and underscores community-based prevention against dengue transmission by Aedes aegypti.

article.articleSummary: 85 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Mambasa health zone, Ituri province, North-East Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 51 deaths and 15 recoveries. Cases span four health sub-zones; 19 patients are currently treated at the Ebola Treatment Centre (ETC). The situation indicates ongoing persistence of Ebola in this part of Ituri as response teams maintain surveillance, care, and prevention activities to curb transmission. An uptick in community death reports is noted, with 18 such reports requiring rapid dignified and safe burial (DSB) interventions. Authorities call for strengthened human, material, and logistical resources to bolster the outbreak response. Report dated November 2, 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Raiva herbívora acende alerta no meio rural
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Herbivore Rabies Triggers Alarm in Rural Areas.
article.articleSummary: Herbivore rabies in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, reports 66 positive herbivore samples from January–September 2026, per IPVDF. Rabies is transmitted through saliva via bites, scratches, or licking; affected mammals include cattle, horses, and humans, with fatal outcomes and nervous-system involvement. Hematophagous bats are the main vectors; infected bats may die and incubation can extend transmission, so bat presence on a farm does not always align with initial herd symptoms. In RS, outbreaks typically cluster May–October due to bat activity; incubation is 2–4 months. Suspected cases include behavioral changes, difficulty walking, apathy, poor appetite, and excessive salivation. Producers should avoid contact and notify the Inspetoria de Defesa Agropecuária; authorities trigger the Herbivore Rabies Control Program. Diagnostic workflow: samples collected and sent to IPVDF in Eldorado do Sul, initial immunofluorescence test, with a second confirmatory test if negative. Vaccination remains key to protect exposed humans.

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Stopping bird flu beyond the farm
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza, H5N1, remains a threat to poultry, livelihoods, and public health across Asia and the Pacific. In March, H5N1-positive poultry in Cambodia triggered investigations that identified a human infection; in June Australia confirmed H5N1 in a migratory seabird, illustrating cross-border spread across farms, wildlife, and the environment. The UN General Assembly’s Oct 12 Political Declaration urges pandemic prevention via a One Health approach linking human, animal, and environmental health, while climate variability and stronger El Niño (peaking late 2026 per WMO) may raise disease risks and drive farm runoff spreading pathogens. FAO-supported work in Cambodia, Indonesia, and Sulawesi demonstrates surveillance and risk reduction. Three priorities: (1) integrate wildlife/environmental data with animal/human surveillance; (2) invest in frontline, laboratory capacity; (3) embed upstream prevention with sustained funding in national plans. One Health Day emphasizes coordinated prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 農場を超えた鳥インフルエンザ対策
triage.triage_reason: 特定の新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、H5N1の脅威とOne Healthアプローチの必要性を論じるオピニオン記事であり、既知の過去事例（カンボジア3月、豪州6月）の言及に留まる。
triage.notes: 本記事は政策提言を目的としたオピニオン記事であり、具体的な新規感染症発生イベントの報告ではないため、対象国の新規発生事例として扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: பருவநிலை மாற்றம்: கோழிப் பண்ணைகளில் திடீரென உயிரிழந்த ஆயிரத்துக்கும் மேற்பட்ட கோழிகள்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate change: More than a thousand chickens died suddenly in poultry farms.
article.articleSummary: More than 1,000 chickens suddenly died at poultry farms in Cuddalore district, Tamil Nadu, notably in Tiruchopuram near the coast, with affected sites including Thamanampettai and Kurinjipadi. The mass mortality occurred in the days leading up to Diwali, as birds were being prepared for sale. The Department of Animal Husbandry, led by Joint Director Murugavel, Assistant Director Venkatalakshmi, and veterinary officers, visited farms in Thamanampettai and nearby areas to assess husbandry practices, farm sanitation, feed, and drinking-water supplies. Samples have been collected to determine whether deaths result from an infectious disease, climate-related stress from erratic monsoon conditions (northeast monsoon, alternating rain and sun) and a Bay of Bengal cyclone causing rainfall, or other factors. Lab results are pending. Separately, residents report fever, cough, and cold amid fluctuating weather conditions, signaling potential public health implications from the weather pattern.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動：養鶏場で1000羽以上の鶏が突然死亡
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州の養鶏場で原因不明の大量死が発生し検査中だが、感染症か気候要因かは未確定であり、ヒトへの影響も確認されていないため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 原因（感染症か気候ストレスか）は検査結果待ちであり、住民の発熱・咳・風邪症状は鶏の大量死と直接関連づけられていない。続報での確定診断を待つ必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: CDC Ebola Attestation Takes Effect Tonight: 130 Million Passengers, 25,000 at Risk
article.articleSummary: Starting Nov 3, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET, the CDC requires every passenger on an international US-bound flight to attest they were not in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) in the prior 21 days; airlines must collect, retain for 42 days, and can deny boarding for noncompliance. The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC—no approved vaccine or treatment—drives this measure. By Oct 25, 2026, ECDC reports 9,964 confirmed cases and 4,851 deaths across three DRC provinces, with additional cases in Kenya and Nigeria; the outbreak surpassed 1,000 confirmed infections within ~40 days of detection, the fastest in Ebola history. The Bundibugyo strain offers limited protection from the Ervebo vaccine, and no licensed vaccine exists; a candidate (ChAdOx1 BDBV) is under review. The US pledged ≥$220 million; the attestation policy highlights a tension: fewer than 25,000 of ~130 million international-origin travelers had DRC ties in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: CDCのエボラ出血熱に関する渡航申告制度、今夜施行：1億3000万人の乗客中2万5000人がリスク対象
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが過去最速の拡大ペースを示し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大、ワクチン未承認、米国CDCによる渡航制限措置導入に至っており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 主たる発生地はDRC東部（ブンディブギョ株、9964例確定・4851死亡、2026年10月25日時点）。ケニア・ナイジェリアへの波及が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれず、米国は渡航制限実施国であり発生国ではないため除外。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | La pénurie d'intrants et les grèves fragilisent la riposte contre le choléra à l'Equateur | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | The shortage of inputs and strikes weaken the cholera response in Équateur | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Cholera response in Équateur province, Democratic Republic of Congo, is hampered by shortages of medicines, chlorine, and sampling kits, as well as limited bed capacity in treatment centers and healthcare worker strikes. The latest epidemiological bulletin dated November 1, 2026, from the Provincial Health Division of Équateur reports 142 cholera cases and 17 deaths. Ongoing healthcare worker strikes, including a national walkout since October 15, have strained facilities and delayed care. Treatment centers in Bolenge and Wangata report constrained capacity amid rising patient needs. Authorities are appealing to the government and technical and financial partners to reinforce the supply of medical inputs and support the ongoing cholera response operations.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース | 資機材不足とストライキがエクアトゥール州のコレラ対応を弱体化させる | mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: DRCエクアトゥール州で142症例・17死亡（致死率約12%）のコレラ流行が継続し、医療物資不足や医療従事者ストライキにより対応が阻害されている。重症度が高く、政府・国際パートナーへの支援要請がなされていることから、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域に『Republic of Ecuador』が含まれるが、これはDRC国内の『Équateur州』の誤認識（Bluedotの地名解析エラー）であり、記事はDRCのエクアトゥール州のコレラ流行についてのみ述べている。致死率が約12%と高く、医療システムへの負荷が深刻な点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Colombia activa vigilancia sanitaria tras dos casos de malaria importada | HSB Noticias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Colombia activates public health surveillance after two imported malaria cases | HSB Noticias
article.articleSummary: Two Colombians returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo were diagnosed with Plasmodium falciparum malaria in Colombia, triggering heightened epidemiological surveillance. The 33-year-old died on October 31 in Palmira, Valle del Cauca, while the 50-year-old remains hospitalized in Cali. The Ministry of Health and Protection Social and the National Institute of Health are conducting investigations in Cali and Palmira to map travel routes, exposure sites, and contacts. Two additional individuals arriving from the DRC reportedly have malaria and are under treatment. Rapid-response teams are performing laboratory tests to rule out other infections, including Ebola; no Ebola case is confirmed. Authorities urge travelers from the DRC with fever or symptoms to seek medical care as surveillance and verifications continue, coordinated with Migración Colombia.

triage.headline_ja: コロンビア、輸入マラリア症例2件を受け公衆衛生監視を発動
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国からの渡航者による輸入マラリア症例（死亡1例含む）が確認され監視体制が強化されているが、ヒト-ヒト感染や地域拡大の証拠はなく、情報も限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコロンビアにおける輸入マラリア症例（DRC渡航者）の管理であり、DRC国内での発生自体は本記事の主題ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれない。Ebolaは検査で否定的（未確認）。

article.articleHeadline: 俄國鼠疫謎團未解 中共悄悄通報一死亡病例 | 鼠疫死亡病例 | 傳染病 | 鼠疫病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia's plague mystery remains unsolved as the CCP quietly reports one death case | plague death case | infectious disease | plague case
article.articleSummary: Plague in China surfaces again as the CCP’s Disease Prevention and Control Center quietly confirms one plague death in September, with no location or timing disclosed. The September national infectious disease overview reportedly lists eight Class A illnesses: seven cholera and one plague, with one plague death, details withheld. Meanwhile, Russia’s plague research institute reported a 28-year-old female worker died from an unknown pneumonia; WHO on Oct 10 flagged lack of a precise diagnosis as the main uncertainty, noting 200 close contacts tested negative and no confirmed plague cases locally, but warnings persist. Rumors of possible plague exposure spread in China, though officials deny cases. Historically, plague remains present in China, though sporadic since 2010, concentrated in Inner Mongolia and Yunnan, linked to contact with wild animals or pastoral activity.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト謎は未解決、中国共産党がひっそりと死亡例を一件報告 | ペスト死亡例 | 感染症 | ペスト症例
triage.triage_reason: 中国が9月の感染症概況でペスト死亡1例・コレラ7例を公表したが詳細（場所・時期）を伏せており、情報不透明性と噂の拡散が社会的関心を高めている。ロシアの研究者死亡例と合わせ、WHOも不確実性を指摘しており、続報次第でリスクが高まる可能性がある。
triage.notes: ロシアでの死亡例はWHOが診断未確定としており、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。中国内の内モンゴル・雲南は中国として集約。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola suma 5.376 muertos y es el más extendido de los registrados en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has killed 5,376 people and is the most widespread on record in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa driven by Bundibugyo variant, with no approved vaccines or treatments. Since May, more than 10,000 infections and mortality over 50%. As of Oct. 31, 2026, 5,376 deaths, 5,372 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and 2 in Kenya and 2 in Uganda. Uganda was the first country impacted and later declared free of the outbreak; initial spillover crossed from DRC, 20 cases, containment led to August declaration. Kenya recorded first-ever October cases (9). Nigeria reported a separate case in October: a 42-year-old Swiss woman whose husband works at the Swiss Embassy in Abuja; linked to travel to Uganda, highlighting cross-border transmission risk. Ervebo vaccine trials have begun, though not designed for Bundibugyo; use is exploratory. Transmission occurs via contact with infected fluids or contaminated surfaces; incubation 2–21 days; early symptoms resemble malaria; severe disease includes vomiting, diarrhea, kidney/liver failure, hemorrhage.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行で死者5,376人、アフリカ史上最大の流行規模に
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱流行でアフリカ史上最大規模（死者5,376人、感染者1万人超、致死率50%超）、複数国へ越境拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアでも症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが死者の大多数（5,372人）を占める震源地。承認されたワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、国際的な支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: "미국 가려면 에볼라 서약서 필수"...대한항공, 4일부터 제출 의무화 | 아주경제
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "To travel to the United States, an Ebola pledge form is mandatory" ... Korean Air makes submission mandatory from the 4th | Aju Economy
article.articleSummary: Korean Air will require Ebola pledge forms for all passengers on United States–bound flights starting December 4, under CDC orders to prevent Ebola importation from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Every passenger, including U.S. citizens and green-card holders, crew, and transfer travelers, must affirm they have not visited or stayed in the DRC within the previous 21 days. If a passenger has a DRC visit, they must spend 21 days outside the United States before flying, and may travel on day 22. The pledge, for all travelers including infants, can be completed on paper or electronically and submitted before departure check-in. The requirement runs through December 19, Korea time, with updates possible if U.S. guidance changes. Ebola transmits via blood or body fluids; incubation up to 21 days with symptoms like fever, muscle pain, and vomiting.

triage.headline_ja: 「米国へ渡航するにはエボラ誓約書が必須」...大韓航空、4日から提出義務化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ出血熱流行を受け、米国CDCの指示により米国行き全便で渡航者誓約書提出が義務化されるなど、国際的な渡航制限措置が実際に講じられており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行に対する米国・韓国航空会社の渡航対策を報じたものであり、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。米国・韓国は対応措置の実施国であり発生地域ではないため除外した。DRCの流行状況（規模、死亡者数等）の詳細情報は本記事に含まれず、フルリスク評価で確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 미국 가려면 에볼라 서약서 제출해야...대한항공, 4일부터 의무화
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To travel to the U.S., you must submit an Ebola pledge form... Korean Air makes it mandatory from the 4th.
article.articleSummary: Korean Air will require all passengers flying to the United States to submit an Ebola pledge form starting December 4 at 1:59 PM local time, under a CDC order to prevent Ebola importation from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The pledge confirms that in the past 21 days the traveler has not visited or stayed in the DRC, including layovers, and applies to all U.S.-bound flights, including Guam and Hawaii routes, for U.S. citizens, permanent residents, crew, and transfer passengers. Each traveler must complete a separate pledge (paper or electronic) before boarding; guardians may sign for minors or incapacitated travelers, and travel companions or agents may sign on their behalf if authorized. If the pledge is not submitted, boarding is restricted. The rule follows CDC guidance and remains in effect through December 19, with possible updates if guidelines change; leaving the DRC requires 21 days outside the country before boarding to the U.S.

triage.headline_ja: 米国へ渡航するにはエボラ誓約書の提出が必要...大韓航空、4日から義務化
triage.triage_reason: CDCがDRCでのエボラ流行を背景に米国行き全便で渡航誓約書提出を義務化するなど、国際的な渡航制限措置が既に発動されており、IHR基準（渡航制限・国際拡大リスク）に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行に対する米国CDCの渡航対策（韓国発便含む）を報じるもの。Hawaii・米国・韓国は渡航措置の適用対象国であり、実際の発生地域はDRCのみ。DRCでの具体的な症例数・重症度・流行規模については本文に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana AIDS Commission Launches Youth Desk To Tackle Infections Among Young People
article.articleSummary: Ghana AIDS Commission launches a Youth Desk to tackle HIV infections among young people in Ghana. On 2 November 2026, the Commission introduced the Youth Desk to elevate HIV prevention, awareness, testing and treatment discussions and to involve youth in the national HIV response. The desk aims to improve access to accurate information, promote responsible health decisions, and bridge gaps caused by limited reliable information, stigma and misconceptions. It seeks to strengthen collaboration with youth organizations, educational institutions and other stakeholders to foster open conversations about sexual health, promote voluntary HIV testing, early diagnosis and treatment access, and reduce new infections by empowering young people with education and services.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ・エイズ委員会、若年層の感染対策のためユースデスクを開設
triage.triage_reason: HIV対策のための行政施策に関する記事であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事態を示すものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の疾患（HIV）に対する予防啓発・組織体制強化の取り組みであり、アウトブレイクや新規事例の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Nuevo requisito para viajar a EU por brote de ébola; qué declaración debes imprimir y llevar al aeropuerto (18:00 h)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New travel requirement for traveling to the EU due to an Ebola outbreak; what declaration you must print and bring to the airport (6:00 PM).
article.articleSummary: Ebola travel requirement for U.S.-bound flights begins 11:59 p.m. EST on November 3, 2026, prompted by an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. All international travelers, regardless of nationality, must complete the CDC Ebola Passenger Disclosure and Attestation Form, certifying they have not been physically in the DRC during the 21 days before boarding. The form must be downloaded, printed, filled, and presented at the boarding gate. The rule applies to those who have been in DRC by air, land, or sea, including connections at DRC airports, even if they do not leave the airport; overflights are excluded. If you were in DRC in the prior 21 days, contact the airline for guidance. In Mexico, travelers must still meet domestic ID requirements; travelers should verify destination rules via IATA or the airline (Volaris).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行によりEU（米国）渡航に新たな要件；空港に印刷して持参すべき申告書とは（18:00時点）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行を受け、米国がCDCによる渡航者申告制度を導入するなど、既に国際的な渡航制限措置が発動されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は米国・メキシコにおける渡航規制の実務的内容が中心だが、感染源はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ流行であり、発生地域としてはDRCのみを採用した。米国・メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 대한항공, 4일부터 미국행 승객 '에볼라 서약서' 제출 의무화
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Korean Air makes it mandatory from the 4th for U.S.-bound passengers to submit an 'Ebola pledge'.
article.articleSummary: Korean Air will require all U.S.-bound passengers to submit an Ebola pledge starting Nov 4, 2026 at 1:59 PM, as part of a U.S. CDC admin order to curb Ebola importation from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). WHO data show DRC Ebola outbreaks with 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths (case fatality ~48.3%) as of last month. The pledge applies to U.S. citizens, green-card holders, crew, and transfer passengers, including those who only transit at DRC airports; anyone with a DRC visit in the past 21 days cannot board. For those with recent DRC travel, the departure date is day 0, and after 21 days spent outside the U.S., they may fly on day 22. Each passenger, including infants, must complete one pledge. The measure runs through December 19, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 大韓航空、4日から米国行き乗客に「エボラ誓約書」提出を義務化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが大規模（9,066症例、致死率48.3%）であり、米国CDCが渡航制限措置を講じるなど国際的対応が発生しているため、IHR基準複数該当とみなしフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国の航空会社による渡航対策について報じているが、根本的な感染症イベントはDRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク。米国・韓国は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。致死率48.3%、累計9,066症例・4,381死亡という大規模アウトブレイクであり、既にWHO通知・国際渡航制限が発動されている段階と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Sustaining measures against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Nigeria must sustain Ebola preparedness after 2014’s Lagos outbreak, when Dr. Ameyo Adadevoh quarantined the index case Patrick Sawyer and limited deaths to eight. A 42-year-old Ugandan-born woman in Abuja tested positive on October 20 after returning from Uganda and was evacuated to Switzerland; 52 contacts remain under monitoring. WHO says Nigeria could be certified Ebola-free after 42 days of containment. DR Congo reports a Bundibugyo outbreak in May 2026 with about 10,000+ cases and 5,000+ deaths, the strain carrying a 50% fatality rate. Uganda has 21 confirmed/probable cases and 3 deaths; Kenya 9 and 2; Nigeria and France 1 each. Transmission stems from unsafe environments, wildlife contact, and bodily fluids; incubation 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, flu-like illness, vomiting, and diarrhoea, with possible organ failure. Nigeria’s measures include border controls, temperature screening, health declaration forms, travel histories, contact tracing, isolation units, labs, and a ₦10 billion fund; reinforced PHCs and emergency services; advisories on travel from East Africa and neutral venues for AFCON-related matches.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策の維持について
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyo株による大規模エボラアウトブレイク（症例1万超、死者5千超、致死率50%）が進行中で、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスにも感染が拡大しており、IHR4基準すべてに該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアの備えだが、実際の大規模アウトブレイク（1万例超、致死率50%）はDRCのBundibugyo株によるもの。ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニア、スイス、フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCの状況を踏まえ速やかなフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 대한항공, 오는 4일부터 미국행 승객 에볼라 서약서 제출 의무화
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Korean Air to require Ebola declaration forms from U.S.-bound passengers starting on the 4th.
article.articleSummary: Korean Air will require Ebola declaration forms from all passengers on U.S.-bound flights beginning December 4, 2026 at 1:59 PM Korea Time (December 3, 11:59 PM EST). The measure follows a CDC administrative order to prevent the entry of Ebola from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) into the United States. The declaration must confirm no visit or stay in the DRC within the prior 21 days; even passengers who only transit without leaving the airport are included. U.S. citizens and permanent residents, crew, and transfer passengers are covered. Each passenger must complete a form for every individual, including infants, with forms accepted in paper or electronic format and submitted before check-in. Refusal or non-submission can bar boarding. Guardians or authorized companions, or delegated travel staff, may complete the form on behalf of those unable to. The measure lasts until December 19, 2026, per CDC guidance, and could change with future directives.

triage.headline_ja: 大韓航空、4日から米国行き乗客にエボラ宣誓書の提出を義務化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行を受け、米CDCが渡航制限措置（宣誓書提出義務化）を発出しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・国際的拡大・渡航制限）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行を背景とした米国CDCによる渡航制限措置（韓国発米国行き便への宣誓書義務化）を報じたもの。発生国はDRCであり、韓国・米国は対策実施国として記載されているのみで、発生地域には該当しないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 대한항공, 4일부터 미국행 노선서 에볼라 서약서 제출 의무화

article.articleSummary: Korean Air will require Ebola-related pledge forms for all passengers on U.S.-bound flights starting with departures on Nov 4 at 1:59 PM. Guardians may sign on behalf of minors or those unable to sign. The directive runs through Dec 19, with updates possible if guidelines change.

triage.headline_ja: 大韓航空、4日から米国行き路線でエボラ誓約書の提出を義務化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ発生を受け、米国CDCの行政命令に基づき国際便での渡航制限措置が取られており、IHR基準（深刻性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限）に複数該当する。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Korean Air makes Ebola pledge form mandatory for U.S.-bound passengers... effective from the 4th.
article.articleSummary: Korean Air requires an Ebola pledge form for all passengers on U.S.-bound flights (including Guam and Hawaii routes) starting November 4, 2026, per a CDC administrative order. The form must confirm no visit or stay in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) within the previous 21 days; non-submission or false information will bar boarding. The order applies to U.S. citizens, permanent residents, crew, and transit passengers. The pledge takes effect 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on November 3, 2026. Each traveler must submit an individual form; a single submission cannot cover a group. Minors or passengers unable to sign may be assisted by a guardian or authorized adult; travel companions or airline staff with delegated authority may sign on their behalf. Forms can be paper or electronic and must be submitted before check-in. The measure runs through December 19, 2026 Korea time, per the article.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Korean Air to make Ebola pledge form submission mandatory for U.S.-bound passengers starting on the 4th.
article.articleSummary: Korean Air will require an Ebola pledge form for all passengers bound for the United States starting November 4, 2026, under a U.S. CDC administrative order. Passengers with any travel history to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) within the previous 21 days are barred from US-bound flights, including routes to Guam and Hawaii. The pledge must confirm no DRC visit or stay in the last 21 days and must be submitted by all travelers, including U.S. citizens, green-card holders, crew, and transfer passengers. Even a simple DRC airport layover counts toward the 21-day window. Those with DRC travel history are day 0 on departure and must spend 21 full days outside DRC before flying to the US on day 22. The measure runs through December 19, 2026, with further guidance to be issued if US health authorities update rules.

article.articleHeadline: Korean Air Mandates Ebola Declaration for U.S.-Bound Passengers
article.articleSummary: Korean Air will require U.S.-bound passengers to declare they have not visited or stayed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) within the past 21 days, effective for departures on the 4th. The U.S. CDC-mandated declaration aims to prevent Ebola virus entry into the United States and applies to all overseas flights to the U.S., including those to Guam and Hawaii. It covers U.S. citizens, permanent residents, crew, and transit passengers, even if they only transited through a DRC airport. Anyone with DRC travel within 21 days cannot board; failure or incomplete declaration blocks boarding. One declaration form per passenger (paper or electronic) at check-in; guardians may sign for minors or those unable to complete the form. Travelers should count Day 0 as the day they left the DRC and spend 21 full days outside the U.S. before boarding on Day 22. The measure remains until December 19 Korean time, pending CDC guidance.

article.articleHeadline: 少女腰痛难忍竟是细菌感染 医生：接受侵入性操作须谨慎 _新闻频道_厦门网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unbearable back pain in a teenage girl turns out to be a bacterial infection; doctor says invasive procedures should be approached with caution.
article.articleSummary: A 14-year-old girl in Xiamen, Fujian, China, presented with persistent lower back pain but no fever. Imaging revealed destruction of the L4 vertebral body with a suspected paravertebral abscess, indicating spinal infection. Routine blood tests showed normal white blood cell count, but erythrocyte sedimentation rate was markedly elevated; tuberculosis was ruled out. Lumbar lesion biopsy demonstrated abundant Staphylococcus aureus, confirming vertebral osteomyelitis caused by S. aureus. The infection was likely seeded through an invasive procedure performed at a clinic, allowing bacteria to invade the spine. Targeted antibiotics led to rapid pain relief and good recovery on follow-up. The report emphasizes that teenage spinal infections are rare and may present without fever, urging thorough evaluation of persistent or progressive back pain (over ~2 weeks) with ESR and MRI, and caution against early invasive therapies such as acupuncture or local injections. Obtaining tissue for culture is essential to guide precise therapy and prevent chronic complications. Keywords: spinal infection, Staphylococcus aureus, vertebral osteomyelitis, adolescent health, invasive procedures.

article.articleHeadline: 毒株确认！已进入流行季，武汉疾控最新提醒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strain confirmed! The epidemic season has begun, Wuhan CDC’s latest alert.
article.articleSummary: Influenza season has begun in Wuhan, with influenza A H3N2 the dominant strain and multiple strains co-circulating nationwide. Wuhan’s center reports low current activity but an autumn–winter peak is approaching; A/H3N2 and B strains are circulating, with H3N2 predominant. Flu differs from the common cold: fever can reach 39–40°C, plus systemic symptoms and risks of pneumonia, myocarditis, and other complications, especially in older adults and those with chronic diseases. Infants may present without fever; the elderly may have fatigue and poor appetite. Vaccination remains the most effective prevention. The 2026–2027 guidelines recommend vaccination for all 6 months and older with no contraindications. Antibodies take 2–4 weeks to develop; best to vaccinate in September–October, though the season typically runs November–March. This year uses three-valent vaccines (split, subunit, and live attenuated); B/Yamagata lineage has not been detected since 2020, so no four-valent option. Even after infection, vaccination is advised; combine with masks and hand hygiene.

article.articleHeadline: 流感三毒株活跃 打疫苗最经济有效
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three influenza strains are circulating; vaccination is the most cost-effective.
article.articleSummary: China faces the autumn–winter influenza season. The CDC's Week 43 influenza surveillance (Oct 19–25) reports 145 influenza-like illness outbreaks nationwide, up from 28 the prior week. This season features early onset and three co-circulating strains: A(H3N2), A(H1N1)pdm09, and B Victoria lineage, with A strains comprising 67.6% and B 32.4% of positives; within A, H3N2 accounts for about 67.2% of A and H1N1pdm09 for about 32.8%. Co-circulation without cross-protection may extend the season and raise total cases, though symptoms are similar: high fever, headache, sore throat, myalgia, fatigue, more than ordinary colds. Vaccination remains the most cost-effective defense; annual flu vaccine is recommended for anyone aged 6 months and older, with prioritized groups (health workers, elderly ≥60, chronic disease patients, pregnant women, young children, school staff). Immunity lasts roughly 6–8 months. Vaccines update yearly; antivirals should be used early (within 48 hours) for high-risk patients; antibiotics are ineffective against influenza.

article.articleHeadline: 一旦感染，终身携带！这种病毒进入高发期
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Once infected, you carry it for life! This virus has entered a high-incidence period.
article.articleSummary: Varicella-zoster virus reactivation causes herpes zoster (shingles). Autumn–winter is a high-incidence period as reduced immunity promotes reactivation after primary chickenpox infection, with the virus latent in dorsal root ganglia. Shingles progresses through prodrome (low fever, fatigue and local pain), eruption (unilateral belt-like clusters of vesicles with neuralgia), and postherpetic neuralgia (pain lasting months to years). It can affect any nerve innervated site, not only the waist, including head, neck, chest, eyes, ears, and occasionally the face. Do not delay treatment; antiviral therapy within 72 hours of rash onset, plus analgesia, minimizes nerve damage. Transmission occurs via vesicle fluid; most adults are immune, but unvaccinated children should avoid contact until crusting. Prevention relies on vaccination and maintaining immune health. Information source: National Emergency Broadcast; Dr. Zhu Qian, Pain Department, China-Japan Friendship Hospital, Beijing.

article.articleHeadline: 江苏疾控发布11月防病提示
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jiangsu CDC Issues November Disease Prevention Tips
article.articleSummary: Nov 3, 2026: Jiangsu CDC warns November brings high activity of influenza, varicella, scarlet fever, scrub typhus, and hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS). Preventive measures emphasize vaccination and hygiene. Influenza vaccination targets the elderly, children, and pregnant women; rural areas offer a free one-dose vaccine for 65+ and schoolchildren, with some employers running ‘two go, one free’ promos. Avoid crowded indoor spaces; keep homes ventilated daily and wear masks outdoors. Varicella spreads by droplets and vesicle fluid; vaccinate eligible individuals, isolate until crusting, trim nails, wash hands, and avoid sharing utensils. Scarlet fever requires proper antibiotic treatment and follow-up to prevent nephritis and rheumatic fever. Scrub typhus peaks Oct–Nov; avoid dense shrubs, keep dry, wear light clothing, use repellents, and shower after outdoor activity. HFRS is endemic; reduce rodent exposure, seal entryways, store grains securely, and vaccinate 16–60-year-olds. Also heed carbon monoxide poisoning risk.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Deaths Pass 5,000 as Outbreak Spreads
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Congo has killed 5,376 people as of 2 November 2026 (5,372 in Congo; 2 in Kenya; 2 in Uganda) with Africa CDC listing 10,444 confirmed cases, while the US CDC records 10,498 due to different cut-off dates. The Bundibugyo strain, identified in Uganda in 2007, has no approved vaccine or drug; Ervebo (Zaire-strain vaccine) is being tested experimentally with unproven efficacy. The Congo outbreak was declared in mid-May 2026; Uganda reported 20 cases and two deaths but has since been declared free of the virus. Kenya recorded nine cases in October; Nigeria confirmed one case linked to Uganda (a woman who traveled to Switzerland for treatment). US travel measures include a 21-day Congo exposure bar for travelers and, from 3 November, a written attestation on international flights. CDC advises avoiding Ituri and Nord-Kivu and reconsidering Haut-Uele and Tshopo travel.

triage.headline_ja: 大韓航空、4日から米国行き旅客に『エボラ誓約書』を義務化
triage.triage_reason: CDCがコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）からの渡航者に対する米国行き搭乗制限を発令しており、IHR基準の複数（渡航制限、国際的懸念、公衆衛生上の重大性）に該当するため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ発生を受けた米国CDCの渡航制限措置（21日以内のDRC滞在者の搭乗禁止）に関する大韓航空の対応を報じたもの。発生地域として挙げられたHawaii・Republic of Korea・United Statesは渡航制限の対象地域であり、実際の感染症発生国はDRCのみ。続報でDRC国内の流行状況（症例数・死亡者数等）を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 대한항공, 4일부터 미국행 승객 '에볼라 서약서' 제출 의무화
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Korean Air to require passengers bound for the United States to submit an 'Ebola pledge' starting on the 4th.
article.articleSummary: Korean Air will require all passengers bound for the United States to sign an Ebola pledge starting Dec 4, 1:59 PM (Korea time) to prevent importation of Ebola from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The pledge confirms no DRC visit or stay in the previous 21 days; even layovers count as stay. It applies on all US routes, including Guam and Hawaii, to US citizens, permanent residents, crew, and transfer passengers moving through the US. If a traveler has visited/stayed in DRC within 21 days or refuses to sign, they cannot board. Each passenger must complete one pledge (infants included; guardians may sign for those unable). Paper or electronic forms are accepted and must be submitted before check-in. Enforcement runs through Dec 19, 2026. The CDC’s order, issued last month with a later amendment clarifying crew applicability, imposes penalties for false information under US federal law.

triage.headline_ja: 大韓航空、4日から米国行き乗客に『エボラ誓約書』提出を義務化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で発生中のエボラ出血熱に関連し、米国CDCの命令に基づき国際線での渡航制限（誓約書提出義務）が実施されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ発生を受けた米国行き航空便への渡航対策（韓国発着便含む）を報じるものであり、実際の感染発生地はDRCのみ。韓国・米国・グアム・ハワイは渡航制限の適用地域であり発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 대한항공, 4일부터 미국행 승객 에볼라 서약서 제출 의무화 - 경제 | 기사 - 더팩트
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Korean Air to require Ebola pledge form submission for US-bound passengers starting on the 4th
article.articleSummary: Korean Air will require Ebola pledge forms for all United States-bound passengers starting December 4, with departures at 1:59 PM, in response to a US CDC administrative order to prevent Ebola importation from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). US-bound travelers must certify before check-in that they have not visited or stayed in the DRC within the last 21 days; a DRC airport layover counts as stay. The rule covers US citizens, lawful permanent residents, and transit passengers, and applies to infants, with one pledge per person. Pledges may be submitted on paper or electronically. If any DRC exposure occurred in the preceding 21 days, boarding is prohibited. The 21-day clock starts the day after leaving the DRC (day 0); eligibility resumes on day 22. The obligation runs through December 19 (KST); updates will follow if US guidance changes.

triage.headline_ja: 大韓航空、4日から米国行き乗客にエボラ誓約書提出を義務化
triage.triage_reason: 米CDCの行政命令に基づきDRC由来エボラの米国への持ち込み防止のための渡航制限措置が実施されており、IHR基準の複数（渡航制限・国際的拡大懸念）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ発生を受けた米国・韓国側の渡航対応措置に関する内容であり、米国・韓国は発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。DRCでの実際の症例数・死亡者数など疫学的詳細は本記事に記載なし。CDC命令の背景にあるDRCの流行状況についてフルリスク評価での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 대한항공, 미국행 승객 대상 '에볼라' 관련 서약서 제출 의무화
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Korean Air makes Ebola-related pledge submission mandatory for passengers traveling to the United States.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 November 2026, Korean Air announced that from 4 November 1:59 PM (Korean time), all passengers on US-bound flights must submit an Ebola pledge, per a CDC administrative order to prevent Ebola importation from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The pledge, which can be paper or electronic, must be completed by each traveler and submitted before check-in; guardians may sign for those unable. The rule applies to all travelers, including citizens, residents, crew, and transfer passengers, and even those who simply transit through DRC if their 21-day look-back includes DRC. If a passenger has visited or stayed in the DRC within the past 21 days, they cannot board; refusing to sign also bars boarding. The pledge remains in effect until 19 December (Korean time), subject to changes in U.S. guidance. Boarding to the United States is allowed only from the 22nd day after leaving DRC after spending 21 days elsewhere.

triage.headline_ja: 大韓航空、米国行き乗客に対しエボラ関連誓約書の提出を義務化
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ出血熱流行を受け、米CDCが渡航制限措置を発令し航空会社が誓約書提出を義務化しており、IHR基準の重大性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限の複数項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで発生中のエボラ流行を受けた米CDCの渡航制限措置に関するもの。米国・韓国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 10 آلاف إصابة بإيبولا في إفريقيا والوفيات تتجاوز 5300
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 10,000 Ebola cases in Africa, with deaths exceeding 5,300.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-03, Africa has recorded over 10,000 Ebola cases and more than 5,300 deaths, with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) accounting for the vast majority of fatalities as the current outbreak’s epicenter, per Africa CDC. The DRC officially declared the outbreak on May 15, 2026, and officials say the virus may have resurfaced in the country months earlier, detected belatedly. Ebola spreads via contact with infected body fluids and causes severe hemorrhagic fever. Africa CDC tallies 5,376 deaths nationwide, including 5,372 in the DRC, among 3,500 cases documented during the 2018–2020 outbreak—the country’s worst on record, which killed about 2,300 of 3,500 cases. The report underscores Congo’s central role in the ongoing outbreak, with no further details on laboratory confirmation or specific infection sources provided."} }{ }{}{

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ感染者1万人超、死者5300人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクが継続しており、死者数が5000人を超えるなど公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、IHR基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事内の数値（2018-2020年の流行との混同、累計3,500症例と1万症例の記述の不整合）に矛盾が見られ、情報の正確性には注意が必要。続報で正確な症例数・致死率・対応状況を確認すべき。
